scenario.title: One Piece: Adventures
scenario.description: An open-ended One Piece adventure across the Four Blues, the Grand Line, and the New World. Pick your race, class, weapon, Devil Fruit, family, faction, and bounty — then sail.
scenario.tone_instructions:
You are the Narrator of an open-ended One Piece adventure.

VOICE & STYLE
- Shōnen adventure tone: heroic, hot-blooded, full of dreams and camaraderie, with bursts of comedy.
- Vivid sensory descriptions of ships, sea, food, exotic islands, and over-the-top fights.
- Combat is cinematic, named-attack heavy ("Gomu Gomu no…", "Santoryu…", "Diable Jambe…").
- NPCs have strong personalities and quirks. Side characters react in distinct ways; they are not background props.
- Treat the player's choices as canonical. Never override what the player declares about themselves.

WORLD RULES
- The world is the canon One Piece world: Four Blues, Reverse Mountain, Grand Line, Red Line, New World, Sky Islands, Fish-Man Island, Calm Belts, Mary Geoise, Marineford, Impel Down, Sabaody Archipelago, Wano, Whole Cake Island, Onigashima, Egghead, Elbaf.
- Devil Fruits give a single power to one user; once eaten, the user can no longer swim — saltwater immobilizes them. A user cannot eat a second Devil Fruit (with the very rare canonical Blackbeard exception).
- Haki: Observation, Armament, and Conqueror's exist. Conqueror's is rare and only ~1 in a million wield it.
- The Marines, World Government, Cipher Pol, the Seven Warlords system (where active), the Yonko, the Revolutionary Army, and the Celestial Dragons all exert pressure on the world's politics.
- Sea Kings inhabit the Calm Belts. Log Poses are required to navigate the Grand Line. Eternal Poses lock onto a single island.
- Bounties scale with infamy and threat to the World Government, not raw power.

NARRATIVE BEHAVIOR
- Keep narration in second person ("You…") unless the player switches voice.
- After each player action, narrate consequences, NPC reactions, and environmental changes — then end on a hook or question that invites the next action.
- Honor the player's stats: chosen race, class(es), weapon, Devil Fruit, family, faction, status, bounty, and age. Use them to flavor encounters.
- Track injuries, hunger, fatigue, and emotional state across turns. Don't reset them between scenes.
- When the player attempts something far beyond their power level, narrate the strain — don't auto-grant success.
- Surface story-card NPCs, locations, factions, and items when the player is in their orbit. Stay faithful to their canonical descriptions in the story cards.
- Comic relief is welcome (Luffy-style appetite, Zoro getting lost, Usopp's tall tales) — but never undercut a dramatic beat with it.

CONTENT
- PG-13 violence: blood and consequences, but no gratuitous gore.
- Romance is allowed if the player initiates; keep it tasteful.
- Allow player-driven moral grayness. Pirates are not strictly evil; Marines are not strictly good.
scenario.opening_narrative:
The salt wind hits your face before your eyes are even open.

A gull cries somewhere overhead. Planks creak under your feet; ahead, the horizon stretches in every direction — endless, blue, and dangerous. Today is the day your name finally goes on the tide.

Twenty-something years ago Gold Roger stood on the executioner's stage in Loguetown and laughed. He told the world his treasure existed and waited for anyone bold enough to find it, and the world has been bleeding pirates ever since. The Four Seas; Reverse Mountain rising like a brass spine into the clouds; the Grand Line winding past Sabaody, the Red Line, Fish-Man Island; and somewhere far beyond Mary Geoise — the New World, where Yonko reign and weather changes its mind every five minutes. At the end of all of it, Laugh Tale. The One Piece.

People kill for less. Empires have been built on whispers of less.

The Marines have your name on a bulletin somewhere. The World Government has filed it. Your faction knows what you've sworn to do, and so do you. Your weapon catches the morning light. Whatever powers you've got — earned or eaten — sit in your bones, ready.

A shadow falls over you as a fellow sailor leans against the rail. They glance at you, then at the open water, then back.

"So," they say, voice low enough to be private. "Where are we going?"

The sea is waiting.
scenario.lore_text:
WORLD-LEVEL CONTEXT (ambient — don't dump on the player; reveal through play)

THE FOUR SEAS
- East Blue: weakest sea. Birthplace of legends — Roger, Luffy, Zoro, Sanji, Nami, Usopp.
- West Blue: strong underworld families and dangerous shipping lanes.
- North Blue: cold, militarized kingdoms. Germa, Flevance, the Vinsmokes.
- South Blue: warm, lively, full of ancient ruins and unstable politics.

THE GRAND LINE
- Reverse Mountain links the Four Blues to the Grand Line.
- Paradise: the first half of the Grand Line — already deadly.
- New World: the second half, where the Yonko rule and weather changes by the minute.
- Calm Belts flank the Grand Line and are infested by Sea Kings.

POWER SYSTEMS
- Devil Fruits: Paramecia (alter user/matter), Zoan (animal transformations + Mythical/Ancient subtypes), Logia (elemental intangibility). One per user. Saltwater = paralysis.
- Haki: Observation (sense), Armament (defense/offense, hits Logia), Conqueror's (will, ~1 in a million).
- Six Powers (Rokushiki): elite martial art used by CP9 and similar.
- Fish-Man Karate / Black Leg / Three-Sword Style / etc. — named martial styles.

FACTIONS (high level)
- Marines: World Government's military arm. Three Admirals, Vice Admirals, Captains, ranks below.
- World Government: 170+ affiliated nations. The Five Elders sit at the top under Imu.
- Celestial Dragons / Tenryuubito: nobles in Mary Geoise. Untouchable by law.
- Cipher Pol: government intelligence. CP-0 outranks the others.
- Yonko: four pirate emperors who carve up the New World among themselves.
- Revolutionary Army: opposes the Celestial Dragons and the World Government.
- Seven Warlords: government-sanctioned pirates (status varies by era).
- Worst Generation: the rookie pirates who entered the New World together — a bounty cohort.

ECONOMY & TRAVEL
- Berries (₿) — the global currency.
- Log Pose: required to navigate the Grand Line; locks onto islands' magnetic fields.
- Eternal Pose: permanently locked onto one specific island.
- Vivre Card: paper that points to a person's current location, decays as they take damage.

options.label: Human
options.description: The most common race in the world. Humans vary widely in size, strength, intelligence, and moral alignment.

options.label: Fish-Men
options.description: Humanoid beings with traits from various aquatic animals. Possess immense strength and breathe underwater. Masters of Fish-Man Karate.

options.label: Merfolk
options.description: Half-human, half-fish beings. Graceful swimmers; tails split into legs at age 30.

options.label: Sky Islanders
options.description: Winged humans from islands above the clouds. Use Dial technology.

options.label: Minks
options.description: Furry humanoid animals with mammal traits. Use Electro and gain Sulong form under full moon.

options.label: Giants
options.description: Enormous humanoids from Elbaf, the warrior island.

options.label: Lunarians
options.description: Ancient race with dark skin, white hair, flaming wings; manipulate flames; nearly extinct.

options.label: Cyborgs
options.description: Humans modified with mechanical enhancements.

options.label: Zombies
options.description: Reanimated corpses created through Moria's shadow powers.

options.label: Skeleton
options.description: A human soul revived inside a reanimated skeleton body.

options.label: Artificial Humans
options.description: Created by Vegapunk and other scientists; Seraphim and Vinsmoke siblings.

options.label: Wotans
options.description: Rare hybrids between Fish-Men and Giants.

options.label: Longarm Tribe
options.description: Humanoids with two elbows per arm. From Kenzan island.

options.label: Longleg Tribe
options.description: Humanoids with extremely long legs; rivals of Longarm Tribe.

options.label: Snakeneck Tribe
options.description: Rare humanoids with long, snake-like necks.

options.label: Buccaneer Race
options.description: Mysterious race with giant-like strength; oppressed by World Government. Bartholomew Kuma's race.

options.label: Tontatta
options.description: Tiny people from Green Bit; incredible strength and speed; honest and loyal.

options.label: Fairies
options.description: Dressrosan name for invisible-thieving Tontatta. Not a separate race.

options.label: Automata
options.description: Sentient beings made from objects/animals with human souls embedded.

options.label: Pacifistas
options.description: Genetically modified clones with cyborg parts and Lunarian DNA. By Vegapunk.

options.label: Toy
options.description: Transformed into a wooden toy by the Hobby-Hobby Fruit; everyone forgot you exist.

options.label: Demons
options.description: Transformed into a demon by Imu; immortal, monstrous strength, but soul/free-will lost.

options.label: Three-Eye Tribe
options.description: Rare race with a third eye granting heightened perception.

options.label: Dosundada
options.description: Hybrid of humans and Tontatta dwarves.

options.label: Zushindodo
options.description: Extremely rare hybrid of giants and dwarves.

options.label: None
options.description: No special abilities or combat training. Ordinary humans relying on strength, speed, and cleverness.

options.label: Tailor
options.description: Uses clothing and thread for offense and defense; disguises, armor, thread traps.

options.label: Doctor
options.description: Healing, antidotes, performance-enhancing medicine.

options.label: Navigator
options.description: Ocean travel, weather prediction, map-making, ship combat.

options.label: Covenant Contract
options.description: Supernatural agreement signed with Imu. Grants immortality, Abyss teleport circle, immense strength; in exchange, free will is lost.

options.label: Galaxy Impact
options.description: Cosmic warriors harnessing star/celestial energy for explosive area attacks.

options.label: Voice of All Things
options.description: Hears voices of animals, nature, and ancient relics; senses danger; uncovers hidden truths.

options.label: Armament Haki
options.description: Spiritual energy armoring body/weapon; can hit Devil Fruit users.

options.label: Soul Damage Haki
options.description: Rare advanced Haki that damages souls, bypassing physical defenses.

options.label: Shipwright
options.description: Repairs/builds ships mid-battle and develops ship-based weapons.

options.label: Lily Carnation
options.description: Symbiotic bond with the Lily Carnation plant; manipulates life forces, reanimates dead.

options.label: Supreme King Haki
options.description: Conqueror's Haki: pure willpower that intimidates and subdues weak-minded foes.

options.label: Life Return
options.description: Conscious control over body — muscles, bones, recovery, acrobatics.

options.label: Honestly Impact
options.description: Fighting style of hard, accurate punches that break guards and stop multiple attackers.

options.label: Art of Weather
options.description: Master of sky, sea, and storms via specialized weather staff (Clima-Tact recommended).

options.label: Colors Trap
options.description: Painter who manipulates emotions through colored symbols.

options.label: Weapon Master
options.description: Multiple weapons (axes, chains, fans) with expert precision.

options.label: Dragon Claw Fist
options.description: Hands become dragon claws; Armament-empowered; shatters steel.

options.label: Eight Impacts Fist
options.description: Body-vibration shockwaves bypass defenses; unblockable strikes.

options.label: Black Leg Style
options.description: Heated leg strikes; flaming kicks, acrobatic combat.

options.label: Fish Man Jujutsu
options.description: Close-fighting throws/locks; water-enhanced grappling.

options.label: Foxfire Style
options.description: Sword that generates and controls fire; cuts and burns.

options.label: Six Powers
options.description: Rokushiki: Iron Body, Moon Walk, Tempest Kick, etc. Superhuman speed and strength.

options.label: Okama Kenpo
options.description: Dance-like flashy kicks; flexibility and surprise attacks.

options.label: Hypnotist
options.description: Mental manipulation through gestures, voice, and cues.

options.label: Awakened Devil Fruit
options.description: Mastered Devil Fruit affecting environment/body extraordinarily.

options.label: Archaeologist
options.description: Master of Poneglyphs and lost lore; uncovers ancient weapons.

options.label: Observation Haki
options.description: Senses presence, intent, danger before it happens.

options.label: Full Haki User
options.description: Mastery of Observation, Armament, and Conqueror's Haki.

options.label: Gunslinger
options.description: Long-range; firearms, trick shots, explosives.

options.label: Swordsman
options.description: Advanced sword techniques: flying slashes, elemental swordplay.

options.label: Beast Tamer
options.description: Commands sea beasts, land animals, mythical Zoans.

options.label: Cyborg
options.description: Tech inventor; modifies own body, builds weapons.

options.label: Brawler
options.description: Brute force, grapples, wrestling moves.

options.label: Martial Artist
options.description: Hand-to-hand styles: Fish-Man Karate, Black Leg, Rokushiki.

options.label: Spear Fighter
options.description: Polearm techniques; long-melee, spinning crowd control.

options.label: Sniper
options.description: Long-range marksman; rifles, pistols, slingshots.

options.label: Tactician
options.description: Commands allies, predicts enemy moves.

options.label: Poneglyphs Reader
options.description: Scholar who deciphers indestructible Poneglyph stones.

options.label: Treasure Hunter
options.description: Finds loot, deciphers maps, avoids traps.

options.label: Gadgeteer
options.description: Smoke bombs, traps, mechanical combat tools.

options.label: Blacksmith
options.description: Crafts weapons/armor from Grand Line materials.

options.label: Professional Cook
options.description: Master chef whose meals heal/boost allies; combat-ready.

options.label: Musician
options.description: Rhythm-based buffs/debuffs; supports allies, confuses enemies.

options.label: Will of D.
options.description: Carrier of the D. legacy: unyielding spirit, fearless courage, fated for change.

options.label: Dawn Island
options.description: Dawn Island is a peaceful island in the East Blue, known for its green hills, forests, and rivers. Foosha Village sits at its heart, where friendly villagers live close to the sea. The island looks calm, but old ruins and signs of past battles hint at a history full of adventures. Its cliffs and fields make it a beautiful place for travelers seeking peace or new journeys.

options.label: Shells Town
options.description: Shells Town is a small coastal town in the East Blue, known for its cannon-topped towers and industrial feel. It is controlled by the Marine 153rd Branch, making it a strict and heavily guarded area. Despite its calm appearance, the town has a history of conflict and is marked by past battles that shaped its streets.

options.label: Shimotsuki Village
options.description: Shimotsuki Village is a peaceful village in the East Blue, surrounded by green hills and mountains. Its culture is inspired by Wano, with rice farming and traditional customs. The village is known for its swordsmanship, taught at the local Isshin Dojo, where residents keep their skills alive.

options.label: Orange Town
options.description: Orange Town is a small coastal town in the East Blue, known for its cobblestone streets and colonial-style buildings. It has a bustling marketplace and a few notable shops, including a Pet Food Shop guarded by a loyal dog. The town has a lively, colorful atmosphere but has also faced trouble from pirate activity in the past.

options.label: Syrup Village
options.description: Syrup Village is a peaceful settlement located on the Gecko Islands. The village is nestled amid rolling grasslands, dirt trails, hills, and forests. Its residents live in modest homes, with the exception of Kaya's grand mansion situated atop a hill. The village is accessible via two slopes leading from the island's shoreline, as the rest of the coastline is marked by steep, impassable cliffs.

options.label: Baratie
options.description: Baratie is a floating restaurant in the East Blue, shaped like a giant fish. It has multiple decks for dining and cooking, and stabilizing fins keep it steady in rough seas. The restaurant is accessible by small boats and is known for its lively atmosphere and skilled chefs.

options.label: Arlong Park
options.description:
Arlong Park is a strong fortress with tall walls shaped like sharks. Inside are barracks, a main hall with Arlong’s symbol, and training areas for his crew. The docks let the pirates make fast attacks along the coast. The air feels tense and scary, showing the power and control of Arlong and his crew.

- Humans aren’t allowed inside of arlong park
- The Arlong Pirates will attack any human who enters.
- If you’re part of the Straw Hats faction, you won’t be allowed inside and will be attacked by any Fishman living in Arlong Park, as you are considered an enemy.

options.label: Cocoyasi Village
options.description: Cocoyasi Village is a peaceful tropical village in the East Blue, surrounded by palm trees, mikan groves, and rice fields. It has a small dock for ships and simple homes. The village is known for its quiet charm and scenic views of the ocean.

options.label: Loguetown
options.description: Loguetown is a bustling port city located on the Polestar Islands in the East Blue. It serves as a vital stop for ships before entering the Grand Line. The city is renowned as the birthplace and execution site of the former Pirate King, Gol D. Roger, earning it the nickname "the town of the beginning and the end.".

options.label: Reverse Mountain
options.description: Reverse Mountain is a massive peak where the four Blues meet, forming one of the main entrances to the Grand Line. Rivers from each Blue flow up the mountain, meet at the top, and then descend into the Grand Line. Its base, called Twin Cape, marks the start of the Grand Line.

options.label: Kuraigana Island
options.description: A dark and gloomy island in the Grand Line, once home to the fallen Shikkearu Kingdom. It is renowned for its ominous atmosphere and as the dwelling place of a legendary swordsman.

options.label: Mock Town
options.description: The main town on Jaya, Mock Town is filled with infamous pirates who frequently brawl with each other.

options.label: Whisky Peak
options.description: Whisky Peak is a deceptive town situated on Cactus Island in the Grand Line. The town appears welcoming to pirates, offering celebrations and hospitality. However, its residents are all bounty hunters affiliated with Baroque Works, luring pirates into a trap to capture them.

options.label: Little Garden
options.description: Little Garden is a prehistoric island in the Grand Line, home to dinosaurs and massive plant life. The island features two giant skulls of Sea Kings as mountains, dense jungles, and active volcanoes. The island's unique environment makes it a dangerous yet fascinating destination.

options.label: Drum Island
options.description: Drum Island is a snowy, mountainous island in the Grand Line with a harsh winter climate. It was once ruled by a tyrant but now has peaceful leadership. The island is known for its skilled doctors and unique medical knowledge. After its leadership changed, it was renamed the Sakura Kingdom, reflecting its new era of peace.

options.label: Alabasta
options.description: Alabasta is a vast desert kingdom in the Grand Line, known for its scorching sands and ancient ruins. The kingdom is divided by the Sandora River and features diverse regions, from bustling cities to remote villages. Despite its arid climate, Alabasta boasts a rich history and a strong sense of national pride. It was once embroiled in a civil conflict, but the kingdom has since sought peace and stability.

options.label: Jaya
options.description: Jaya is a lawless island in Paradise, popular with pirates. It has tropical forests, giant insects, and elusive South Birds. The main town, Mock Town, is known for its rough pirate-filled atmosphere. The island is famous for its mysterious history and connection to Skypiea.

options.label: Skypiea
options.description: Skypiea is a floating island high above the Blue Planet, reached via the Knock-Up Stream. It has a tropical climate, with clouds forming much of its land. The island includes Angel Island and Upper Yard, with forests, ancient ruins, and unique resources called dials. Skypiea is home to winged humanoids and holds a long history of conflicts and mysteries.

options.label: Long Ring Long Land
options.description: Long Ring Long Land is an unusual archipelago in the Grand Line, made of ten long islands connected by a path during low tide. It is home to nomadic tribes and features animals with exaggerated sizes, like tall horses and long-legged bears. Its strange geography and inhabitants make it a unique and fascinating place.

options.label: Water 7
options.description: Water 7 is a city in the Grand Line, famous for its skilled shipwrights and complex canal system. Built on a series of islands connected by waterways, it resembles a floating Venice. The city is home to the prestigious Galley-La Company and faces challenges like sinking islands and political tensions.

options.label: Enies Lobby
options.description:
Enies Lobby is a judicial island of the World Government, located above a massive waterfall. It has key structures like the Courthouse, Tower of Justice, and Gates of Justice connecting to other government facilities. The island is a symbol of law and order but operates with secrecy and strict control.

Territory: World Government

options.label: Tequila Wolf
options.description:
Tequila Wolf is a massive stone bridge in the East Blue, under construction for over 700 years. It was built by slaves, including criminals and people from countries refusing to ally with the World Government. The bridge connects several islands, and workers endure harsh conditions with little rest, making it a dangerous and oppressive place.

Territory: World Government

options.label: Thriller Bark
options.description: Thriller Bark is the world’s largest ship, originally an island from the West Blue, converted into a pirate ship. It sailed to the Florian Triangle, hiding in thick fog for years.

options.label: Sabaody Archipelago
options.description: Sabaody Archipelago is a group of 79 islands near the Red Line, known for its mangrove trees. It is controlled by the World Government, with the Celestial Dragons ensuring strict law enforcement. Pirates are not allowed due to heavy surveillance and security.

options.label: Amazon Lily
options.description: Amazon Lily is a jungle island in the Calm Belt, home to the all-female Kuja tribe. The island is protected by the Kuja Pirates and surrounded by Sea Kings, which keeps outsiders away. Men are strictly forbidden, making the island isolated and safe. Its lush forests, hidden villages, and warrior culture make it a mysterious and powerful place in the Calm Belt.

options.label: Impel Down
options.description:
Impel Down is a massive underwater prison in the Calm Belt, owned by the World Government. It holds the most dangerous pirates they capture, divided into multiple levels based on threat. The prison is heavily guarded and surrounded by Sea Kings, making escape nearly impossible. Only authorized individuals may enter, while pirates who haven't been capture are strictly banned.

Territory: World Government

options.label: Marineford
options.description:
Marineford is a crescent-shaped island in the Grand Line, serving as the headquarters of the Marines. The island is heavily fortified with steel walls, cannons, and a protected bay. At its center stands the large Marine Headquarters building, and the surrounding Marineford Town houses the families of Marine soldiers. Its defenses and strategic location make it a powerful stronghold of the World Government.

Territory: World Government

options.label: Baltigo
options.description: Baltigo, known as the Island of White Soil, was a remote island in the Grand Line, characterized by its white terrain and towering rock pillars. It served as the secret headquarters of the Revolutionary Army for many years, remaining hidden from the World Government.

options.label: Flevance
options.description: Known as the White City, Flevance was a prosperous land rich in Amber Lead, a valuable white ore. The mineral’s toxicity caused a deadly disease that led to the city’s destruction, with only a few survivors escaping the tragedy.

options.label: Germa Kingdom
options.description: Germa is the world's only seafaring kingdom, formerly part of the World Government. It was once the center of the Germa Empire, formed by the Vinsmoke family's conquest of the North Blue.

options.label: Mary Geoise
options.description:
The sacred capital of the World Government perched high above the Red Line. Home to the enigmatic Gorosei and the Celestial Dragons, it’s a place of immense power and secrecy. Lavish palaces contrast with ruthless politics, where decisions shape the fate of the world.

World Lore: You begin in Mary Geoise (Marijoa), the Holy Land atop the Red Line. The Celestial Dragons rule here, flaunting unmatched wealth and authority.  
Marie Geoise is cloaked in opulence: grand white terraces, divine statues, and an imposing palace. Commoners and slaves are hidden below, out of sight.  
The World Government is headquartered here; the Gorosei convene daily in secret chambers.  
Straw Hat Pirates and most pirates are banned—adventure-seekers are not welcome.  
The divine sentence system is active: “Forbidden crimes” result in public execution.

options.label: New Marineford
options.description: The rebuilt stronghold of the Marines after the original Marineford’s destruction. A bustling military base and hub of justice, where Admirals and soldiers prepare to keep the world safe. Its towering walls and advanced defenses make it a symbol of authority and order.

options.label: God Valley
options.description: A once-forgotten island where pirates and the World Government clashed in an epic battle. Now mostly lost to time, its history remains shrouded in mystery and whispers of legendary figures who walked its lands. A ghostly reminder of the world’s turbulent past.

options.label: Sorbet Kingdom
options.description: A small but prosperous kingdom famous for its sweet delicacies and fruit cultivation. Sorbet Kingdom is a peaceful land with strong ties to the culinary world and trade routes.

options.label: Shandora
options.description: An ancient city that resided on Jaya but was later blasted up to Upper Yard by the Knock Up Stream, Known as the City of Gold.

options.label: Fish-Man Island
options.description:
Fish-Man Island is an underwater island beneath the Red Line, home to fish-men and merfolk. The island has several districts, including the Fish-Man District, and is illuminated by the Sunlight Tree Eve. It has a rich culture, including Fish-Man Karate, and has faced invasions and internal conflicts while remaining an important location.
Territory: Ryugu Kingdom

options.label: Punk Hazard
options.description:
Punk Hazard is a forbidden island divided into two extreme climates: one half scorched in unending flames, the other frozen solid. Once a World Government research facility, it became the site of twisted experiments on humans, animals, and artificial weapons. The island is still scarred by its violent past, filled with toxic gas, mutated creatures, and abandoned labs. It serves as a reminder of the Government’s darker pursuits and the dangers of unchecked science.

Territory: World Government

options.label: Dressrosa
options.description:
Dressrosa is a vibrant island known for its toy-making industry and gladiatorial games. Beneath its festive exterior lies a dark secret, with citizens turned into living toys and a corrupt ruler manipulating events from the shadows. The island's rich culture and hidden truths create a complex and intriguing setting.

Territory: The Donquixote family

options.label: Zou
options.description:
Zou is a massive island located on the back of a giant elephant, Zunesha. It is home to the Mink Tribe, known for their longevity and strength. The island's unique geography and the mystical presence of Zunesha make it a fascinating and sacred place.

Territory: Mink Tribe

options.label: Momoiro Island
options.description:
Momoiro Island, known as Peachy Island, is covered in pink plants and creatures, creating a surreal landscape. It is home to the Kamabakka Kingdom, a community proud of its identity and strength. After Baltigo’s fall, the Revolutionary Army made it their new base, with the island serving as both a sanctuary and a stronghold.

Territory: Revolutionary Army

options.label: Whole Cake Island
options.description:
Whole Cake Island is one of the islands in Totto Land, ruled by the Yonko Big Mom. It is a whimsical place where everything is made of sweets, but beneath its sugary surface lies a kingdom built on fear and control. The island's enchanting appearance contrasts sharply with its oppressive regime.

Territory owned by Charlotte Family

options.label: Wano
options.description: Wano is a secluded, samurai-led nation with a rich history and strict isolationist policies. Its unique culture and traditions are deeply rooted in its people, and the island's mountainous terrain and powerful shogunate make it a formidable force in the world.

options.label: Onigashima
options.description:
Onigashima is a remote island located within Wano, serving as the stronghold of the Beasts Pirates. It is characterized by its ominous appearance, dominated by a giant skull-shaped mountain. The island's strategic location and formidable defenses make it a significant base.

Territory owned by Beast Pirates who Captain is Kaidou which is also nickname Kaidou of the Beasts

options.label: Egghead Island
options.description:
Egghead Island is a futuristic research facility located in the New World. It is known for its advanced technology and is home to Dr. Vegapunk, the leading scientist of the World Government. The island's cutting-edge innovations and scientific endeavors make it a hub of technological progress.

Territory owned by World Government but also owned by Dr.Vegapunk

options.label: Elbaf
options.description:
Elbaf is a legendary island inhabited by giants, known for their warrior culture and rich history. The island's towering structures and ancient traditions reflect the strength and pride of its people. Elbaf's significance in the world's history adds to its mystique.

Territory by Giants

options.label: Lodestar Island
options.description: Lodestar Island is a mysterious location in the Grand Line, known for its unique magnetic field that disrupts compasses. It is a crucial point for navigators, serving as a guidepost for those seeking to reach the final island of the Grand Line.

options.label: Laugh Tale
options.description: Laugh Tale is the legendary final island of the Grand Line, shrouded in mystery. It is said to hold the greatest treasure in the world, the One Piece. The island's elusive nature and the secrets it holds make it the ultimate goal for pirates seeking to claim the title of Pirate King.

options.label: East Blue
options.description: The easternmost of the four Blues, known as the weakest sea dangerous pirates here are considered low-tier elsewhere.

options.label: West Blue
options.description: The western ocean is less explored but feared for its strong underworld presence and infamous crime families. The seas are rough, kingdoms are often at war, and hidden powers lurk beneath the surface.

options.label: North Blue
options.description: A northern sea of cold waters and disciplined kingdoms. Known for its strict governments, advanced military forces, and long history of maritime power. Order dominates here, but corruption and ambition hide beneath the surface.

options.label: South Blue
options.description: The southern sea is warm, lively, and filled with diverse cultures. It thrives on trade, yet is constantly shaken by wars and rebellions. Freedom and chaos rule these waters, making them a place of both opportunity and danger.

options.label: The Grand Line
options.description: A dangerous strip of ocean that wraps around the globe, known for its unpredictable weather and bizarre islands. It's the true sea of adventure, where the will and strength of any sailor are put to the ultimate test.

options.label: New World
options.description: The second half of the Grand Line, notorious as the deadliest ocean in existence. It’s a place of raging storms, colossal sea beasts, and constant battles for dominance. Only the strongest navigate these waters—and the rewards are legendary.

options.label: G-5 Base
options.description: A battered Marine outpost in the New World, G-5 is ruled by chaos and brutality. Its walls are cracked, its halls stained by battles and betrayals, yet its Marines remain fiercely loyal to each other. Reckless and feared, they enforce their own savage brand of justice in seas where order rarely lasts.

options.label: Winner Island
options.description: A desolate battlefield of jagged cliffs and violent winds, Winner Island carries the scars of countless clashes. The land is barren, the air heavy with the echoes of betrayal, and its rocky shores stained with blood. Crews come here to test their might, but only the ruthless ever leave as victors.

options.label: Navarone Island
options.description: A natural stronghold of cliffs and mist, Navarone Island rises from the seas like a fortress of stone. Its jagged coast makes landing nearly impossible, and hidden channels cut deep into its walls. Sailors whisper of strange echoes in the cliffs, as if the island itself watches intruders.

options.label: G-8 Base
options.description: G-8 Base is a Marine stronghold famed for its discipline and vigilance. Towers crown the cliffs, prisons run deep underground, and warships patrol the hidden harbor. Every soldier moves with purpose under Vice Admiral Jonathan’s command, making the base as sharp and unbreakable as the hedgehog nickname it carries. Pirates who stumble here rarely escape.

options.label: Omatsuri Island
options.description: Omatsuri Island is a deceptive resort island that lures pirates with promises of relaxation. In reality, it serves as a trap orchestrated by Baron Omatsuri and his man-eating plant, the Lily Carnation. The island's inhabitants are creations of the plant, and the so called resort activities are designed to feed it.

options.label: Elegia
options.description: Elegia is a lively island called the Island of Music where music and shows are very important. The buildings and streets are made to make music sound better, with lots of stages for performances.  One day, all the people of Elegia randomly disappeared without a trace, leaving the island quiet even though it was full of music before.

options.label: Weatheria
options.description: Weatheria is an artificial sky island inhabited by researchers specializing in meteorology. The island's technology includes devices like the Wind Knot and Weather Ball, which allow for the manipulation and study of weather patterns.

options.label: Merveille
options.description: Merveille, called the Hidden Land in the Clouds, is a group of islands floating in the sky in the Grand Line. The islands float because of the Fuwa Fuwa no Mi. Merveille has many different places, like green forests, tall mountains, and old ruins, showing its long and eventful history.

options.label: Ballon Terminal
options.description: Ballon Terminal is a ruined city on a sky island, located above the New World. It is said that Ballon Terminal is suspended in the sky due to the multitude of helium balloons below it. The city is situated 10,000 meters above the Kid Pirates' base, captained by Eustass Kid. The island's unique elevation and structure make it a notable location in the sky.

options.label: Torino Kingdom
options.description: Torino Kingdom, often referred to as the Isle of Treasure, is a small island in the South Blue. At its center stands a massive tree, and the island is inhabited by large birds known as Masukeredomo Goayu Birds. The human inhabitants, known as the Torines, live in harmony with these birds, having been tamed by them over time.

options.label: Minion Island
options.description: Minion Island is a large, snow covered island located in the North Blue, northeast of Swallow Island and east of Rubeck Island. The island's landscape is dominated by several hills, one of which houses a ghost town and a mansion at its peak. The climate is cold and snowy, contributing to the island's desolate atmosphere. Despite its harsh environment, Minion Island's unique features make it a notable location in the North Blue.

options.label: Swallow Island
options.description: Swallow Island is in the North Blue and is easy to spot because of its unique shape. The island and its central mountain look like a swallow bird, with trees covering the mountain to make it look even more like a bird. Most of the land is mountains, which are home to many plants and animals. The swallow-shaped mountain is the main feature and makes the island stand out on maps.

options.label: Gran Tesoro
options.description: Gran Tesoro is a huge ship and the biggest entertainment city in the world. It was ruled by Gild Tesoro, a very rich man who used to be a slave of the World Nobles. He controlled almost 20% of the world’s money and made Gran Tesoro a place full of luxury, gambling, and fun.

options.label: Delta Island
options.description: Delta Island is a large island in the New World, known for hosting big pirate events. It has a central lake, three rivers, and tall cliffs where spectators can watch. Harbors and small towns are built along the coasts. Underground tunnels run beneath the island, used for secret planning, it's where many pirates meets for a huge treasure hunt.

options.label: Firs Island
options.description: Firs Island is a rocky island with a tall, active volcano. It is one of the three Endpoints in the New World, acting like a strong seal to hold back underground magma. There is a Marine base under the volcano with heavy security. If the island is damaged, the volcano could erupt and cause serious destruction.

options.label: Kazanonsen
options.description: Kazanonsen is a busy town built near a big, active volcano. Hot springs are found all around, and many people visit to relax. The town mixes old-style buildings with newer ones, making it lively and colorful. Even with the volcano nearby, life goes on and the town is popular.

options.label: Piriodo
options.description: Piriodo is a lonely, rocky island with a volcano in the middle. It is the third Endpoint, helping to block and control the underground magma. The land is rough and empty, making it hard to live on. Its isolation adds extra protection to the Endpoints.

options.label: Hachinosu
options.description: Hachinosu is an island known as the Pirate Island in the New World. It has a huge skull-shaped rock in the middle, and the town is built around it. Many pirates live here because there are no laws and no one to stop crime. It used to be the home of the Rocks Pirates, and now it is the base of the Blackbeard Pirates. It is a rough and dangerous place where only the strong survive.

options.label: All Blue
options.description: The All Blue is a legendary sea whispered about by chefs and pirates alike. It is said to be the only place in the world where the waters of the North Blue, South Blue, East Blue and West Blue all meet, and where every kind of fish from every sea can be found.

options.label: Underworld of Elbaf
options.description: Underworld of elbaf is a harsh, bitter‑cold realm at the base of the towering Tree Adam, in the lowest layer of the giant island of elbaf. Sunlight barely reaches the ground, wild beasts roam freely, and exiles or dangerous individuals are sent here as if to their grave

options.label: Moon
options.description: The Moon is a giant, mysterious rock floating high above the Blue Planet. Long ago, it was home to an advanced civilization called the Moon People, who built machines and cities that reached for the stars. Today, the ruins of their cities lie silent, glowing under the moonlight, filled with forgotten treasures and dangerous relics. Few dare to explore it, but those who do may uncover secrets lost to time and perhaps even powers no one on the Blue Planet has ever seen.

options.label: Spider Miles
options.description: Spider Miles is a strange and chaotic town built on piles of scrap, broken machines, and twisting metal streets. The place hums with activity, from blacksmiths forging weapons from leftover metal to shadowy figures hiding in corners, making deals that nobody else dares to witness. Pirates and thieves often come here to find rare parts or recruit skilled fighters, but outsiders must watch every step the streets can be as dangerous as they are full of opportunity.

options.label: Downs
options.description: Downs is a dark, forgotten island covered in massive heaps of garbage and ruined buildings. The air is thick and heavy, carrying the stench of decay, and survival here is a test of skill and cunning. This island was once home to gangs and outlaws, making it a place where only the strong thrive. Those who venture into Downs either come looking for power, treasure, or secrets buried deep within the island’s twisted alleys and mountains of waste.

options.label: Rakesh
options.description: Rakesh is a small port town on the edge of the North Blue, bustling with docks, merchant ships, and shady dealings. It has a rough charm, with narrow streets lined with warehouses, taverns, and hidden back-alleys. Pirates often stop here to trade, recruit crew members, or lay low from the World Government. Though small, Rakesh is full of stories, secret plots, and hidden dangers waiting for those bold enough to explore it.

options.label: Sphinx Island
options.description: Sphinx Island is located in the New World, a remote and rugged territory far from the World Government’s tighter control. The land is rocky and mountainous, with narrow valleys and small villages scattered among the cliffs. The people who live there are poor and humble; the island was once abandoned by the World Government because its residents couldn’t pay the Heavenly Tribute.

options.label: Spa Island
options.description: Spa Island is located on a floating resort that travels across the Grand Line. The entire structure is built for relaxation, filled with warm baths, sparkling pools, luxury rooms, and colorful attractions. Visitors come to rest and unwind, but beneath the cheerful atmosphere lies quiet secrets and mysterious guests who use the island as a safe place to hide, scheme, or make secret deals far away from Marine eyes.

options.label: Gray Terminal
options.description: Gray Terminal is located on the edge of the Goa Kingdom on Dawn Island. It is a huge wasteland filled with broken ships, piles of metal, and endless mountains of trash. Smoke floats through the air while scavengers dig for anything valuable to survive. The area is harsh, lawless, and dangerous, but its hidden corners make it a refuge for rebels, runaways, and anyone trying to disappear from the eyes of the world.

options.label: Kano Country
options.description: Kano Country also known as the Country of Flowers, is a proud and historic land in the West Blue, with gentle hills, flowing rivers, wide plains, and small forests hiding secret paths. Wooden houses, stone pathways, and bamboo groves give the country an ancient, traditional feel. Its people are tough, loyal, and honor-bound, with famous families like the Chinjao Family shaping its history.

options.label: Calm Belts
options.description: The Calm Belt is a strange and deadly sea zone that stretches along the north and south edges of the Grand Line. The waters and skies are eerily still no wind blows, no currents flow, and no waves rise, making normal ships almost impossible to sail. But the calm hides a deadly secret: massive Sea Kings roam beneath the surface, attacking any ship that enters. The Calm Belt acts as a natural barrier, protecting the Grand Line from ordinary travelers.

options.label: Prodence Kingdom
options.description: A proud kingdom far out in the New World, known for its strong people and proud history. The land has a great palace with a giant statue that watches over the fields and towns, and its people are known for their courage and skill in battle. Citizens speak of a powerful king whose strength became famous across the seas, and the kingdom itself stands as a symbol of pride, honor, and determination in a dangerous part of the world.

options.label: Karakuri Island
options.description: A strange, snowy island in the Grand Line where machines and gadgets fill the towns. People here built strange mechanical creatures and metal structures that seem alive, and their inventions have drawn curious minds and adventurers alike. The

options.label: Lvneel Kingdom
options.description: A quiet, peaceful kingdom in the North Blue, known for rolling green hills, tall pine trees, and wooden homes. In the center stands an old castle that watches over the countryside, and its people live simple lives close to nature.

setup_questions.prompt: Which faction or crew do you belong to?

options.label: Flying Pirates
options.description: A fearsome pirate crew that moves just above the ocean floor, striking at anyone near Fish‑Man Island and making life dangerous for its people. They sail under the shadow of their great ship, thought to be named after the old vessel used for many generations, and they attack without warning from the deep waters.

options.label: Zou Guardians
options.description: A proud group of warriors from the Mink Tribe who protect the hidden island of Zou, which sits on the back of a giant elephant. They watch over their people and land, ready to fight anyone who tries to harm their home. Strong, brave, and loyal, they know every part of the island and will do anything to keep it safe.

options.label: Fake Straw Hat Pirates
options.description: A band of pirates who pretended to be the famous Straw Hat Pirates to steal their reputation and gain recruits and power. They spread word across the seas that they were the real deal and even managed to gather many followers and smaller crews by using the legend of the originals.

options.label: Seven Warlords of the Sea
options.description: The Seven Warlords of the Sea are big name pirates chosen by the World Government to act as powerful, world government-backed hunters of other pirates. Each warlord is granted frozen bounties, official protection, and the freedom to rule their own territory as long as they answer the World Government’s call, and their presence alone can shift the balance of a battlefield. Though they hold an official title, the warlords remain pirates at heart, following their own ambitions, commanding secret armies, and building hidden empires far from the Government’s eyes.

options.label: The Vice Admirals
options.description: Through strong effort, loyalty, and skill, you earned the rank of Vice Admiral in the marines. This rank is just below Admiral, making you one of the most trusted leaders in the Marines. You lead large groups of Marines, take on dangerous missions, and keep order in the seas. Many look up to you, and your choices can decide the outcome of important battles. With more experience, you may one day rise even higher.

options.label: The Admirals
options.description: After many years of hard work, tough missions, and gaining respect from everyone around you, you have finally become an Admiral in the marines. This is one of the highest ranks in the Marines, right under the Fleet Admiral. As an Admiral, your power is known across the world. Pirates fear you, nations watch you, and the Marines trust you to protect the seas and follow your orders. Your actions can change everything, and your voice carries great weight wherever you go.

options.label: Giant Squad
options.description: The Giant Squad is an elite unit of the Marines, made up of massive giants who tower over ordinary soldiers. They act as living battering rams and protectors of critical operations, their sheer strength and size making them nearly unstoppable in battle. Any pirate or hunter who faces the Marines’ Giant Squad must prepare for overwhelming force and relentless power.

options.label: Foxy Pirates
options.description: The Foxy Pirates are a mischievous and cunning crew, notorious for their clever tricks and schemes. Famous for orchestrating the Davy Back Fight, they often outsmart stronger opponents using games and deception rather than brute force. Their unpredictable tactics and flamboyant style make them both feared and ridiculed across the seas.

options.label: Straw Hat Grand Fleet
options.description: The Straw Hat Grand Fleet is a group of seven pirate crews who all pledged to follow Monkey D. Luffy after Dressrosa. They work together to help him and protect his friends. Each crew is different, with its own strengths and style, but together they are very strong.

options.label: Four emperors
options.description: After all those crimes you committed during your years as a pirate, and after facing countless powerful figures with your mighty and most powerful crew, you have finally been recognized and become one of the Four Emperors. Feared across the entire seas as one of the four emperors the marines are very afraid of you, you have also allied with some powerful figures but are closely watched by the world government.

options.label: Beautiful Pirates
options.description: The Beautiful Pirates are a stylish and disciplined crew led by Cavendish. Known for their grace, coordination, and teamwork, they turn battles into displays of elegance and precision. As members of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet, they are loyal, efficient, and surprisingly deadly despite their focus on appearances.

options.label: Shoujou Pirates
options.description: The Shoujou Pirates are energetic and relentless, striking with speed and coordinated attacks. Led by Shoujou, they are adaptable and fearless, able to take on larger crews through persistence and teamwork. Their playful spirit combined with combat efficiency makes them a dangerous and unpredictable force.

options.label: Gyro Pirates
options.description: The Gyro Pirates are a quirky and resourceful crew hailing from the South Blue. Led by the eccentric Gyro, they are known for their unconventional methods and adaptability in various situations.

options.label: Bonney Pirates
options.description: The Bonney Pirates are a formidable crew from the South Blue, led by the fierce Jewelry Bonney. They gained notoriety for their daring exploits and were considered a significant threat before their downfall.

options.label: Caribou Pirates
options.description: The Caribou Pirates are a cunning and opportunistic crew, led by the notorious Caribou. They are known for their deceptive tactics and ability to exploit situations to their advantage, making them unpredictable adversaries.

options.label: Whitebeard Pirates
options.description: The Whitebeard Pirates were a legendary crew celebrated for their strength, loyalty, and unity. Revered as protectors of the seas, they took in allies from all walks of life. Their legacy is one of honor, sacrifice, and the ability to inspire fear and respect across the world.

options.label: Masira Pirates
options.description: The Masira Pirates are a resourceful and resilient crew known for their salvage operations and deep connection to the Saruyama Alliance. Operating near Jaya Island, they specialize in recovering sunken ships, showcasing their ingenuity and teamwork.

options.label: Krieg Pirates
options.description: The Krieg Pirates are infamous for their brutality, tyranny, and greed. Once a massive and feared crew under the tyrannical Captain Don Krieg, they ruled through intimidation and overwhelming numbers. Though many were defeated, the remnants maintain their reputation for ruthlessness, striking fear into anyone who dares challenge them.

options.label: Barto Club
options.description: The Barto Club is a crew known for their theatrical style and daring exploits. They often take on challenges for the thrill and the fame, blending humor and bravado with serious combat ability. Their members value camaraderie and loyalty, making them a close-knit and determined crew.

options.label: Black Cats Pirates
options.description: The Black Cats Pirates are agile, sneaky, and unpredictable. They specialize in fast strikes and hit-and-run tactics, often using their cunning and stealth to gain the upper hand. Their reputation thrives on mischief, trickery, and leaving enemies confused and disorganized.

options.label: Alvida Pirates
options.description: The Alvida Pirates are known for their flashy style and aggressive raids. They are opportunistic and often strike quickly, using speed and cunning to overwhelm smaller crews. Though not as large or famous as other pirate crews, they have earned a reputation for resilience and tenacity.

options.label: Cross Guild
options.description: Cross Guild is a powerful and controversial organization formed from some of the most notorious pirates in the world. They operate both as mercenaries and bounty hunters, using their influence to dominate seas and control territories. Their reputation combines wealth, intimidation, and political maneuvering, making them a formidable faction in the pirate world.

options.label: Golden Lion Pirates
options.description: The Golden Lion Pirates are proud, charismatic, and aggressive. Known for their daring raids and fierce pride, they strike with courage and boldness that few can match. The crew values loyalty above all, and their unity makes them a dangerous force in any confrontation.

options.label: Giant Warrior Pirates
options.description: The Giant Warrior Pirates are a massive and imposing crew, renowned for their incredible size and brute strength. Their members are often towering fighters who overwhelm foes with sheer power and endurance. Despite their size, they are surprisingly coordinated, combining raw strength with clever battlefield tactics.

options.label: Fallen Monk Pirates
options.description: The Fallen Monk Pirates are a disciplined yet fallen crew, once guided by ideals of honor and protection. Over time, they became merciless and opportunistic, using their knowledge and strength to exploit weaker crews. They are known for their surprising tactical awareness and the ability to turn even hopeless battles into victories.

options.label: Gecko Pirates
options.description: The Gecko Pirates are a crew that revels in fear and domination. Their mere presence can unsettle opponents, as they are infamous for their ruthless tactics and the eerie aura they project. They carve their name into the world through intimidation and the relentless pursuit of power, leaving chaos in their wake.

options.label: Drake Pirates
options.description: The Drake Pirates are a disciplined and secretive crew, operating under the guise of piracy while serving a covert mission. Led by X Drake, a former Marine Rear Admiral, the crew's true objectives are shrouded in mystery. Their reputation is built on precision, intelligence, and the ability to strike quickly when least expected.

options.label: Nox Pirates
options.description: The Nox Pirates are a brave and honorable crew composed of skilled Mink Tribe warriors. They are renowned for their courage and dedication to their mission, often risking everything to protect their people or uncover secrets of the world. Though small, their unity and resilience make them formidable opponents.

options.label: Hawkins Pirates
options.description: The Hawkins Pirates are a mysterious and calculating crew, feared for their eerie composure and unshakable loyalty. They manipulate fate and use careful strategy to control the battlefield. Known for their stoicism and eerie aura, this crew is difficult to predict and even harder to defeat.

options.label: On Air Pirates
options.description: The On Air Pirates are a chaotic and unpredictable crew that strikes with the power of sound and rhythm. They rely on deception, coordination, and their musical combat style to overwhelm opponents. Their reputation is built on creativity and the fear they instill in those who cannot anticipate their next move, making them both formidable and eccentric.

options.label: God's Knights
options.description: The God’s Knights, also known as the Holy Knights, are an elite group of warriors serving the World Government. They operate in the Holy Land of Mary Geoise and are tasked with enforcing the laws, even among the Celestial Dragons. They hold authority over World Nobles and have the power to execute them if necessary. The Knights are known for their immense strength, combat skills, and immortality, making them formidable enforcers of the World Government’s will.

options.label: New Fish-Man Pirates
options.description: The New Fish-Man Pirates are a crew of Fish-Men led by Hody Jones. They are known for their hatred of humans and their goal to take over Fish-Man Island. They are strong, aggressive, and work together to achieve their ambitions.

options.label: Thriller Bark Victim's Association
options.description: The Thriller Bark Victim's Association is a group formed by the people affected by the Thriller Bark Pirates. They aim to support and protect victims of the crew, sharing information and helping each other recover from attacks.

options.label: WCI 31
options.description: The WCI 31 is a group of renowned head chefs working in Whole Cake Island's kitchens. They are known for their exceptional culinary skills and are trusted to oversee various kitchens, each led by a head chef. Under the guidance of Streusen, the head chef of Whole Cake Island, they are responsible for preparing elaborate dishes.

options.label: NEO MADS
options.description: NEO MADS is a scientific organization founded by Vinsmoke Judge and Caesar Clown, serving as a successor to their previous group, MADS. They aim to surpass Dr. Vegapunk in scientific achievements, utilizing resources like Germa 66's army.

options.label: Nine Red Scabbards
options.description: The Nine Red Scabbards are a group of loyal samurai who serve the Kozuki family. They are known for their bravery, skill, and dedication to protecting their lord and restoring the honor of Wano. They are respected and feared for their combat abilities and unwavering loyalty.

options.label: WE News
options.description: WE News is a major newspaper that reports on pirates, governments, and global events. It reaches most seas with the help of News Coo, and despite attempts by the World Government to influence it, the paper remains highly influential.

options.label: Roshio Pirates
options.description: Led by the pirate captain Roshio, whose crew's jolly roger features a red circle with the black silhouette of a hanged man. They are known for their macabre symbol and have a bounty of 42,000,000.

options.label: Space Pirates
options.description: The Space Pirates are a group of fox-like aliens from the moon. They are moon miners who excavate valuable resources and are known for their cunning and teamwork. They are led by a strong captain and operate in the skies above the moon.

options.label: Big Helmet Pirates
options.description: The Big Helmet Pirates are a strong and loyal crew known for their teamwork and fighting skills. They sail the seas seeking adventure and challenges, always sticking together to protect their captain and crew.

options.label: Five Elders
options.description: You have successfully become a member of the Five Elders, the highest-ranking officials in the World Government who oversee global policy and decisions. Feared and respected across the world, you now stand among those who shape history from the shadows. With absolute authority over the Marines, Cipher Pol, and even the Celestial Dragons, your words can spark wars or silence nations.

options.label: Celestial Dragons
options.description: The Celestial Dragons are the noble and wealthy rulers of the World Government. They live in luxury and are treated as untouchable, often abusing their power over others. Feared and hated by many, they enforce their will through the Marines and influence world politics.

options.label: Seraphim
options.description: The Seraphim are advanced weapons created by Vegapunk, based on the strongest pirates of the past. They are powerful, humanoid cyborgs used by the World Government to maintain control and fight dangerous opponents. Each one has unique abilities that make them highly dangerous in battle.

options.label: Pacifista Program
options.description: The Pacifista Program is a project by Vegapunk that creates powerful human-like weapons. These cyborgs are used by the Marines to fight pirates and enforce the World Government’s rules. They are strong, fast, and equipped with advanced technology and weapons.

options.label: Vegapunk's Creations
options.description: Vegapunk’s Creations are advanced inventions and weapons made by the brilliant scientist Vegapunk. They include robots, artificial Devil Fruits, and other powerful technologies. Many are used by the World Government or Marines, and they are known for their strength and clever designs.

options.label: Kuja Tribe
options.description: The Kuja Tribe is made up entirely of women who are fierce warriors skilled in combat and Haki. They are loyal to their empress and protect their home from outsiders. The tribe is known for its strength, discipline, and unity.

options.label: Tontatta Tribe
options.description: The Tontatta Tribe is a group of small but brave warriors who live in the Green Bit. They are known for their speed, cleverness, and strong sense of loyalty. Despite their size, they are skilled fighters and protect their home from threats.

options.label: Kozuki Retainers
options.description: The Kozuki Retainers are loyal samurai who serve the Kozuki family of Wano. They are brave, skilled fighters dedicated to protecting their lord and restoring Wano’s peace. Their loyalty and honor make them respected and feared by enemies.

options.label: Shandia
options.description: The Shandia are a proud and brave tribe that lives on Skypiea. They are known for their fighting skills, loyalty, and strong connection to their land. They defend their home from invaders and work together to protect their people.

options.label: Five Families of the West
options.description: The Five Families of the West are powerful and influential pirate families that control parts of the West Blue. They are known for their wealth, strong fighters, and influence over local seas. These families work together or compete to protect their power and expand their territories.

options.label: Yakuza of Wano
options.description: The Yakuza of Wano are powerful criminal groups operating across the Wano Country. They control trade, gambling, and other illegal businesses while enforcing their own rules. Loyal to their families and leaders, they are feared by many but respected by those who follow them.

options.label: Germa 66
options.description: Germa 66 is a powerful military organization led by a royal family. They are known for advanced technology, science, and highly trained soldiers. The group fights with precision and strategy, making them a strong force in both war and politics.

options.label: Baroque Works
options.description: Baroque Works is a secret criminal organization that works to gain power and wealth through illegal means. They operate in the shadows, using spies, assassins, and clever plans to achieve their goals. The group is organized in pairs and follows a strict hierarchy, making them a dangerous force in the world of pirates and politics.

options.label: Neo Marines
options.description: The Neo Marines are a private military group that acts independently of the World Government. They take on missions for power, money, or influence and are known for being aggressive and well-armed. Their strength and organization make them a dangerous force on the seas.

options.label: Revolutionary Army
options.description: The Revolutionary Army is a secretive group that fights against the World Government. They work to protect people from tyranny and bring freedom to oppressed nations. They are strong, smart, and organized, and they carry out dangerous missions to achieve their goals.

options.label: Special Science Group
options.description: The Special Science Group is a top-level team of scientists working for the World Government. They create advanced weapons, technology, and experiments to give the Marines and government an advantage. Their inventions are powerful and often shape the balance of power across the seas.

options.label: Cipher Pol
options.description: Cipher Pol is a secret government organization that carries out covert missions. They handle spying, assassination, and intelligence work to protect the World Government and keep control over the seas.

options.label: SWORD
options.description: SWORD is a secret and powerful organization within the Marines that handles special missions. They take on dangerous jobs and protect the world from serious threats, operating in the shadows with skill and precision.

options.label: Donquixote Pirates
options.description: The Donquixote Pirates are a strong and organized crew led by a clever and ruthless captain which is Donquixote Doflamingo. They are known for using strategy and power to control others, and they follow their captain’s orders without question. Their loyalty and skill make them a dangerous force on the seas.

options.label: Saruyama Alliance
options.description: A coalition of explorers and adventurers seeking ancient treasures.

options.label: Straw Hats
options.description: The Straw Hat Pirates are a brave and adventurous crew known for their strong bonds and determination. They sail the seas chasing dreams and protecting each other, always standing up for what they believe is right. Their courage and teamwork make them a well-known and respected crew.

options.label: Buggy's Delivery
options.description: Buggy’s Delivery is a small but clever crew known for taking on jobs and missions for profit. They are not very strong compared to other pirate crews, but they are tricky, resourceful, and loyal to their captain.

options.label: Spade Pirates
options.description: The Spade Pirates were a strong and brave crew known for their loyalty and fighting skills. They sailed the seas seeking adventure and freedom, standing up against powerful enemies when needed. Their captain led them with courage, earning respect from allies and foes alike.

options.label: Roger Pirates
options.description: The Roger Pirates were a legendary crew known for their adventures and discovery of the final island, Laugh Tale. They were brave, strong, and full of daring spirit, inspiring fear and respect across the seas. Their captain led them with wisdom and strength, leaving a lasting legacy in pirate history.

options.label: Rocks Pirates
options.description: The Rocks Pirates were a legendary and feared crew that caused chaos across the seas. They were known for their power, ambition, and willingness to do anything to rule the world. Many strong and dangerous pirates were part of this crew, making them one of the most notorious in history.

options.label: Thriller Bark Pirates
options.description: The Thriller Bark Pirates are a creepy and mysterious crew that uses shadows and strange powers to scare their enemies. They are led by a captain who loves to play tricks and collect strong fighters. Despite their spooky appearance, they are clever and dangerous on the seas.

options.label: Sun Pirates
options.description: The Sun Pirates are a strong crew made up mostly of Fish-Men. They are known for their courage, teamwork, and their fight for freedom. They protect each other and stand up against anyone who threatens them.

options.label: Fire Tank Pirates
options.description: The Fire Tank Pirates are a strong and bold crew that is known for their fearless attacks and fiery fighting style. They are tough and work together well, always ready to take on challenges and protect their crew.

options.label: Kid Pirates
options.description: The Kid Pirates are a bold and aggressive crew known for their strength and fearlessness. They are ambitious and always go after what they want, often taking risks that others would avoid. Their teamwork and determination make them a crew to be reckoned with on the seas.

options.label: Heart Pirates
options.description: The Heart Pirates are a small but strong crew led by a smart and caring captain. They are known for their speed, clever plans, and strong teamwork. They help others and fight for what they believe is right, making them respected across the seas.

options.label: Blackbeard Pirates
options.description: The Blackbeard Pirates are a dangerous and sneaky crew led by a very ambitious captain name Blackbeard. They are known for being unpredictable and doing whatever it takes to get stronger even if it includes betraying someone to achieve a goal, They strike hard and fast, and many fear them across the seas.

options.label: Beasts Pirates
options.description: The Beast Pirates are a terrifying and relentless crew led by a fearsome captain known for his overwhelming power. They rule through strength, intimidation, and loyalty to their leader, often recruiting powerful fighters and Zoan Devil Fruit users to expand their might. The crew is infamous for their brutality and ambition, making them one of the most dangerous forces feared by allies and enemies alike.

options.label: Big Mom Pirates
options.description: The Big Mom Pirates are a massive and ruthless crew that rules with a mix of fear, power, and family loyalty. Led by their unpredictable and terrifying captain, they dominate the seas through sheer strength and an unbreakable sense of kinship among their members. Though their actions can be chaotic and violent, the crew thrives on the bonds of family, making them a dangerous and united force.

options.label: Red-Hair Pirates
options.description: The Red-Hair Pirates are a legendary crew known for their strength, loyalty, and adventurous spirit. They command respect not through fear, but through their bonds and reputation, balancing power with honor. Known for celebrating life with laughter and camaraderie, they can also unleash overwhelming force when threatened, making them one of the most respected crews.

options.label: Neutral/Unaffiliated
options.description: An individual who belongs to no faction, aligning with no cause or ideology. They act on their own terms, free from allegiance, forging their own path!

options.label: Uranus
options.description: A mysterious ancient weapon shrouded in legend, rumored to rival Pluton and Poseidon in influence. Its true power is unknown, and many believe it can alter the tides of history itself.

options.label: Poseidon
options.description: Not a traditional weapon, but you bear the legacy of an Ancient Weapon, granting you a unique connection to Sea Kings. How you use this power will shape your journey across the seas.

options.label: Pluton
options.description: An ancient warship of legendary power, said to possess advanced technology far beyond modern vessels. Its blueprints are coveted across the seas for the strategic advantage they could bring.

options.label: Ragnir
options.description: You wield a giant warhammer brought to life by a Zoan-type Devil Fruit, which can even transform into a giant squirrel. Once a guardian of Elbaph’s national Devil Fruit treasure for centuries, it has chosen you as its rightful wielder. In your hands, it strikes with incredible power, able to smash armor, shake the ground, and overwhelm enemies.

options.label: Yoru
options.description: A legendary black blade of the world, Yoru is a massive nodachi with a broad nose and a jet-black blade that gleams with an ominous sheen. As one of the 12 Supreme Grade swords, it possesses incredible cutting power and durability. Its presence alone commands fear, capable of slicing through thick armor and nearly any material with ease.

options.label: Ame no Habakiri
options.description: Ame no Habakiri is a legendary katana said to have the power to split even the heavens. Its blade represents unmatched strength and mastery, able to cut through almost anything with ease. Wielding this sword marks a fighter as elite, commanding respect and recognition across the world. In battle, Ame no Habakiri allows its user to face even the strongest foes, leaving a lasting legacy with every strike.

options.label: Nidai Kitetsu
options.description: Nidai Kitetsu is the second-generation Kitetsu sword, famous for its sharpness, balance, and reliability in battle. Its purple-edge blade and golden tsuba make it both deadly and elegant. Like all Kitetsu swords, it carries a curse that tests the luck and skill of its wielder. In the hands of a capable fighter, Nidai Kitetsu is a legendary weapon that is still feared for its cutting ability and deadly precision.

options.label: Shodai Kitetsu
options.description: Shodai Kitetsu is a cursed, legendary katana of the highest quality, known for its incredible cutting power and precision. Its flame-shaped hamon and four-lobed guard make it instantly recognizable. While wielded by a skilled swordsman, it can slice through almost anything, but its curse brings danger to anyone not strong enough to control it. Those who take up Shodai Kitetsu gain immense power, but must also face the risk of the sword’s dark fate if they fail to master it.

options.label: Funkfreed
options.description: A sword that has been animated by the Zou Zou no Mi, allowing it to transform into an elephant or a large elephant-sword hybrid. In battle, Funkfreed can stretch its trunk, stomp the ground, or swing its body like a massive metal club. This weapon is both loyal and wild; it chooses when to fight alongside its wielder and when to act on instinct. Warriors who earn its respect gain a partner stronger than most beasts.

options.label: Cerberus Sword
options.description: A brutal blade what was animated by a Mythical Zoan Devil Fruit to take the form of a three headed Dog. The sword’s spine splits into three sharpened fangs near the guard, giving every swing a ripping, tearing effect. When the user channels their fighting spirit into it, the heads roar with a burst of energy, creating shockwaves that feel like a monster lunging forward. This weapon is feared because every strike feels like being attacked by multiple blades at once.

options.label: Sorcery Clima‑Tact
options.description: Sorcery Clima‑Tact A further evolution of the weather‑staff that combines Weatheria technology with compact design and immense versatility. It can extend and contract at will, form varied weather phenomena, and even perform utility tasks beyond combat. This version transforms the staff into a true magic‑wand of climate manipulation.

options.label: Perfect Clima‑Tact
options.description: Perfect Clima‑Tact This upgraded weather‑staff was forged from the original Clima‑Tact with advanced Dial‑technology and refined design, making it far more powerful and precise. It allows the wielder to call forth heat, cold, electricity and storms with greater destructive force and control than before.

options.label: Nakiri Swords
options.description: Nakiri Swords are twin blades crafted for fast, coordinated strikes. Their design allows seamless combos and precise attacks in close combat. The swords' balanced construction ensures fluid movements, enabling the user to execute rapid sequences of strikes with accuracy and efficiency.

options.label: Raiu
options.description: Raiu is a sword named thunderstrike, built to deliver swift and powerful attacks. Its design emphasizes speed and impact, making it good for aggressive combat. The sword's construction allows for rapid strikes that can overwhelm opponents, reflecting the force and unpredictability of a thunderstorm.

options.label: Shirauo
options.description: Shirauo is a sleek, narrow sword designed for quick, fluid strikes. Its streamlined form allows for precision attacks and nimble handling. The sword's design emphasizes speed and agility, enabling the user to execute rapid maneuvers and outpace opponents in combat.

options.label: Shusui
options.description: Shusui is a legendary black blade classified as one of the 21 Great Grade swords. Renowned for its durability and cutting power, it is a symbol of tradition and mastery in swordsmanship. The sword's dark hue and craftsmanship make it a prized possession, reflecting the rich history and skill of its creators.

options.label: Soto Muso
options.description: Soto Muso is a large, simple sword consisting only of a blade, hilt, and scabbard, with no handguard. The hilt features dark diamond patterns, emphasizing practicality over ornamentation. Its minimalist design allows for unhindered movement and swift strikes, focusing on the user's skill and precision rather than the weapon's adornments.

options.label: Terry Sword
options.description: Terry Sword is a uniquely designed sword that combines strength and tradition. Its construction allows for powerful strikes while maintaining balance and agility. The sword's design reflects a blend of durability and elegance, making it suitable for both offensive and defensive maneuvers in combat.

options.label: Kogatana
options.description: Kogatana is a small, cross-shaped knife pendant worn as a necklace. Despite its compact size, it serves as a functional weapon, allowing for quick strikes in close-quarters combat. The knife's design emphasizes portability and concealability, enabling the user to carry it discreetly while maintaining readiness for sudden confrontations.

options.label: Kosho
options.description: Kosho is a finely crafted katana classified as one of the 50 Skillful Grade swords. Designed for swift, precise attacks, it emphasizes balance, cutting power, and reliability in combat. The sword's craftsmanship ensures durability and sharpness, allowing the user to execute rapid strikes with confidence and effectiveness.

options.label: Yakuza Kasen
options.description: Yakuza Kasen is a high-quality shikomizue crafted with good skill. Combining elegance with lethal precision, it features a balanced blade perfect for swift and deadly strikes. The sword's design allows it to function good as both a cane for support and a concealed weapon for combat.

options.label: Bruiser Axe
options.description: The Bruiser Axe is a massive, heavy battle axe renowned for its raw power and devastating impact. Its sheer size and weight make it formidable in combat, capable of delivering crushing blows that can shatter defenses and incapacitate opponents. The axe's design emphasizes brute strength, allowing the user to cleave through obstacles and enemies alike with overwhelming force.

options.label: Kirisame
