options.description: Kirisame is a curved blade shaped like a shark's dorsal fin, optimized for underwater combat. Its design allows for swift, lethal strikes, making it effective in aquatic environments. The blade's unique curvature aids in cutting through water resistance, enabling the user to move and attack with enhanced speed and efficiency beneath the surface.

options.label: Peacock Slashers
options.description: The Peacock Slashers are unique weapons consisting of small, sharp jewels attached to wires. Resembling the eye spots on a peacock's tail feathers, they are designed for precise and rapid attacks. The user loops one end of the wire around a finger and swings the jewel to create a slicing, spinning disk. This allows for swift, graceful strikes that can entangle or cut through opponents with remarkable accuracy.

options.label: Ace Cutlass
options.description: Forged in the fires of a forgotten island and tempered by time, Ace Cutlass is a legendary saber once wielded by the Pirate King himself. Its golden hilt is wrapped in aged, crimson cloth, and its slightly curved blade gleams with a brilliance that seems to hum with power.

options.label: Warabide Sword
options.description: The Warabide Sword is a special longsword with a blade made from straw. It can be extended and shaped in combat, giving it great versatility. Considered a Meito, it is a high-quality blade known for its unique design and adaptability.

options.label: Tsuji Shibai
options.description: Tsuji Shibai looks like a giant ink brush but functions as a katana. It lets the user create drawings and illusions to confuse opponents, while delivering swift and unpredictable strikes. Its creativity and versatility make it deadly in skilled hands.

options.label: Punishers
options.description: Punishers are a pair of gauntlets equipped with curved, sickle-like blades mounted on axles. you can spin them rapidly, creating shockwaves at the speed of sound, causing internal damage to opponents. These weapons are versatile, capable of both offensive and defensive maneuvers.

options.label: Shark guitar
options.description: A shikomizue-style weapon that resembles a shark and serves as both a musical instrument and a weapon. It can be used to perform sound-based attacks and in combat.

options.label: Chakram
options.description: A circular throwing weapon with a sharpened outer edge, used on a string in combination with techniques like hypnosis.

options.label: Cat Claws
options.description: A pair of black-furred gloves equipped with full-length katana blades at the end of each finger. They are used for swift and lethal attacks.

options.label: Hand Axe
options.description: A hand axe, perfectly balanced for close combat, can be an incredibly deadly weapon. When wielded with skill and precision, it has the power to take down even the most formidable opponents

options.label: Morning Star
options.description: A spiked ball on a stick. Heavy and dangerous.

options.label: Spiked Club
options.description: A wooden club with nails. More deadly than plain wood.

options.label: Hook Hand
options.description: A pirate’s metal hook. Works as both weapon and tool.

options.label: Halberd
options.description: A pole with an axe head and spike. Long reach, powerful.

options.label: War Hammer
options.description: A large hammer. Can crush, but very heavy.

options.label: Trident
options.description: A three-pronged spear. Good for stabbing and fishing.

options.label: Dagger
options.description: A small knife. Easy to hide, fast in close fights.

options.label: Sickle
options.description: A curved farm blade. Can slash or hook in close combat.

options.label: Iron Chain
options.description: A chain used for hitting or grabbing. Hard to control.

options.label: Spiked Knuckles
options.description: Metal on fists. Makes punches stronger and painful.

options.label: Short Bow
options.description: A small bow. Not very strong, but good for hunting.

options.label: Crossbow
options.description: A bow with strong shots but slow reload. Good for defense.

options.label: Wooden Club
options.description: A plain piece of wood. Cheap and easy to use.

options.label: Throwing Knives
options.description: Small knives made to throw. Weak, but quick and sneaky.

options.label: Battle Axe
options.description: A big axe. Strong, but slow and heavy.

options.label: Machete
options.description: A heavy blade. Cuts through plants and enemies alike.

options.label: Pitchfork
options.description: A farm tool used like a spear. Clumsy, but works in a fight.

options.label: Iron Spear
options.description: A long weapon with a sharp tip. Good for keeping distance.

options.label: Wooden Staff
options.description: A long stick. Simple, light, and good for defense.

options.label: Rapier
options.description: A thin sword used for stabbing. Fast, but not very strong.

options.label: Cutlass
options.description: A short pirate sword. Easy to swing on ships, good for quick fights.

options.label: Germa 66 Raid Canister
options.description: A specialized high-tech device used by the Germa 66 military force, these canisters are equipped with offensive and defensive weaponry. They can deploy traps, emit energy blasts, or release smoke screens to disorient opponents. Designed for versatility and tactical advantage, the Raid Canisters enhance Germa 66’s combat efficiency.

options.label: Hiru
options.description: A uniquely designed sword with a curved blade optimized for swift cutting and close-quarters combat. The Hiru sword’s balanced build allows the user to deliver quick, fluid attacks, making it a favorite among agile swordsmen.

options.label: Shigure
options.description: Known as the “Rain Cutter,” Shigure is a finely crafted katana reputed for its elegance and sharpness. Its blade is said to glide through the air like a gentle rain, allowing for swift and precise strikes. It is treasured by those who combine artful technique with deadly efficiency.

options.label: Kikoku
options.description: An imposing nodachi sword characterized by its exceptional length and weight. Kikoku’s heavy blade is capable of delivering devastating slashes, often used to intimidate and overpower foes. It is wielded with expert skill to maximize reach and cutting power.

options.label: Kashu
options.description: A large, heavy cleaver-type sword that emphasizes brute strength and overwhelming force over finesse. Kashu’s wide blade can cleave through tough materials and opponents alike, making it a favored weapon for those who fight with raw power.

options.label: Yubashiri
options.description: A lightweight and exceptionally durable sword forged with great craftsmanship. Known for its sleek design and ease of handling, Yubashiri is favored by those who value speed and precision. Though it was lost early in the story, it remains a symbol of skilled swordsmanship.

options.label: Sandai Kitetsu
options.description: The third generation in the cursed Kitetsu sword lineage, Sandai Kitetsu is a sharp, single-edged katana renowned for its deadly edge and cursed nature. Its blade is said to bring misfortune and death to its wielder, yet it is highly sought after by skilled swordsmen for its razor-sharp cutting ability and balance in battle.

options.label: Kiribachi
options.description: A massive, jagged saw-like sword that embodies the brutal and savage fighting style. The Kiribachi’s serrated blade can tear through wood, flesh, and bone with ease, and its heavy weight allows the person to deliver powerful, crushing blows.

options.label: Clima-Tact
options.description: A slender, extendable baton imbued with advanced weather-manipulating technology. this weapon has the ability to summon and control weather phenomena like lightning, wind, and rain in battle. Its lightweight design allows for swift strikes, while its hidden compartments unleash devastating electric and climatic attacks that leave enemies off balance.

options.label: Jitte
options.description: A heavy, large jutte with a thick metal shaft and a hook-like prong near the handle. This weapon is specially designed to counter Devil Fruit users, as the prong contains Seastone, which nullifies Devil Fruit powers on contact.

options.label: Gryphon
options.description: A sleek, red-hilted saber with a slightly curved blade, Gryphon is a remarkable sword known for its unmatched sharpness and strength. The blade can cut through almost anything with ease and is further enhanced by the mastery of Haki.

options.label: Musket Rifles
options.description: Long-barreled firearms designed for longer-range shots. They require time to reload but offer improved accuracy over pistols.

options.label: Flintlock Pistol
options.description: Single-shot pistols that use flint and gunpowder to fire lead bullets. They have slow reload times but are effective at close range.

options.label: Hiraikotsu
options.description: A giant war hammer known for crushing power. Its weight and force make it a weapon of destruction.

options.label: Bisento
options.description: A traditional polearm with a broad curved blade, delivering powerful thrusts and slashes capable of cleaving multiple enemies.

options.label: Chains
options.description: Flexible weapons used to entangle, trip, or strike from a distance. Require skill but offer reach and control.

options.label: Throwing Stars
options.description: Small, throwable blades useful for distraction or injuring foes from a distance.

options.label: Mace
options.description: Blunt weapons designed to deal crushing blows. Often made of wood or metal, effective against armored foes.

options.label: Slingshot
options.description: Simple projectile weapons that can launch stones or small ammo. Usually used for distraction or minor damage.

options.label: Bows and Arrows
options.description: Ranged weapons useful for silent and precise strikes from afar. Limited by ammunition but valuable for sniping.

options.label: Spear
options.description: Long-range melee weapons with pointed tips for thrusting attacks. Basic but effective in keeping enemies at a distance.

options.label: Soul-Based Sword
options.description: A hidden blade within a cane. Combined with soul manipulation, it allows chilling cuts, soundwave-based attacks, and freezing soul energy strikes.

options.label: Rumble Ball Transformation
options.description: Transforms the user’s body into different monstrous or hybrid forms, each with unique combat styles like horns, claws, or brute strength. A form-changing powerhouse.

options.label: Kabuto
options.description: A long-range slingshot-like weapon enhanced with Dials and Pop Greens. Capable of firing exploding plants, projectiles, and unique ammunition with immense precision.

options.label: Enma
options.description: A legendary sword that draws out its wielder’s Haki involuntarily. Requires great control, but offers immense cutting force capable of scarring even the mighty.

options.label: Three-Sword Style
options.description: You wield not one, but three blades one in each hand, and one held firmly in your mouth. This unorthodox style, forged through relentless discipline, blends precision, power, and unpredictability into a whirlwind of steel.

options.label: None
options.description: You decided that you don’t need a weapon relying instead on your skills, instincts, and perhaps Haki or Devil Fruit powers to face any challenge. Ready to prove that sometimes, the greatest strength comes from within.

options.label: Horse-Horse Fruit, Model: Pegasus
options.description: This fruit grants the power to transform into a Pegasus or Pegasus-hybrid, giving the user majestic wings, heightened speed, and flight capability. The transformation lets the user soar above battlefields and strike while airborne with swift power.

options.label: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Nine Tailed Fox
options.description: This Mythical Zoan fruit grants the user the power to transform into a mythical nine-tailed fox or a hybrid form, gaining supernatural agility, enhanced senses, and mystical abilities. The fox’s legendary nature also allows the user to perfectly impersonate others, copying their appearance, including clothing, after touching them.

options.label: Huge-Huge Fruit
options.description: This fruit grants the user the power to dramatically enlarge the user’s body to gargantuan scale. When activated, the user grows to immense proportions, gaining overwhelming strength, reach, and massive physical presence. Their size alone becomes a weapon, crushing enemies, buildings, and terrain.

options.label: Glug-Glug Fruit
options.description: This fruit grants the user the power to create and manipulate alcohol in battle. The user’s body becomes infused with alcohol properties, allowing them to gulp down liquor to empower themselves, spit out fiery liquid blasts, and use alcohol in clever offensive and defensive techniques. the fruit Abilities can be used to produce explosive reactions and manipulate liquor-based attacks against enemies.

options.label: Human-Human Fruit, Model: Buddha
options.description: Grants the power to turn into a huge golden Buddha at will. The user can grow into a giant at any time, with very strong power and defense. In this form, their body shines gold, their arms and legs get very big, and every move hits hard. They can make strong shockwaves with their hands, crush enemies with their weight, and take hits that would break normal fighters.

options.label: Dark-Tremor Fruit
options.description: The User have successfully gained the power of two Devil Fruits after stealing them from a dead Yonko using his dark-dark fruit. This User successful wields both the Dark-Dark Fruit and the Tremor-Tremor Fruit, allowing the User to gain the power of Darkness, which lets them create, control, and become darkness itself. Through this power, the User can absorb attacks, pull in objects or enemies, increase gravity, and anullify other Devil Fruit powers through direct contact with the dark-dark fruit. The User also gains the power to create massive shockwaves and violent vibrations, allowing them to shatter the air, crack the land, trigger devastating earthquakes, and cause massive tsunamis capable of destroying entire areas with the Tremor-Tremor Fruit.

options.label: Age-Age Fruit
options.description: This fruit allows the user to manipulate the age of living beings and objects, aging or de-aging them at will. It can render opponents helpless by turning them into children or elderly individuals. The fruit also grants an ability called Distorted Future, which allows the user to temporarily access alternate futures. By picturing themselves with a desired power, the user can summon and use that ability for a limited time.

options.label: Fengxi-Fengxi Fruit
options.description: This mythical zoan fruit lets the user turn into a massive boar-like beast. In this form, the user gains huge strength and a very tough body that is hard to damage. The thick hide protects against attacks, while the large tusks can stab, crush, and break through defenses. The user can charge forward at high speed, smashing anything in their way without stopping. Even in partial form, the user becomes stronger, tougher, and harder to slow down, making this power perfect for head-on fights and destroying enemy lines.

options.label: Itsumade-Itsumade fruit
options.description: This mythical zoan fruit allows the user to turn into a giant cursed bird. In this form, the user can fly for long periods and move quickly through the air. The wings are strong, and the talons and beak are sharp enough to tear through armor and enemies. The user’s senses improve, letting them see enemies from far away and react quickly. Even without full transformation, the user becomes more aware of their surroundings and more frightening to enemies. This power is best for air combat, scouting, and striking from above.

options.label: Sandworm-Sandworm Fruit
options.description: This Mythical zoan fruit allows the user to become a giant sandworm. In this form, the user can move underground at very high speed, breaking through sand, dirt, and rock. The ground can collapse around enemies, trapping or crushing them. The sandworm body is massive and powerful, able to swallow enemies whole or destroy large areas from below. The user can also suck in air, enemies, and objects like a vacuum, then blast them back out with huge force. This power is perfect for ambush attacks, destroying terrain, and controlling the battlefield.

options.label: Bakotsu-Bakotsu Fruit
options.description: This mythical zoan fruit lets the user turn into a spooky, bone-covered horse-like creature. In this form, the user becomes much faster and lighter, allowing quick movement and strong charging attacks. The skeletal body is strange but tough, letting the user keep fighting even after taking heavy damage. The user can move long distances quickly, jump far, and strike hard while staying hard to hit. Even in a half form, the user gains better speed, faster reactions, and improved movement, making this power great for chasing enemies or attacking and escaping fast.

options.label: Gyuki-Gyuki Fruit
options.description: This mythical zoan fruit lets the user turn into a huge monster that looks like a mix of an ox and a spider. In this form, the user becomes extremely strong and hard to hurt. Their body grows larger and tougher, letting them smash buildings, break defenses, and overpower enemies with raw force. The many limbs help the user grab, crush, and control enemies in close combat. Even when not fully transformed, the user gains more strength, stamina, and a scary presence, making them very dangerous in long fights and direct battles.

options.label: Soul-Soul Fruit
options.description: This fruit enables the user to manipulate souls, extract life spans, and infuse objects with souls to create sentient beings called “Homies.” This power allows the user to form a diverse army and manipulate elements such as fire and lightning. The fruit also grants the user two Special Homies. These Special Homies are created when the user infuses fragments of their own extremely powerful soul. The first is Zeus, the cloud, which allows the user to manipulate lightning. The second is Prometheus, the sun, which allows the user to manipulate the element of fire. These two Special Homies follow the user wherever they go, obey every command, and remain completely loyal.

options.label: Paw-Paw Fruit
options.description: This fruit gives the user special paw pads on their hands. With those paws, the user can push away or repel almost anything they touch attacks, objects, air, even invisible or abstract stuff like pain or memories. The power also lets the user form bubbles shaped like paws from air or energy, and those paw‑bubbles can store or carry whatever was repelled. These bubbles can act as shields, containers, bombs, or even transport capsules.

options.label: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Okuchi-no-Makami
options.description: This fruit lets the user turn into a giant legendary wolf or a half-wolf hybrid. In this form, they gain super speed, sharp senses, strong claws and teeth, and a powerful body. They can use ice-based attacks, freeze enemies, and move with incredible agility. This fruit makes the user a fierce guardian on the battlefield.

options.label: Glint-Glint Fruit
options.description: Grants the power to become and manipulate light. The user can move at the speed of light, fire devastating laser beams, and reflect themselves off surfaces for high-speed travel.

options.label: Bird-Bird Fruit, Model: Falcon
options.description: This fruit lets the user turn into a falcon or a human/falcon hybrid. They get strong wings, sharp talons, a hooked beak, and very fast reflexes. Their eyesight becomes super sharp, and they can fly at high speeds. The user can attack from above, scout far distances, and move quickly across the battlefield. They can carry heavy loads or people while flying, making them great for both travel and surprise attacks.

options.label: Bird-Bird Fruit, Model: Albatross
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into an albatross or a half-bird hybrid. They gain huge wings, strong claws and beak, sharp eyesight, and super-fast reflexes. In this form, the user can fly long distances, glide across the sky, and attack from above with speed and precision. Their body becomes lighter and more agile, making them hard to hit in combat.

options.label: Arm-Arm Fruit
options.description: Allows the user to transform any part of their body into various weapons or armaments. This ability enhances their offensive and defensive capabilities, making them versatile in combat.

options.label: Sick-Sick Fruit
options.description: Grants the user the ability to create and control various diseases, enabling them to infect others through touch or airborne pathogens. The user is immune to the diseases they produce, making them a formidable biological threat.

options.label: Viso‑Viso Fruit
options.description: Grants the user the ability to imprint, project, and manipulate visual images: the user can touch a picture or scene, record it mentally, then summon or alter that visual reality as illusion, cover, or distraction in the environment.

options.label: Pet‑Pet Fruit
options.description: Grants the user the ability to produce collar-like constructs that attach to living creatures, allowing the user to exert control over their bodies though not their minds.

options.label: More‑More Fruit
options.description: Grants the user the ability to amplify the size or speed of objects they touch, allowing them to enlarge or accelerate tools, weapons, or even parts of themselves and thereby manipulate scale and momentum to dominate combat or construction.

options.label: Return-Return Fruit
options.description: Gives the user the power to turn back the age of anything they touch. They can make people, animals, or objects younger, or return things to how they were before. The user can even return the age of anyone by twelve years, making it act like a younger or refreshed version of itself.

options.label: Clank‑Clank Fruit
options.description: rants the user the ability to control, disassemble, reassemble, and reshape inanimate objects, turning them into weapons, armor, or constructs. The user can manipulate multiple objects simultaneously, merge them into complex machines or defensive structures, or temporarily fuse with objects to enhance their attacks and defenses.

options.label: Liquid-Liquid Fruit
options.description: Grants the user the ability to transform their body into a viscous liquid and control it freely, allowing them to evade attacks, pass through narrow spaces, and attack with liquid-based techniques. The user can manipulate the liquid form to stretch, expand, or compress, launch high-speed liquid projectiles, or create waves and barriers.

options.label: Sing-Sing Fruit
options.description: Grants the user the ability to trap anyone who hears their singing inside a dream-like dimension, where reality bends to the user’s imagination, allowing them to manipulate landscapes, objects, and even people’s physical or mental states. the user can also summon a powerful demon known as Tot Musica, a destructive entity sealed by a previous user of the fruit. This demon can manifest in both the dream dimension and the real world, causing widespread devastation.

options.label: Butterfly-Butterfly Fruit
options.description: Grants the user the ability to transform into a butterfly or a human-butterfly hybrid. The user gains flight, enhanced agility, and the ability to manipulate wings for offense, defense, or mobility. The transformation also improves reflexes and sensory perception, making the user extremely nimble in combat.

options.label: Gold-Gold Fruit
options.description: Allows the user to manipulate gold at will, enabling them to create and control gold structures and projectiles. This power grants the user enhanced strength and the ability to immobilize opponents.

options.label: Blind-Blind Fruit
options.description: Grants the user the ability to induce blindness in others upon contact. This power can disorient opponents and provide a tactical advantage in combat.

options.label: Shadow-Shackle Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user summon, control, and shackle shadows not just their own, but shadows of objects or people binding them like chains of darkness. the user can cause tendrils or shackles of shadow to sprout from the ground, walls, or their own body and bind, restrain, or immobilize targets, trapping foes in inky restraints, sealing doors or escape routes with shadow‑bars, or even shackling weapons or limbs to render enemies helpless.

options.label: Strong-Strong Fruit
options.description: The Strong-Strong Fruit is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that grants its user superhuman strength. This ability allows the user to perform feats of strength far beyond normal human limits, such as lifting and throwing massive objects with ease. The fruit enhances the user's physical power, making them formidable in close combat and capable of overwhelming opponents with sheer force.

options.label: Woods-Woods Fruit
options.description: The Woods-Woods Fruit is a Logia-type Devil Fruit that grants the user the power to create, control, and transform into flora at will, making the user a Forest Human. This ability allows for the manipulation of plants and trees, enabling the user to create barriers, entangle foes, and regenerate by merging with plant life.

options.label: Horm-Horm Fruit
options.description: Grants the user control over hormones, allowing them to alter a person’s gender, heal injuries, boost energy, or change appearance. A powerful support ability with life-saving potential.

options.label: Magma-Magma Fruit
options.description: Grants control over and transformation into magma. The user’s attacks are intensely hot, capable of melting anything they touch, and they gain enhanced destructive power.

options.label: Swamp-Swamp Fruit
options.description: Turns the user into a living swamp. The body becomes a sticky, dark bog that can absorb people and objects like a bottomless trap, storing them inside indefinitely.

options.label: Ice-Ice Fruit
options.description: Allows the user to create, control, and become ice. The user can freeze opponents instantly, create icy landscapes, and travel across the sea by freezing it beneath their feet.

options.label: Chop-Chop Fruit
options.description: Allows the user to separate their body into pieces and control them independently, rendering them immune to slashing attacks.

options.label: Snow-Snow Fruit
options.description: Gives the user control over snow and the ability to turn into snow. The user can freeze environments, obscure vision with blizzards, and move by merging with snowy terrain.

options.label: Arrow‑Arrow Fruit
options.description: This fruit grants the user the ability to generate solid arrow‑shaped constructs from their body. The user can fire, bind, redirect, or form large constructs with these arrows, turning their body into a versatile and deadly weapon on the battlefield.

options.label: Storm-Storm Fruit
options.description: This Logia fruit lets the user become a living storm. Their body can turn into dark clouds, lightning, wind, and rain. They can shape storms around them, strike with thunder, cut with sharp wind, and fly through the sky like a moving tempest. As their power grows, they can summon full hurricanes that change the entire battlefield.

options.label: Rumble-Rumble Fruit
options.description: Allows transformation into and control over lightning. The user gains immense speed, electrical attacks, and can travel along conductive surfaces almost instantaneously.

options.label: Monkey-Monkey Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a monkey or monkey‑human hybrid at will, granting them all the agility, reflexes, and climbing prowess of a primate. As a Monkey‑Human, the user gains long, dexterous limbs and possibly a prehensile tail or opposable toes, letting them swing through trees, scale cliffs or walls, leap great distances, climb or grapple and escape easily, and fight with fast, nimble strikes and acrobatics.

options.label: Penguin-Penguin Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a penguin or a penguin‑human hybrid at will. As a Penguin‑Human, the user gains streamlined body shape, flippers or windows for limbs or partial limbs, a beak if full‑beast or hybrid form, and natural resistance to cold. They can move with speed and agility on ice or slippery surfaces, slide or glide across snow, ice, or slick ground for surprise strikes or rapid movement, and, if near ice or water, use their natural aquatic adaptation for stealth, diving, or survival in freezing climates

options.label: Dark-Dark Fruit
options.description: Enables the control of darkness and gravitational pull. The user can absorb physical matter and even other Devil Fruit powers, but unlike most Logia, their body does not become intangible.

options.label: Sand-Sand Fruit
options.description: Gives control over sand and the ability to become sand. The user can dehydrate whatever they touch, create sandstorms, and shift their body into sand to avoid attacks.

options.label: Flame-Flame Fruit
options.description: Allows the user to generate, control, and become fire. Attacks are imbued with flames, and the user's body can become completely intangible to physical harm by transforming into fire.

options.label: Press-Press Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user manipulate gravity, they can press, pull, crush or lift anything around them by warping gravitational force. the user can slam enemies into the ground with tremendous pressure, crush structures or terrain, fling heavy debris or even meteors down from the sky, or lift and levitate objects or even themselves, using floating platforms of rock or debris, They can crush foes with localized gravity‑crushes, create gravity fields that squeeze or immobilize, or send mass destruction by collapsing the ground under armies or collapsing fortresses.

options.label: Tremor-Tremor Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user generate powerful shockwaves and tremors, turning the ground, air, and even bodies of water into vibrating, destructive waves at will. The user is able to slam fists or palms to create devastating earthquakes, crush enemies, shatter terrain, or split islands apart. The shockwaves can travel through the earth, strike multiple foes at once, or knock back ships and structures with overwhelming force. The user can also focus vibrations to amplify attacks or direct them with precision, making them a walking natural disaster.

options.label: Mochi-Mochi Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user turn their body into sticky mochi and generate, shape, or transform mochi at will, limbs, whips, clubs, walls or tendrils of mochi rise from their body on command. As a Mochi‑Human, the user can stretch or reshape their body in bizarre ways: launching mochi fists, extending limbs to strike from afar, hurling sticky blobs to trap or slow enemies, or hardening mochi, especially when coated with Haki into powerful blunt weapons capable of stopping bullets or smashing through defenses.

options.label: Ope-Ope Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user create a spherical room in which they can freely manipulate everything inside as if performing surgery or rearranging pieces on a board. The user is able to cut, swap, or rearrange objects, people, or even body parts without causing permanent harm, teleport things within the room, and heal injuries by reorganizing matter. They can isolate foes, swap positions to confuse or trap them, or even remove internal organs and place them elsewhere temporarily. The room can also grant protection, letting the user control the battlefield’s layout to their advantage.

options.label: Venom-Venom Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user produce and control every kind of poison or venom from corrosive acid to lethal toxins, gaseous clouds, or paralyzing darts. the user can coat their body in poison, spit venom at enemies, launch toxic gas clouds or venom‑projectiles, poison weapons, or even turn entire areas into death zones. Their poison can be mild irritants for harassment, or extremely deadly toxins capable of dissolving flesh and armor or crippling powerful foes.

options.label: Dragon-Dragon Fruit, Model: Kirin
options.description: This mythical Zoan fruit allows the user to transform into a Kirin or a hybrid Kirin‑human form. They gain enhanced strength, draconic features, and powers tied to the legendary creature, including the ability to channel destructive energy through their horn and roar.

options.label: Fish-Fish Fruit, Model: Azure Dragon
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a massive, mythic Azure‑dragon or a dragon‑human hybrid, granting wings or body for flight, scaly dragon‑armor for near‑impenetrable defense, and dragon claws, fangs, and tail for devastating melee combat, they can soar through the air, smash through walls or mountains, shred foes with claws and tail‑swipes, and rain destruction from above. The user also gains command over natural elements like breathing fire or elemental breath like flames, wind or lightning.

options.label: Raccoon-Raccoon Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a raccoon or a raccoon‑human hybrid at will. As a Raccoon‑Human, the user gains all the typical raccoon traits, sharp claws and teeth, night‑vision, enhanced senses smell, hearing, nimble hands and fingers for fine manipulation or theft, stealthy movement, agility, climbing and jumping skills, plus excellent reflexes.

options.label: Goat-Goat Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a goat or a goat‑human hybrid at will giving them the slick balance, sturdy limbs, agility, climbing ability, and natural defenses of a mountain goat. As a Goat‑Human, the user gains powerful legs and hooves ideal for jumping, sprinting, climbing steep surfaces or rough terrain, and delivering heavy kicks or hoof‑stomps, curved horns in hybrid or beast form serve as natural weapons for ramming or goring foes, capable of piercing armor or shielding.

options.label: Bull-Bull Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a bull or a bull‑human hybrid at will, giving them immense strength, bulky mass, thick hide, and powerful natural weapons such as horns, hooves, and brute force. As a Bull‑Human, the user can charge like a rampaging bull with devastating head‑butts, trample or gore foes, smash through walls or defenses, and use sheer mass and weight to overpower enemies in close combat

options.label: Snake-Snake Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a snake or a snake‑human hybrid gaining serpentine traits like a long flexible body, sharp fangs, venom or ability to spit or produce poison, depending on the snake model, and enhanced stealth, agility, and reflexes. As a Snake‑Human, the user can coil around enemies to constrict them, strike with biting venomous attacks, slither silently to infiltrate or ambush, scale or slip through narrow spaces, and move with fluid, unpredictable motions that make them hard to hit or anticipate.

options.label: Rhino-Rhino Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a rhinoceros or into a rhino‑human hybrid turning them into a Rhino‑Human with powerful horns, thick hide, and massive brute strength. With this power the user can charge like a rampaging beast, gore foes with tusks or horns capable of piercing armor or smashing bones, stomp and trample enemies or obstacles, and shrug off hits that would fell normal fighters thanks to their dense, tough skin and heavy build.

options.label: Bird‑Bird Fruit, Model: Crane
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a crane or a crane‑human hybrid at will. As a Crane‑Human, the user gains wings for flight, lightweight graceful limbs for high agility, long legs and neck typical to a crane for extended reach or powerful kicks/slashes, and heightened reflexes and balance.

options.label: Bat-Bat Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a bat or a bat‑human hybrid at will granting them bat‑like wings, acute hearing, echolocation, and agility. as a Bat‑Human, the user can fly through the air silently, swoop down on foes with clawed limbs and fangs, use echolocation to scout hidden enemies or navigate in darkness, and strike from above or behind with surprise.

options.label: Dog‑Dog Fruit, Model: Wolf
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a wolf or a wolf‑human hybrid at will, gaining everything a wolf has including sharp claws, fangs, enhanced senses smell, hearing, night‑vision, agility, speed and predatory reflexes. As a Wolf‑Human, the user can sprint across terrain, leap and pounce on enemies, slash with claws, bite with fangs, stalk prey silently, and hunt or fight with feral ferocity.

options.label: Lion-Lion Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a lion or a lion‑human hybrid at will. As a Lion‑Human, the user gains the raw power, speed, claws, fangs, and heightened senses of a mighty lion, razor‑sharp claws and crushing bites, powerful leaps and deadly charges, enhanced night‑vision, scent and hearing perfect for hunting, close‑combat ambushes, and brutal overpowering of foes.

options.label: Elephant-Elephant Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user turn into an elephant, an elephant‑human mix, or sometimes a giant mammoth‑like creature. They gain the huge size, strength, and tough body of an elephant. As an Elephant‑Human, they get strong tusks, a long trunk, thick skin, and enough power to break trees, crush rocks, lift big things, or smash walls. They can use their trunk to grab, throw, or hit enemies, swing their tusks to charge, or stomp like a walking fortress.

options.label: Frog-Frog Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a frog or frog‑human hybrid, giving them all the powerful amphibian traits, long, muscular legs for explosive jumps and leaps, a prehensile tongue to grab or snatch enemies and objects from afar, stretchy digits for climbing or sticking to surfaces, and amphibious abilities like swimming or staying underwater.

options.label: Mole-Mole Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a mole or mole‑human hybrid at will, granting them the power to burrow and move through the earth as if it were water. As a Mole‑Human, the user can tunnel beneath the ground with ease, travel unseen underground to ambush or escape, and burst out from beneath foes to strike them by surprise with sharp mole‑claws that can gouge flesh or break through walls and rock.

options.label: Horse-Horse Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a horse or a horse‑hybrid at will, turning them into a Horse‑Human with all the speed, strength, and agility of a steed. They gain powerful legs and hooves for fast running, long jumps, charging attacks that can trample foes or shatter obstacles, and enhanced endurance compared to a normal human.

options.label: Dog-Dog Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a dog, dog‑hybrid or a powerful often mythic canine beast at will. They can run fast across terrain, track scents over kilometers, pounce, leap, or tear through foes with claws, or use canine instincts to hunt, guard, or stalk enemies. In beast or hybrid form their reflexes, strength, and durability are boosted beyond human limits, making them fierce close‑range fighters or trackers.

options.label: Ox-Ox Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a powerful bovine beast or beast‑hybrid at will, granting strength, endurance, and physical prowess like that of a bull, bison, or horned cow. the user can charge like a rampaging bull, gore foes with horns.

options.label: Resonance-Resonance Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user tune into the natural resonant frequencies of objects, metal, wood, stone, even the air and manipulate those vibrations by touching or striking something, the user can lock on to its frequency and amplify or distort it. the user can shatter armor or weapons by resonating them, crumble walls or structures by hitting just the right tone, or cause objects to vibrate uncontrollably until they break apart.

options.label: Ball-Ball Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform their body into a ball or take on the properties of any ball they imagine or in some versions, create and control extra spherical balls around them. the user can curl into a compact sphere and roll or ricochet at high speed for powerful charge attacks or surprise strikes. They can also perform moves like turning into a heavy, cannon‑ball–like mass to smash through walls or enemies, become a light bouncy ball to dodge or bounce across terrain, or morph into specialized ball‑forms heavy for impact, light for agility.

options.label: Paste-Paste Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user generate an adhesive paste at will, they can coat objects, surfaces, weapons, or even parts of their body in sticky paste that they control with their mind. the user can use the paste to bind or immobilize enemies, glue shut doors or weapons, trap objects together, create sticky traps or barriers, or even immobilize foes by encasing them in hardened paste.

options.label: Imitate-Imitate Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user copy the abilities, appearance, or skills of others after touching or observing them, turning the user into a Mimic‑Human. With this power the user can mimic physical traits, strength, speed, agility, fighting style, even special powers if conditions allow, they may take on a target’s abilities to fight, climb, sneak, or use unique talents.

options.label: Box-Box Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user create magical box‑cubes at will, or compress objects including gases, liquids, fire and physical items into small, transparent boxes by touching them. The user can trap items or elements, storing weapons, ammo, treasure, or dangerous substances and carry them effortlessly. The boxes can be used as shields, traps, or projectiles, the user can release their contents to surprise enemies, trap parts of the environment, or even rearrange the battlefield.

options.label: Sky-Sky Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user become a Sky‑Human, granting the power to shape and manipulate the sky including the air, clouds and atmosphere as if it were a tangible substance. The user can walk or fight in the air, create solid or semi‑solid sky‑fabric to form shields, platforms or barriers, whip or bind enemies with sky‑whips, or shape air and clouds to create gusts, storms, or sudden aerodynamic effects.

options.label: Mushroom-Mushroom Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user generate, control, and even transform into mushrooms, spores, and fungal matter at will. The user can sprout mushrooms or fungal masses out of the ground or from their body, creating walls, platforms, spore clouds, or fungal traps. They can release spores to poison, paralyze, or confuse enemies, or use mushrooms as living shields, terrain, or weapons.

options.label: Book-Book Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user manipulate books at will, they can control any book nearby, make books fly or be used as platforms, and most dangerously, trap living beings inside books. the user can open a book over a target and imprison them turning them into part of the book’s world or illustration, effectively locking them in an alternate story prison where they no longer age.

options.label: Color-Color Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user paint or color‑coat people, objects, or surfaces at will, changing their appearance so they blend with surroundings, disguise themselves or others, or even mimic a different look entirely. the user can spray or coat ships, walls, clothes, or bodies to become nearly invisible or disguised perfect for stealth, infiltration, surprise attacks, or escapes. They can also recolor enemies or objects to sow confusion, change armor to look like stone, weapons to look like harmless tools, or create illusions by altering colors of the environment.

options.label: Wax-Wax Fruit
options.description: Lets the user generate wax that can be molded into various shapes, hardened to steel-like consistency for defense and offense.

options.label: Glare-Glare Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user see through anything, skin, clothes, walls, even the minds and memories of others and perceive hidden truths others conceal. the user can reveal lying enemies, read memories, uncover secrets, and detect invisible traps or hidden foes. They can also project or transfer memories to others, letting them plant false memories or share their own without spoken words.

options.label: Heat-Heat Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user superheat their body and anything they touch, turning flesh, weapons, or even water into searing heat. the user can scorch enemies with a mere touch, melt metal weapons or armor, heat up their own fists or blades to burn through defenses, or even boil surrounding water or the sea itself to hinder ships or aquatic foes.

options.label: Echo-Echo Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user control sound waves and echoes: they can amplify, distort, recreate, or project any existing sound voice, noise, ambient sounds, turning them into tools or weapons. the user can unleash deafening sonic blasts to shatter objects or knock back foes, distort sounds to confuse or mislead enemies, create illusions of footsteps or voices to trick people, or quietly mimic someone’s voice to impersonate them.

options.label: Spore-Spore Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user create, control, and become spores and fungus at will, turning them into a Spore. With this power the user can release clouds of spores to poison, paralyze, or put foes to sleep, infecting air or surfaces and turning entire areas into hazard zones.

options.label: Sleep-Sleep Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user put other living beings to sleep at will, by touch, voice, or a subconscious trigger, instantly sending targets into slumber and rendering them unconscious. the user can pacify enemies without violence, infiltrate guarded places by knocking out guards quietly or disable large groups simply by making them fall asleep. The user can also lull targets into deep sleep, so they dream, fall into illusions, or remain helpless for extended periods, while the user remains free to act.

options.label: Sickle-Sickle Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user grow long, razor‑sharp nails that can sliver through the air like cutting blades, turning themselves into a Sickle. With this power the user can slash directly with clawed nails in close combat or swing to generate slicing air‑blades that cut through flesh, metal, or even stone from afar, they can unleash gusts or whirlwinds of razor‑wind to slash groups of enemies or cleave through heavy defenses.

options.label: Gigantify-Gigantify Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user dramatically increase their body size at will growing into a towering giant whose reach, strength, and mass become enormous. As the user turns into a Giant the user can stomp or punch with the force to crush earth, shatter walls, uproot trees, or sweep aside foes like rag‑dolls.

options.label: Smelt-Smelt Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user become a living blast furnace, they can consume metal ore or metal objects, melt them down inside their body, and then reshape the molten metal into weapons, armor, or tools at will, forming swords, shields, heavy weapons or even constructs from melted ore. the user can pull molten metal from within their body to attack, coat themselves in molten armor, pour molten metal over enemies to burn or encase them, or forge metal gear on the fly for offense, defense, or utility.

options.label: Love-Love Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user turn anyone who feels lust, love, or deep attraction toward them into stone, or even petrify objects on contact, effectively freezing targets in place as stone statues. The user is able to fire heart‑shaped beams, kisses, or other charm‑based attacks that exploit desire or infatuation to immobilize or neutralize foes, even weapons, metal, or inanimate objects hit by the right move can be turned to stone.

options.label: Jacket-Jacket Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform into a wearable jacket, when someone else slips into that jacket, the user becomes the skin‑jacket and gains control over the wearer’s body and physical abilities. the user can let a stronger or larger ally wear them borrowing that person’s strength, size, and capabilities turning themselves into a living suit of flesh, cloth, or flesh‑cloth. While worn, the user can move and speak, and control every action of the wearer, turning even a timid or weak person into a powerful fighter under their direct command.

options.label: Meld-Meld Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user merge with or meld into any surface or object they touch including stone, metal, ground, wood, walls, basically any inanimate material and while merged they can move through it as if the material were liquid, travel inside it, reshape it from within, or emerge anywhere on that connected material. the user can hide within walls or floors, phase through barriers, travel unseen through solid ground or structures, ambush enemies by surfacing behind them, or reshape the merged material.

options.label: Whisper-Whisper Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user manipulate sound and silence, they can silence all noises they or objects they touch make, dampen footsteps and movement, muffle voices, or cloak ambient sound so no one hears them coming; at the same time they can subtly project whispers or soft sounds to selected people, letting them speak without being overheard, tricking ears, spreading misinformation, or secretly transmitting messages.

options.label: Molten-Molten Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user create, control, or transform parts of their body and nearby materials into molten metal or molten rock, With this power the user can melt metal or earth at will and reshape molten matter into weapons, armor, molten projectiles, or streams of molten lava and metal to strike, burn, or flow over obstacles.

options.label: Voice-Voice Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user manipulate sound and voices: they can perfectly mimic or steal any voice they hear human, animal, even mechanical then speak using that voice as though it were their own. the user can disguise themselves, impersonate others, trick enemies by issuing orders with someone else’s voice, or sow confusion and chaos by mimicking sounds from far away.

options.label: Chain-Chain Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user sprout and control chains from their body at will, arms, legs, even fingertips can elongate as metallic chains controlled by the user’s will. the user can lash out with chains as whips or flails, swing or grapple across terrain, bind or restrain enemies, form chain‑armor, or wield the chains as stabbing or bludgeoning weapons.

options.label: Whip-Whip Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user command anything they strike with a whip living or nonliving by implanting obedience or control into the target, bending weapons, objects, or even terrain to their will. the user becomes a master manipulator, lash a building and have its walls shift and move, crack a rock floor and make it crawl, or strike metal to force it into shapes and forms under their command.

options.label: Sew-Sew Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user stitch or un-stitch anything, living or non‑living, as if they were sewing fabric. the user can bind enemies to walls or the ground by sewing them in place, immobilizing them, stitch together objects of all materials even metal or stone, reattach broken limbs or torn items, patch up wounds or mend broken gear, or unravel the stitches to restore the original state.

options.label: Stick-Stick Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user generate and control sticks or rigid rod‑like objects at will, sprouting them from their body or materializing them out of nothing. the user can form sticks into weapons spears, clubs, staffs, projectiles, throwing rods or javelins, barricades or barriers to block attacks, or even support structures like bridges, ladders, or scaffolding on demand.

options.label: Ripple-Ripple Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user and anything they touch ripple, billow, or flutter as though made of cloth: solid metal, wood, or weapons become flexible and wave like a flag under the user’s will. the user can bend, flatten or fold rigid objects turning swords into whips, metal shields into flapping barriers, or even reshape terrain into flexible, undulating surfaces. Metals and materials still retain their original strength and sharpness, but their shape becomes fluid, giving the user huge versatility in combat and creativity.

options.label: Hobby-Hobby Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user turn any living person or animal they touch into a toy, and when they do, everyone else instantly forget the person ever existed memories of them vanish as if they were erased from history. the user can reshape victims into dolls, stuffed animals, toy soldiers, or any toy form they choose, stripping them of powers, weapons, and normal physical strength. Once transformed, the user can bind the toy with a contract so it must obey all orders, making them loyal soldiers or servants for life.

options.label: Pop-Pop Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user make any inorganic object they touch or even parts of their own body swell up until they rupture and violently explode, turning them into a Rupture‑Human. With this power the user can cause metal weapons, walls, machinery, or other solid items to expand and burst apart, demolishing defenses or creating chaos with sudden explosions.

options.label: Spin-Spin Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user rotate or spin any part of their body including limbs, clothing, even hair at superhuman speeds, turning themselves into a Rotation‑Human. With that spinning power they can turn limbs into spinning weapons or propellers, launch blade like strikes, spin to create powerful gusts or shockwaves, or even spin themselves to fly or move with incredible speed over ground or air.

options.label: Arms-Arms Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform any part of their body a finger, hand, arm, leg, or even their entire body into any weapon they imagine including swords, cannons, guns, missiles, axes, scythes, or even explosive ordnance. the user never needs to carry weapons their body is the arsenal. At their will they can shapeshift limbs into blades to slash, barrels to shoot, or heavy weapons to blast enemies, giving them total flexibility in combat.

options.label: Swim-Swim Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user swim not through water, but through solid matter ground, walls, earth as if the rock or dirt were liquid. With this power the user becomes a Free‑Swimming Human, able to dive into the ground, travel beneath walls, emerge from unexpected places, sneak into or out of strongholds, ambush enemies from below or escape unnoticed, and even slide upward through terrain to reach high positions with momentum.

options.label: Ton-Ton Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user drastically increase their body weight at will turning them into a Super‑Weight Human. With it the user can slam down with unbearable force, crush foes or shatter the ground beneath them by suddenly becoming so heavy they hit like a meteor. Their weight becomes a weapon even a simple fall or stomp packs the strength of tons. But the power has trade‑offs if they miss their target the full weight hits the ground hurting themselves or wasting the attack.

options.label: Straw-Straw Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user create and control straw at will forming bundles, threads, or masses of straw from nothing, or drawing straw from surrounding surfaces. the user can shape straw into weapons, shields, or even dolls and puppets. They can send out straw threads like whips or bind enemies, create straw constructs to trap or restrain foes, or even cover themselves in straw armor.

options.label: Magnet-Magnet Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user generate and control magnetic forces to attract or repel metal at will. The user is able to draw metal weapons swords, guns, cannons, even ship metal toward them to disarm opponents or form armor, weapons, and mechanical limbs from scrap metal lying nearby. They can also repel metal projectiles or metal‑containing attacks back toward attackers, turning enemy weapons against them.

options.label: String-String Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user produce thin, razor‑sharp strings from any part of their body and control them at will With this power the user can launch invisible strings to slice through flesh, metal, and even stone, wrap or bind enemies like marionettes by attaching strings to their spines, or spin strings into whips, webs, cages, or compressed constructs to trap, restrain, or cut

options.label: Barrier-Barrier Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user generate and shape invisible or translucent barriers at will, walls, domes, spheres, or even stairs that can block, deflect, or trap anything: bullets, blades, punches, and even the fiercest attacks. the user can summon a protective shield in front of them for defense, enclose an area to trap enemies, erect stair‑like barriers to climb or reach high ground, or launch a barrier forward like a huge force‑filled projectile to smash foes.

options.label: Brush-Brush Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user generate ink from their body and use a brush or any painting tool, even hair to draw images that instantly become real, three‑dimensional objects once painted. The user becomes a Brush‑Human, capable of creating weapons, armor, tools, creatures, food, or nearly anything they can imagine ink‑swords that fight, ink‑creatures that serve as allies, ink‑boats to sail the seas, or ink‑food to eat. What you draw becomes real, and your creations carry the same physical properties as the real thing.

options.label: Calm-Calm Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user mute all sound around them: they can create a zone of absolute silence or cancel any noise they or others make, rendering footsteps, voices, explosions, even gunshots, completely silent. As a Silent‑Human, the user can slip through enemy territory unseen and unheard, speak privately, spy on conversations, or launch surprise attacks without warning.

options.label: Cook-Cook Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform ordinary objects into edible food at will. The user becomes a Food‑Human, with the power to turn logs, stones, metal any non‑living object into meals, baked goods, or other forms of food. With this ability the user can feed themselves or allies endlessly, create food from nothing when resources are scarce, or turn dangerous objects into harmless nourishment.

options.label: Memory-Memory Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user reach into a person’s mind and manipulate memories they can view, steal, erase, or alter memories at will, making someone forget who they are, what they know, or believe events that never happened. The user becomes a Memory‑Human, able to rewrite reality in others’ minds: erase past traumas, fabricate false histories, wipe away secrets, or implant lies so convincing the victim believes them as truth.

options.label: Wringer-Wringer Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user drain all liquid from anything living beings, objects, even the air inside a fruit or a container simply by squeezing or wringing it out as if wringing a wet cloth. The user becomes a Dehydration‑Human, able to pull moisture out of opponents to dehydrate them, weaken them, or even leave them as withered husks; they can also drain liquids from weapons, objects or terrain.

options.label: Butter-Butter Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user create and control butter at will, shaping it into gooey, sticky butter that can bind or trap anything, limbs, weapons, even entire bodies. The user becomes a Butter‑Human, able to slather butter onto the ground to make opponents slip, flood an area with adhesive butter to immobilize foes, or encase enemies in thick butter walls to trap or restrain them.

options.label: Biscuit-Biscuit Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user summon and shape living biscuits at will, with a clap or even a gesture they create biscuit material out of thin air, molding it into whatever they need from weapons and shields to massive humanoid biscuit soldiers that fight, shield, or carry the user. The user becomes a Biscuit‑Human, able to spawn near‑limitless biscuit constructs, cloak themselves in armor made of hardened biscuits, build walls or weapons, or send legions of biscuit golems to overwhelm foes.

options.label: Art-Art Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform people, objects, or scenery into abstract art distort shapes, warp functionality, and bend reality into a twisted canvas anything struck by the user’s creative power loses its normal form and purpose, becoming surreal art that can’t function as before.

options.label: Clear-Clear Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user become invisible at will and make anything they touch invisible as well, including clothes, weapons, or small objects. The user can walk unseen through crowds, slip past guards, spy on conversations, sneak aboard enemy ships, or set up ambushes without being detected. Invisible weapons and items can strike or move without being seen, and small gear or even boats can vanish to aid in stealthy travel or escape.

options.label: Hollow-Hollow Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user create spectral ghosts known as Hollows, under their control. The user can summon a swarm of these ghosts at will, shaping them into anything from small, sneaky phantoms to larger, more powerful wraiths. The ghosts float, pass through walls and solid matter, and cannot be harmed by physical attacks.

options.label: Shadow-Shadow Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user manifest and control shadows, not just their own, but the shadows of other living beings. The user can steal another person’s shadow, cut it free from their body, and reshape or reassign it at will. They can also make their own shadow take physical form: a dark, semi‑solid silhouette that moves, fights, and obeys the user’s will.

options.label: Revive-Revive Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user come back to life after their first death. The user’s soul returns, reviving their body, even if it has decayed, lost parts, or become nothing more than bones. Once revived, the user lives on as something between living and undead: their body may bear scars of death, but their soul powers grant them continued existence.

options.label: Wheel-Wheel Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user transform their body parts arms, legs, or even torso into wheels. When activated, those wheels spin at high speed, granting the user the ability to roll, dash, or strike with rotating limbs. The user can roll across the ground like a living wheel human, launch into whirling charges to crash into enemies, or spin their limbs into blade‑like strikes.

options.label: Rust-Rust Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user cause any metal they touch to rust and weaken, eventually breaking apart. The user can target weapons, armor and even parts of buildings, making them brittle and useless. By touching enemies’ metal equipment, they can leave them vulnerable in battle.

options.label: Berry-Berry Fruit
options.description: This fruit allows the user to transform their body parts into grape-like balls, effectively becoming a Grape Human. The user can roll, bounce, or stretch these berry-balls for movement, offense, or defense. They can attack enemies by launching or flinging parts of their body, and the balls can absorb impacts, letting the user withstand hits. With creativity, the user can reshape their body to dodge, trap foes, or create barriers.

options.label: Bubble-Bubble Fruit
options.description: This fruit gives the user the power to create and control soap and bubbles from their body. The bubbles are more than just water they can wash away dirt and clean off an enemy’s strength or powers, leaving them weaker, vulnerable, and slick. The user can wrap themselves in dense bubbles for protection, or cover foes in slippery foam so they can’t stand or fight properly

options.label: Door-Door Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user create doors on any surface walls, air, ground, even empty space and use them to instantly travel from one place to another. The user can open a door here and another door elsewhere, then step through to instantly appear at the destination. They can also open a door on themselves to escape danger, dodge attacks, or ambush enemies.

options.label: Spring-Spring Fruit
options.description: This fruit gives the user a body made of powerful spring like coils. Their limbs become stretchy and springy: they can launch punches or kicks with explosive force, rebound from hits, or strike with long reach. The coiled body gives them both great attack power and good resistance, The user can extend or compress their limbs to move with surprising speed or reach across distances.

options.label: Cage-Cage Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user create iron shackles and chains from their own body, which can be used to bind, trap, or restrain enemies. The user can form chains quickly and with great strength, controlling where they wrap, how tight they hold, and even lifting or throwing opponents. It’s a powerful tool for capturing or immobilizing foes, controlling the battlefield, and supporting allies.

options.label: Spike-Spike Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user grow spikes or thorns all over their body, or on parts of it arms, back, shoulders, whatever they choose. The spikes can be used to jab, slash, or impale enemies and objects with deadly force. They also work as natural armor if someone tries to grab or hurt the user, they risk getting cut or pierced by the spikes.

options.label: Dice-Dice Fruit
options.description: This fruit gives the user the ability to turn their body into razor‑sharp steel. Their arms, legs, even skin become as hard and sharp as metal blades. With this power, they can slice through nearly anything, wood, stone, ships and cut enemies and obstacles with brutal precision. The user can also reshape or reform their body into different sharp forms, blades, spikes, edges to adapt to battle or defense.

options.label: Clone-Clone Fruit
options.description: This fruit gives the user the power to copy the appearance of anyone they touch with their right hand. After contact, the user becomes a perfect physical double, copying face, voice, build and overall look. The memory of every face they’ve touched is stored, so they can transform into any of them later, with no time limit.

options.label: Munch-Munch Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user eat any object including things that aren’t food which is weapons, buildings, even living beings and absorb it into their body. Once eaten, the user can rearrange or transform that material: they could turn swallowed metal into a cannon, wood into armor, or even fuse two eaten items together to create new forms.

options.label: Kilo-Kilo Fruit
options.description: The Kilo-Kilo Fruit lets the user change their weight anytime they want, from as light as 1 kilogram to as heavy as 10,000 kilograms 10 tons in a second. They can make their body super light to jump very far, walk on water or thin branches, float in the wind, or dodge attacks easily. They can also make themselves extremely heavy to break through walls, crush enemies with huge pressure, create shockwaves by stomping, or fall from the sky like a meteor and leave a large crater.

options.label: Flower-Flower Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user sprout copies of their body parts, arms, legs, eyes, even full limbs, from almost any surface: walls, ground, other objects, or living things. The user can control those extra limbs as if they were their own, letting them attack, grab, hold, or spy from unexpected angles.

options.label: Bomb-Bomb Fruit
options.description: This fruit lets the user turn any part of their body, arms, legs, breath, even spit or mucus into a living bomb. They can detonate limbs or exhalations to create powerful explosions, hurting enemies and damaging surroundings without harming themselves. The user becomes immune to explosions even cannonballs, so they can unleash blasts freely while staying safe.

options.label: Smooth-Smooth Fruit
options.description: This fruit makes the user’s skin super smooth and slippery. Any attack punch, sword, bullet, even heavy objects will slide off their body harmlessly, because nothing can grip or bite into their slick surface. If the user was overweight, the slip effect can even cause excess fat to slide off, making their body slim and sleek.

options.label: Gum-Gum Fruit
options.description: This fruit turns the user’s body into rubber, letting them stretch, bend, and move in ways normal people can’t. Their punches and kicks can reach far distances, and their rubber body helps them take strong hits without breaking.

options.label: Non-Devil Fruit User
options.description: A normal human with no Devil Fruit powers. They rely purely on physical strength, skill, intelligence, and determination. Through hard training and experience, they've become a capable fighter able to stand their ground in a world full of monsters and abilities.

setup_questions.prompt: Tell me, who will be your family?

options.label: King Harald Family
options.description: A proud royal family that once ruled the giant island of Elbaf, known for their strength, history, and leadership. They held power over the land for generations, guiding their people with both wisdom and might. After the death of King Harald, the family no longer rules Elbaf, but their name still carries great respect and reputation among the giants.

options.label: Accino Family
options.description: The Accino Family is a famous family of bounty hunters, known for their skill and clever strategies. Led by Don Accino, they are well-known for capturing many pirate flags, which they keep as trophies. The family plans carefully and knows their enemies well, making them a respected force in bounty hunting.

options.label: Davy Family
options.description: The Davy Family is a famous family linked to the mysterious pirate Davy D. Jones, who was cursed to live on the ocean floor. They are one of the most legendary families among those with the "Will of D." Important members of this family include Rocks D. Xebec and Marshall D. Teach. Their family has a strong connection to the sea and its secrets.

options.label: Fugetsu Family
options.description: The Fugetsu Family was a distinguished samurai lineage from the Kibi region of Wano Country. As staunch supporters of the ruling Kouzuki Family, they held the title of daimyo and were integral to the region's governance and defense.

options.label: Amatsuki Family
options.description: The Amatsuki Family were staunch supporters of the ruling Kouzuki Family in Wano. Members held the title of daimyo, overseeing various regions.

options.label: Uzuki Family
options.description: Once a powerful family in Wano Country, the Uzuki Family ruled over the Udon region until the rise of Kurozumi Orochi. Notable members include Uzuki Tempura, the former daimyo of Udon, and Uzuki Namida.

options.label: Bavette Family
options.description: The Bavette Family is another royal bloodline of the World Nobles. About 38 years ago, members participated in the Native Hunting Competition at God Valley, ranking among the top scorers. Details about their current activities and influence remain limited.

options.label: Rimoshifu Family
options.description: A royal bloodline among the World Nobles, the Rimoshifu Family is represented by Saint Killingham, a member of the Holy Knights. The family is known for its association with the Kirin, a mythical creature of Chinese origin.

options.label: Boa Family
options.description: The Boa Family is a powerful and influential lineage, feared and respected across the seas. Known for their cunning, combat skill, and sharp intellect, they strike strategically rather than relying on brute force alone. Loyalty and family honor are everything to them, and any threat to their name is met with swift and decisive retaliation.

options.label: Charlotte Family
options.description: You are one of many born under a powerful and feared matriarch. In a family of politics, power, and sweets, your upbringing was anything but simple. In this world of monstrous siblings and ruthless ambition, will you rise above or become another pawn in your mother’s empire?

options.label: Kurozumi Family
options.description: Once veiled in shadows, the Kurozumi Family rose to power through deceit, dark ambition, and ruthless cunning. Masters of manipulation and subterfuge, their name inspires fear and distrust throughout Wano. Hidden behind a facade of honor, they wield treacherous secrets and deadly plots to seize control a legacy stained by betrayal and bloodshed. To cross a Kurozumi is to invite ruin.

options.label: Furukawa Family
options.description: A noble lineage rooted deeply in tradition and honor, the Furukawa Family stands as a pillar of stability within Wano. Known for their unwavering loyalty and skilled craftsmanship, they have long served as trusted retainers to the ruling class. Though not the most flashy or powerful, their wisdom and steady influence quietly shape the fate of their land.

options.label: Nerona Family
options.description: Shrouded in mystery, your family is rumored to hold the keys to ancient secrets and forbidden knowledge. Your path is one of discovery and the weight of hidden truths.

options.label: Manmayer Family
options.description: A lesser-known lineage among the elite, your family's contributions are veiled in secrecy. Operating from the shadows, your influence is felt in whispers and unseen actions.

options.label: Shepherd Family
options.description: Known for their stewardship and guidance, your family has long been caretakers of global balance. Your role is one of quiet influence and enduring legacy.

options.label: Topman Family
options.description: Steeped in tradition and governance, your family has long been a pillar of the world order. Your decisions ripple through history, shaping the course of civilizations.

options.label: Jaygarcia Family
options.description: As part of the ruling elite, your family holds sway over the world's most critical decisions. With a legacy of authority and control, your path is one of command and consequence.

options.label: Figarland Family
options.description: A noble lineage with ties to the highest echelons of power, your family's influence is felt across the seas. With secrets and connections that span the globe, your heritage is both a blessing and a burden.

options.label: Chinjao Family
options.description: Hailing from a line of powerful martial artists, your family is known for strength and pride. With a legacy of combat and honor, your fists carry the weight of generations.

options.label: Dadan Family
options.description: Though not related by blood, your family ties are forged through shared hardship and survival. Raised among bandits, your upbringing was rough but instilled in you a fierce sense of loyalty and resilience.

options.label: Franky Family
options.description: Born from camaraderie and shared purpose, your family is a band of shipwrights and fighters. United not by blood but by bonds forged in fire and steel, your legacy is one of creation and rebellion.

options.label: Shimotsuki Family
options.description: Descended from legendary samurai, your family brought the way of the sword from Wano to the wider world. With a heritage of honor and discipline, your blade carries the weight of generations.

options.label: Riku Family
options.description: Once rulers of Dressrosa, your family was overthrown and later restored. Known for compassion and justice, your lineage stands as a symbol of resilience. Will you uphold this legacy or seek a new destiny?

options.label: Neptune Family
options.description: As royalty of the Ryugu Kingdom beneath the sea, your family holds ancient ties to the world's mysteries. With the ability to communicate with Sea Kings and a history intertwined with legends, your path is one of deep currents and hidden depths.

options.label: Nefertari Family
options.description: Royalty of the desert kingdom of Alabasta, your family is revered for wisdom, loyalty, and compassion. You walk the line between nobility and humility, a bridge between the people and the throne. Will you rule with grace or forge your own crown?

options.label: Donquixote Family
options.description: You come from a family once seated among the Celestial Dragons, now infamous for its fall from grace. With a legacy steeped in corruption, betrayal, and tragedy, your journey may be one of redemption or vengeance.

options.label: Kozuki Family
options.description: Heirs of an ancient kingdom and guardians of powerful knowledge, your lineage carries a legacy of honor, sacrifice, and resistance. Bound to the fate of Wano, your blood ties you to a history of war and prophecy.

options.label: Vinsmoke Family
options.description: Engineered for warfare, you are a product of science and royalty. Your family leads the Germa 66, feared across seas for their genetic advancements and ruthless ambition. Do you embrace your designed destiny, or rebel against the machine?

options.label: Portgas Family
options.description: Born of sacrifice and hidden lineage, your family endured great suffering to bring you into the world. You represent both the fire of rebellion and the burden of secrecy. What will you do with the freedom bought for you?

options.label: Gol Family
options.description: Your blood flows from a legend whispered across every sea. As a descendant of a Pirate King, you bear the weight of greatness and the eyes of the world. Hunted, honored, or feared your heritage cannot be ignored.

options.label: Monkey D. Family
options.description: You hail from a lineage known for defying the world. With ties to both the Marines and the Revolutionary Army, your family legacy is one of strength, rebellion, and unwavering conviction. Will you carry on the will of your ancestors, or carve your own path?

options.label: Unknown Family
