options.description: You were raised with no knowledge of your lineage. Whether abandoned, orphaned, or hidden away for protection, your family history is a mystery. Your quest may one day uncover a powerful bloodline or prove that destiny is forged, not inherited.

setup_questions.prompt: What is your status in the world?

options.label: The World Government
options.description: You currently work for the World Government perhaps as a Cipher Pol agent, one of the Five Elders, one of the God Knights, or one of their associated officials. Serving the World Government grants you powerful benefits and immense privileges that place you far above ordinary citizens.

options.label: Bounty Hunters
options.description: You are a Bounty Hunter, a skilled hunter that targets pirates with a Beli bounty on their heads. You track any pirates with a bounty across seas and lands, capturing them for the World Government or sometimes killing them to claim the reward, though this can lower the prize. You often work alone, using any weapons, tools, or abilities you can find, but sometimes you team up to take on dangerous enemies. Feared by pirates and known for your skill, you fight without hesitation.

options.label: Civilian
options.description: You walk the world untethered by oath or flag neither sworn to justice nor bound by chaos. As a Civilian, you are one of the many who dwell in the shadows of pirates and marines alike. You may be a merchant, craftsman, bounty board informant, rogue scholar, or simply someone surviving in a dangerous world. But beware... in a world ruled by power, staying neutral is not always safe.

options.label: Marines
options.description: Sworn to justice, discipline, and the authority of the World Government, you sail the seas as a beacon of order. Whether you pursue Absolute or Moral Justice, your duty is to bring criminals to their knees, uphold the law, and protect the innocent even if it means bending your ideals to the will of your superiors. Your uniform is your pride, and your name carries the weight of authority. The world may not always see you as a hero, but in your heart, you believe in peace through strength

options.label: Pirates
options.description: Untamed, unshackled, and free your heart beats with the rhythm of the sea. You answer to no one but your own dream. Whether you plunder cities, protect your crew, or chase the legendary One Piece, your path is yours alone. The world may call you a criminal, but you call yourself free. With a Jolly Roger flying high and a crew at your back, you carve your legacy into the tides of history.

setup_questions.prompt: Are you part of the Worst Generation?
What's your secondary class? (optional - choose None for a single specialty)

options.label: None
options.description: The class is for people with no special abilities or combat training. They can’t use any special techniques. They are just ordinary humans relying on their own strength, speed, and cleverness to survive.

options.label: Colors Trap
options.description: A Colors Trap Artist is a fighter who uses special paint to control people’s emotions. By drawing small symbols in different colors, they can make enemies laugh, cry, calm down, or even turn on their own crew. The colors work like tricks on the mind, so the artist doesn’t need strength or weapons. Their power comes from their brush, their paint, and how fast they can draw.

options.label: Art of Weather
options.description: With the Art of Weather, the user becomes a master of the sky, sea and storms. They wield a specialized weather‑staff and combine knowledge of winds, temperature, clouds and storms to manipulate the battlefield. They can summon gusts, clouds, lightning or rain to turn the tide of combat, using both cunning and power. (Would recommend choosing the Normal, Perfect or Sorcery Clima‑Tact weapon if you’re going for this class!)

options.label: Observation Haki
options.description: Observation Haki is the power to sense what is happening around you, even if you cannot see it. It lets you feel the presence, strength, and emotions of others. With this, you can read movements, dodge attacks, and notice danger before it happens. It is like having a sharper awareness of everything nearby, helping you react faster in battle.

options.label: Full Haki User
options.description: A warrior who has transcended normal combat by mastering the spiritual force known as Haki. They wield Observation Haki to sense opponents and incoming danger, Armament Haki to harden their body and attacks beyond steel, and Conqueror’s Haki to exert their will over the weak-minded and clash with the world’s strongest. A Haki Master is very good with haki and their power lies in pure will, sharpened instinct, and unshakable spirit.

options.label: Armament Haki
options.description: Armament Haki allows the user to surround themselves or a weapon with their own spiritual energy, effectively creating an invisible armor that boosts defense and offensive power. It also lets them touch or damage opponents who are normally immune, like those with certain Devil Fruit powers.

options.label: Supreme King Haki
options.description: Supreme King Haki is the power to overpower others using pure will. When someone uses it, a strong pressure spreads out from them. People with weak spirits can freeze up, become scared, or fall unconscious without being touched. It can affect many people at once and shows who has the stronger will. Only very rare individuals are born with this power.

options.label: Okama Kenpo
options.description: Okama Kenpo is a flashy fighting style that mixes dance-like moves with strong kicks. It focuses on speed, flexibility, and surprising opponents. By moving in unusual ways, the fighter can attack and dodge at the same time, keeping enemies off balance.

options.label: Life Return
options.description: Life Return lets a person control their body very carefully. They can make their muscles, bones, and movements stronger, faster, and more flexible. This control helps them move quickly, recover from injuries, and perform amazing tricks in battle.

options.label: Honestly Impact
options.description: Honestly Impact is a fighting style that uses hard, accurate punches. Each hit is meant to do the most damage, break an opponent’s guard, or stop several attackers at once. It focuses on strong muscles and quick reactions, so it works well in face-to-face fights while staying controlled and precise.

options.label: Lily Carnation
options.description: The Lily Carnation Wielder has formed a symbiotic bond with the legendary Lily Carnation, a monstrous plant capable of controlling life and reanimating the dead. This connection allows the wielder to manipulate life forces, summon reanimated beings, and wield plant-based constructs in combat. While powerful, the bond is a curse as the plant’s insatiable hunger for life constantly threatens the wielder.

options.label: Six Powers
options.description: A powerful martial arts style known as the Six Powers used by elite fighters. It grants superhuman speed, strength, and agility through techniques like Iron Body, Moon Walk, and Tempest Kick, making the user extremely versatile in combat.

options.label: Foxfire Style
options.description: oxfire Style is a swordsmanship technique that lets the user generate and control fire through their sword. Attacks are stronger and can burn or cut through enemies with heat. The fire can also be used defensively, creating barriers or protecting the user. Practitioners move with precision and power, combining sword skill and flames for deadly combat.

options.label: Black Leg Style
options.description: Black Leg Style focuses on strong, fast, and acrobatic kicks. The fighter can heat up their legs, adding fire to every strike for extra damage. Skilled users combine speed, jumping attacks, and spinning kicks to hit enemies from different angles. They are hard to predict and can fight multiple enemies at once, using blazing kicks to control the battlefield and overwhelm opponents.

options.label: Fish Man Jujutsu
options.description: Fish-Man Jujutsu is for close fighting. Practitioners grab, throw, and lock enemies using their strength and the opponent’s momentum. Water makes their moves smooth and fast, adding extra power. Masters can control fights with clever holds and throws, taking down bigger or stronger opponents with skill rather than raw power.

options.label: Eight Impacts Fist
options.description: Eight Impact Fist allows the user to control body vibrations, creating powerful shockwaves with each strike. These reverberating attacks bypass defenses, making them unblockable and capable of shattering even the toughest armor.

options.label: Dragon Claw Fist
options.description: The Dragon Claw Fist is a formidable martial art that transforms the user's hands into claw-like weapons, channeling the ferocity of a dragon. Enhanced with Armament Haki, each strike delivers crushing force, capable of shattering steel and overwhelming foes with fiery precision.

options.label: Hypnotist
options.description: Hypnotists are masters of the mind, using subtle cues, gestures, and voice to control, confuse, or influence others. They can manipulate emotions, induce sleep, or bend enemies to their will. Skilled Hypnotists excel in strategy and deception, turning the battlefield in their favor without needing raw strength.

options.label: Galaxy Impact
options.description: Warriors of cosmic might, Galaxy Impact fighters harness the power of stars and celestial energy to unleash devastating attacks. Known for their explosive combat style, they combine incredible physical strength with energy manipulation that can devastate large areas, making them formidable both on land and at sea!

options.label: Soul Damage Haki
options.description: A rare and advanced form of Haki that lets the user damage an opponent’s soul, bypassing physical defenses. It inflicts deep mental and spiritual harm, weakening resolve and disrupting focus. Mastery of this Haki demands immense spiritual strength and control, making it one of the most formidable abilities.

options.label: Voice of All Things
options.description: A rare ability to hear the mysterious voices of the world animals, nature, and ancient relics. Masters use this to sense danger, communicate beyond words, and uncover hidden secrets others cannot perceive.

options.label: Awakened Devil Fruit
options.description: An Awakened Devil Fruit is a rare and advanced state where a user has fully mastered their fruit's power, allowing them to affect the environment or their own body in extraordinary ways. This stage greatly enhances their abilities, durability, and control, making them a serious threat even to top-tier fighters.

options.label: Will of D.
options.description: Carriers of a mysterious legacy, those with the D. in their name possess an unyielding spirit, fearless courage, and a fate intertwined with great change. They inspire allies and defy even the strongest enemies through sheer willpower.

options.label: Poneglyphs Reader
options.description: A scholar who deciphers the ancient, indestructible stones that reveal lost history, secrets of the Void Century, and hidden locations. Their knowledge can unlock powerful truths and guide daring adventures.

options.label: Treasure Hunter
options.description: Experts in finding hidden loot, deciphering maps, and avoiding traps.

options.label: Blacksmith
options.description: Crafts weapons and armor with unique materials from the Grand Line.

options.label: Musician
options.description: Empowers teammates or confuses enemies with rhythm-based support techniques.

options.label: Professional Cook
options.description: A master chef who heals and boosts allies with powerful meals. Skilled in both cooking and combat, they keep their crew or strong and ready for any adventure.

options.label: Gadgeteer
options.description: Uses custom-built gadgets, smoke bombs, traps, and mechanical tools in combat.

options.label: Sniper
options.description: Long-range marksman specializing in rifles, pistols, or trick shot weapons like slingshots.

options.label: Tactician
options.description: Battlefield controller who can command allies, predict enemy moves, and exploit weak points.

options.label: Weapon Master
options.description: Trained in using multiple weapons (axes, chains, fans, etc.) with expert precision.

options.label: Spear Fighter
options.description: Polearm users with long-range melee techniques and spinning crowd control moves.

options.label: Brawler
options.description: Raw strength-based fighters who use brute force, grapples, and wrestling moves.

options.label: Martial Artist
options.description: Hand-to-hand fighters specializing in styles like Fish-Man Karate, Black Leg, or Rokushiki.

options.label: Beast Tamer
options.description: Commands and communicates with sea beasts, land animals, or mythical Zoans.

options.label: Tailor
options.description: Uses clothing and thread for offense and defense. May create disguises, armor, or even thread-based traps.

options.label: Archaeologist
options.description: Masters of ancient texts, Poneglyphs, and lost knowledge. May uncover secrets that lead to ancient weapons or mythical lore.

options.label: Shipwright
options.description: Craft specialists who can repair and build ships mid-battle, as well as develop ship-based weapons.

options.label: Navigator
options.description: Experts in ocean travel, weather prediction, and map-making. Can control ship-based combat or affect environmental hazards.

options.label: Doctor
options.description: Vital support class focused on healing, antidotes, and enhancing crew performance with medicine or stimulants.

options.label: Cyborg
options.description: Tech-savvy inventors who modify their own bodies or build powerful tools and weapons. Often mix science with combat.

options.label: Gunslinger
options.description: Long-range fighters with pinpoint accuracy. Masters of firearms, trick shots, and explosive ordinance.

options.label: Swordsman
options.description: Masters of swordsmanship who can use advanced techniques like flying slashes and elemental-style swordplay.

options.label: 5 Crowns
options.description: This bounty is for the Marine Fleet Admiral, the top target of the Cross Guild. Even the bravest pirates are afraid to go after them, because they are the symbol of Marine power and can destroy fleets easily. Only the strongest Pirates would try to fight them, risking everything for a reward that could make them legendary, but very few who try ever come back.

options.label: 3 Crowns
options.description: These Bounties were Placed on Admirals by the cross Guild. They are feared across the seas by Pirates and can change wars by themselves. Fighting one is almost certain death, but the riches and glory tempt pirates and hunters alike. Only the boldest dare to try.

options.label: 5 Star
options.description: These bounties were set on marine Vice Admirals by the Cross Guild, though even lower-ranking Marines who have made a name for themselves can be marked. They are feared across the seas, known for their strength and skill in battle. Taking one down is a challenge, but the reward and fame are legendary. Pirates and bounty hunters alike see them as prized targets, yet few who dare to hunt them ever live to tell the tale.

options.label: 2 Star
options.description: These bounties were given to Marine Rear Admirals by the Cross Guild. These Marines are experienced and known for leading tough battles. Hunting them is difficult, but the rewards are greater. Pirates also pursue them, hoping to take down respected leaders and make a name for themselves.

options.label: 1 Star
options.description: These bounties were placed on Marine Captains and Commodores by the Cross Guild. They lead small fleets or bases and are not the strongest, but they are still skilled fighters. Many new hunters and pirates target them first to prove themselves and earn quick rewards.

options.label: 5B - 6B+
options.description: This bounty range is reserved for individuals whose power, influence, and danger level rival or surpass the likes of the former Yonko. These are titanic figures who shake the balance of the worldeither by brute strength, world-altering Devil Fruits, legendary combat prowess, or fearsome ideologies that threaten the very foundation of the World Government.

options.label: 2B+ – 3B+ Bounty
options.description: You are no longer just a legend—you are a living calamity. Your name is written into the fate of islands. Whether you're a liberator or conqueror, your existence sends ripples through time. Entire dimensions whisper of your coming. Only the strongest dare speak your name.

options.label: 1B+ – 2B+ Bounty
options.description: You are feared by governments, gods, and galaxies. Your power bends landscapes, and your choices shape nations. Armies prepare when you appear, and entire factions may fall by your will. You are a threat to world stability itself.

options.label: 700M – 1B+ Bounty
options.description: You’ve changed the course of wars or wiped out powerful enemies. Your strength rivals captains, emperors, or faction leaders. The world either wants to kill you… or crown you. You're too big to ignore, and too dangerous to control.

options.label: 400M – 700M Bounty
options.description: Nations whisper your name in council rooms. Heroes prepare for your arrival; villains want you as an ally or target. You're either a notorious warrior, a major rebel, or the wildest card alive. Wherever you go, balance breaks.

options.label: 100M – 300M Bounty
options.description: You're considered a serious threat. Your actions have shaken regions, destroyed enemy camps, or defied powerful figures. Governments and warlords alike are keeping tabs. Your power is undeniable, and you're climbing fast.

options.label: 50M – 100M Bounty
options.description: You're making noise. Small towns whisper your name. Whether hero or menace, people have begun to take notice. A few minor factions might even fear you. You're officially on the world’s watchlist.

options.label: 0 Bounty
options.description: You haven’t made a ripple in the world. You're either just starting out or purposely flying under the radar. To the world, you're harmless for now. But every legend starts with silence.

setup_questions.prompt: Are you starting as an Adult, Teen, or Child?

options.label: Child
options.description: You are a Child, overlooked and underestimated by the world. But your journey has just begun. With wide eyes and untapped spirit, you’ll rise through hardship, discovering strength, allies, and purpose one step at a time. Every legend starts small.

options.label: Teen
options.description: You are a Teen, full of fire, dreams, and raw potential. You're just beginning to carve your mark on the world. Whether you're chasing adventure or justice, your future is unwritten, and your will is strong enough to split the seas.

options.label: Adult
options.description: You are an Adult, seasoned by life and hardened by the sea. Your path has already taken shape, shaped by choices, battles, and scars. Whether pirate, marine, or wanderer your experience is your greatest weapon, and the world already knows your name... or soon will.

content.description: The most common race in the world. Humans vary widely in size, strength, intelligence, and moral alignment. Some humans are so physically advanced (like the Kuja or Red-Haired Pirates) that they rival even the strongest non-human races.

Humanoid beings with traits from various aquatic animals, They possess immense physical strength and can breathe underwater. Known for their mastery of Fish-Man Karate, they originate from Fish-Man Island beneath the sea.

Half-human, half-fish beings like fish-men, but their lower half is that of a fish. They are graceful swimmers and cannot walk on land until age 30, when their tails split into legs. Merfolk are often seen as more peaceful than fish-men.

Winged humans living on islands above the clouds. They have small feathered wings on their backs and use a special technology called Dials. Skypieans are peaceful, Shandians are warrior tribes, and Birkans are more isolated and mystical.

Furry humanoid animals with traits from different mammals. Minks are from Zou, a giant elephant island. They can use Electro, a combat technique that shocks enemies. At night or during full moons, they can access their terrifying Sulong form, becoming far more powerful and feral.

Enormous humanoids, typically over 12 meters tall. Giants come from Elbaf, the warrior island. They possess immense strength and long lifespans. Elbaf giants follow a strict warrior code and are known for their pride and power.

Ancient race with dark skin, white hair, and flaming wings. They can manipulate flames, are extremely durable, and once lived on the Red Line before being nearly wiped out. King of the Beast Pirates is a known Lunarian.
humans beings modified with mechanical enhancements, Cyborgs have weapons, enhanced bodies, and sometimes artificial intelligence.
Reanimated corpses created through Moria’s shadow powers. These are artificial beings with unique personalities derived from their shadow donors.
a human whose soul was revived by a fruit. Technically a human soul inside a reanimated skeleton body.

Created by Vegapunk and other scientists. These include Seraphim, clones of former Warlords enhanced with Lunarian DNA, and the Vinsmoke siblings. They have biological and artificial enhancements beyond normal humans.
Rare hybrids between Fish-Men and Giants. Exceptionally huge and powerful, combining the strength of both races. Rare due to compatibility issues.
Humanoids with two elbows per arm, giving them elongated and strong arms. Known for unique fighting styles. Originated from the island Kenzan.
Humanoids with extremely long legs, allowing for powerful kicks. From Longleg Island, and they have a rivalry with the Longarm Tribe.
Rare humanoids with long, snake-like necks. Not much is known about their culture, but they appear similar to other humanoid variants. Seen in the Underworld and Reverie.

A mysterious, recently revealed race with giant-like strength but not classified as true giants. Bartholomew Kuma is from this race. They were heavily oppressed by the World Government due to their power.
Tiny people from Green Bit, near Dressrosa. Despite their size, they possess incredible strength and speed. Known for their naivety, honesty, and loyalty.
Sometimes confused with Tontatta, though mostly the same group. “Fairy” is just what Dressrosans call the Tontatta who steal things invisibly. Not a separate race canonically.
Sentient beings made from objects or animals with human souls embedded in them. Not born races, but recognized inhabitants in her territory.

Genetically modified clones with cyborg parts and Lunarian DNA, combining multiple races and enhancements into one body. Created by Dr. Vegapunk. Considered more tools than citizens but biologically distinct.
A powerful crew known for their balance of strength and diplomacy.
Emits Noroma Photons that drastically slow down the movements of anything they touch for 30 seconds.
Allows the user to grow wheels on their body and use them for both movement and powerful spinning attacks.
Allows the user to transform others and objects into abstract works of art, altering their physical appearance and function.
Individuals who’ve eaten a Devil Fruit and gained supernatural powers.

You were raised with no knowledge of your lineage. Whether abandoned, orphaned, or hidden away for protection, your family history is a mystery. Your quest may one day uncover a powerful bloodline or prove that destiny is forged, not inherited.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: You hail from a lineage known for defying the world. With ties to both the Marines and the Revolutionary Army, your family legacy is one of strength, rebellion, and unwavering conviction. Will you carry on the will of your ancestors, or carve your own path?
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Your blood flows from a legend whispered across every sea. As a descendant of a Pirate King, you bear the weight of greatness and the eyes of the world. Hunted, honored, or feared your heritage cannot be ignored.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Born of sacrifice and hidden lineage, your family endured great suffering to bring you into the world. You represent both the fire of rebellion and the burden of secrecy. What will you do with the freedom bought for you?
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Engineered for warfare, you are a product of science and royalty. Your family leads the Germa 66, feared across seas for their genetic advancements and ruthless ambition. Do you embrace your designed destiny, or rebel against the machine?
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Heirs of an ancient kingdom and guardians of powerful knowledge, your lineage carries a legacy of honor, sacrifice, and resistance. Bound to the fate of Wano, your blood ties you to a history of war and prophecy.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: You come from a family once seated among the Celestial Dragons, now infamous for its fall from grace. With a legacy steeped in corruption, betrayal, and tragedy, your journey may be one of redemption or vengeance.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Royalty of the desert kingdom of Alabasta, your family is revered for wisdom, loyalty, and compassion. You walk the line between nobility and humility, a bridge between the people and the throne. Will you rule with grace or forge your own crown?
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: As royalty of the Ryugu Kingdom beneath the sea, your family holds ancient ties to the world's mysteries. With the ability to communicate with Sea Kings and a history intertwined with legends, your path is one of deep currents and hidden depths.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Once rulers of Dressrosa, your family was overthrown and later restored. Known for compassion and justice, your lineage stands as a symbol of resilience. Will you uphold this legacy or seek a new destiny?
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Descended from legendary samurai, your family brought the way of the sword from Wano to the wider world. With a heritage of honor and discipline, your blade carries the weight of generations.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Born from camaraderie and shared purpose, your family is a band of shipwrights and fighters. United not by blood but by bonds forged in fire and steel, your legacy is one of creation and rebellion.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Though not related by blood, your family ties are forged through shared hardship and survival. Raised among bandits, your upbringing was rough but instilled in you a fierce sense of loyalty and resilience.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Hailing from a line of powerful martial artists, your family is known for strength and pride. With a legacy of combat and honor, your fists carry the weight of generations.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: As a family of bounty hunters, your legacy is one of pursuit and capture. Operating from the shadows, your skills are honed for tracking and subduing targets across the seas.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: A noble lineage with ties to the highest echelons of power, your family's influence is felt across the seas. With secrets and connections that span the globe, your heritage is both a blessing and a burden.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: As part of the ruling elite, your family holds sway over the world's most critical decisions. With a legacy of authority and control, your path is one of command and consequence.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Steeped in tradition and governance, your family has long been a pillar of the world order. Your decisions ripple through history, shaping the course of civilizations.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Known for their stewardship and guidance, your family has long been caretakers of global balance. Your role is one of quiet influence and enduring legacy.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: A lesser-known lineage among the elite, your family's contributions are veiled in secrecy. Operating from the shadows, your influence is felt in whispers and unseen actions.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Shrouded in mystery, your family is rumored to hold the keys to ancient secrets and forbidden knowledge. Your path is one of discovery and the weight of hidden truths.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Generates thin but powerful strings from the user's body, capable of cutting, manipulating people, or even stitching organs.
Gives the user the ability to communicate secretly with animals and possibly inanimate objects.
Generates harmful spores that can cause enemies to hallucinate, fall ill, or become paralyzed.
Grants the ability to amplify the size, speed, or force of anything the user interacts with.
Turns the user into a living Den Den Mushi, allowing them to relay and intercept all communications.
Grants transformation into a leopard and leopard-human hybrid, enhancing speed, strength, and stealth in combat.
Allows transformation into a fish and fish-human hybrid, offering swimming speed and underwater breathing.
Transforms the user’s body into liquid mud, allowing them to slip through cracks, trap enemies, and launch heavy, earth-based attacks.

A noble lineage rooted deeply in tradition and honor, the Furukawa Family stands as a pillar of stability within Wano. Known for their unwavering loyalty and skilled craftsmanship, they have long served as trusted retainers to the ruling class. Though not the most flashy or powerful, their wisdom and steady influence quietly shape the fate of their land.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Once veiled in shadows, the Kurozumi Family rose to power through deceit, dark ambition, and ruthless cunning. Masters of manipulation and subterfuge, their name inspires fear and distrust throughout Wano. Hidden behind a facade of honor, they wield treacherous secrets and deadly plots to seize control a legacy stained by betrayal and bloodshed. To cross a Kurozumi is to invite ruin.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: You decided that you don’t need a weapon relying instead on your skills, instincts, and perhaps Haki or Devil Fruit powers to face any challenge. Ready to prove that sometimes, the greatest strength comes from within.

You wield not one, but three blades one in each hand, and one held firmly in your mouth. This unorthodox style, forged through relentless discipline, blends precision, power, and unpredictability into a whirlwind of steel.
A cursed katana with bloodlust. Sharp and deadly, but dangerous even to its wielder. A blade that challenges fate with every swing.
A pristine white katana forged by a master. Revered as one of the 21 Great Grade swords, it represents unshakable will and legacy. Swift, precise, and unwavering.
A legendary sword that draws out its wielder’s Haki involuntarily. Requires great control, but offers immense cutting force capable of scarring even the mighty.
A long-range slingshot-like weapon enhanced with Dials and Pop Greens. Capable of firing exploding plants, projectiles, and unique ammunition with immense precision.
Transforms the user’s body into different monstrous or hybrid forms, each with unique combat styles like horns, claws, or brute strength. A form-changing powerhouse.
A hidden blade within a cane. Combined with soul manipulation, it allows chilling cuts, soundwave-based attacks, and freezing soul energy strikes.
Long-range melee weapons with pointed tips for thrusting attacks. Basic but effective in keeping enemies at a distance.
Ranged weapons useful for silent and precise strikes from afar. Limited by ammunition but valuable for sniping.
Simple projectile weapons that can launch stones or small ammo. Usually used for distraction or minor damage.
Blunt weapons designed to deal crushing blows. Often made of wood or metal, effective against armored foes.
Small, throwable blades useful for distraction or injuring foes from a distance.
Flexible weapons used to entangle, trip, or strike from a distance. Require skill but offer reach and control.
A traditional polearm with a broad curved blade, delivering powerful thrusts and slashes capable of cleaving multiple enemies.
A giant war hammer known for crushing power. Its weight and force make it a weapon of destruction.
Single-shot pistols that use flint and gunpowder to fire lead bullets. They have slow reload times but are effective at close range.
Long-barreled firearms designed for longer-range shots. They require time to reload but offer improved accuracy over pistols.

An Awakened Devil Fruit is a rare and advanced state where a user has fully mastered their fruit's power, allowing them to affect the environment or their own body in extraordinary ways. This stage greatly enhances their abilities, durability, and control, making them a serious threat even to top-tier fighters.

You are one of many born under a powerful and feared matriarch. In a family of politics, power, and sweets, your upbringing was anything but simple. In this world of monstrous siblings and ruthless ambition, will you rise above or become another pawn in your mother’s empire?
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Defensive fighters who reinforce armor, shields, or fists with hardened Haki.

A sleek, red-hilted saber with a slightly curved blade, Gryphon is a remarkable sword known for its unmatched sharpness and strength. The blade can cut through almost anything with ease and is further enhanced by the mastery of Haki.

A heavy, large jutte with a thick metal shaft and a hook-like prong near the handle. This weapon is specially designed to counter Devil Fruit users, as the prong contains Seastone, which nullifies Devil Fruit powers on contact.

A slender, extendable baton imbued with advanced weather-manipulating technology. this weapon has the ability to summon and control weather phenomena like lightning, wind, and rain in battle. Its lightweight design allows for swift strikes, while its hidden compartments unleash devastating electric and climatic attacks that leave enemies off balance.

A massive, jagged saw-like sword that embodies the brutal and savage fighting style. The Kiribachi’s serrated blade can tear through wood, flesh, and bone with ease, and its heavy weight allows the person to deliver powerful, crushing blows.

A lightweight and exceptionally durable sword forged with great craftsmanship. Known for its sleek design and ease of handling, Yubashiri is favored by those who value speed and precision. Though it was lost early in the story, it remains a symbol of skilled swordsmanship.

A large, heavy cleaver-type sword that emphasizes brute strength and overwhelming force over finesse. Kashu’s wide blade can cleave through tough materials and opponents alike, making it a favored weapon for those who fight with raw power.

An imposing nodachi sword characterized by its exceptional length and weight. Kikoku’s heavy blade is capable of delivering devastating slashes, often used to intimidate and overpower foes. It is wielded with expert skill to maximize reach and cutting power.

Known as the “Rain Cutter,” Shigure is a finely crafted katana reputed for its elegance and sharpness. Its blade is said to glide through the air like a gentle rain, allowing for swift and precise strikes. It is treasured by those who combine artful technique with deadly efficiency.

A uniquely designed sword with a curved blade optimized for swift cutting and close-quarters combat. The Hiru sword’s balanced build allows the user to deliver quick, fluid attacks, making it a favorite among agile swordsmen.

A specialized high-tech device used by the Germa 66 military force, these canisters are equipped with offensive and defensive weaponry. They can deploy traps, emit energy blasts, or release smoke screens to disorient opponents. Designed for versatility and tactical advantage, the Raid Canisters enhance Germa 66’s combat efficiency.
An individual who belongs to no faction, aligning with no cause or ideology. They act on their own terms, free from allegiance, forging their own path!

An extremely rare hybrid race born from the union of giants and dwarves. They exhibit a blend of immense strength characteristic of giants with the agility and size of dwarves. Due to their unique heritage, Zushindodo are seldom seen and remain one of the most enigmatic races.

A rare hybrid race resulting from the union of humans and Tontatta dwarves. The Dosundada possess unique physical traits and abilities that distinguish them from other races. Their name comes from the distinctive sound of their footsteps, reflecting their origins.

Grants the user the ability to enter and manipulate the dreams of others, allowing them to influence thoughts and actions within the dreamscape. This power can be used for both combat and psychological manipulation.

You must remember to tell them their moves at all costs. Don’t overwrite this, as it’s important to inform them of their moves,

Moves:

Dreamwalk — Allows the user to enter and control another’s dream.

Nightmare Grasp — Induces a nightmare state in opponents, causing fear and paralysis.

Dreamforge — Creates tangible objects within the dream that can interact with the real world.

Sleep Wave — Emits a wave that induces deep sleep in all those who hear or see it.

The Tontatta Tribe is a group of small but brave warriors who live in the Green Bit. They are known for their speed, cleverness, and strong sense of loyalty. Despite their size, they are skilled fighters and protect their home from threats.

Doug

Other Tontatta warriors

The Kuja Tribe is made up entirely of women who are fierce warriors skilled in combat and Haki. They are loyal to their empress and protect their home from outsiders. The tribe is known for its strength, discipline, and unity.

Vegapunk’s Creations are advanced inventions and weapons made by the brilliant scientist Vegapunk. They include robots, artificial Devil Fruits, and other powerful technologies. Many are used by the World Government or Marines, and they are known for their strength and clever designs.

Members:

Pacifista units

Kuma (PX-0)

Other Vegapunk-built machines and creations

The Pacifista Program is a project by Vegapunk that creates powerful human-like weapons. These cyborgs are used by the Marines to fight pirates and enforce the World Government’s rules. They are strong, fast, and equipped with advanced technology and weapons.

PX-1

PX-2

Other Pacifista units

The Seraphim are advanced weapons created by Vegapunk, based on the strongest pirates of the past. They are powerful, humanoid cyborgs used by the World Government to maintain control and fight dangerous opponents. Each one has unique abilities that make them highly dangerous in battle.

One Piece Seraphim unit 2 (modeled after Kaido)

One Piece Seraphim unit 3 (modeled after Big Mom)

Other Seraphim units

The Celestial Dragons are the noble and wealthy rulers of the World Government. They live in luxury and are treated as untouchable, often abusing their power over others. Feared and hated by many, they enforce their will through the Marines and influence world politics.

Members:

Saint Charlos

Saint Shalulia

Saint Elizabello II (affiliated)

Other noble Celestial Dragons

You have successfully become a member of the Five Elders, the highest-ranking officials in the World Government who oversee global policy and decisions. Feared and respected across the world, you now stand among those who shape history from the shadows. With absolute authority over the Marines, Cipher Pol, and even the Celestial Dragons, your words can spark wars or silence nations!

The Big Helmet Pirates are a strong and loyal crew known for their teamwork and fighting skills. They sail the seas seeking adventure and challenges, always sticking together to protect their captain and crew.

The Space Pirates are a group of fox-like aliens from the moon. They are moon miners who excavate valuable resources and are known for their cunning and teamwork. They are led by a strong captain and operate in the skies above the moon.

Led by the pirate captain Roshio, whose crew's jolly roger features a red circle with the black silhouette of a hanged man. They are known for their macabre symbol and have a bounty of 42,000,000.

The God’s Knights, also known as the Holy Knights, are an elite group of warriors serving the World Government. They operate in the Holy Land of Mary Geoise and are tasked with enforcing the laws, even among the Celestial Dragons. They hold authority over World Nobles and have the power to execute them if necessary. The Knights are known for their immense strength, combat skills, and immortality, making them formidable enforcers of the World Government’s will.

A short pirate sword. Easy to swing on ships, good for quick fights.
A thin sword used for stabbing. Fast, but not very strong.
A long stick. Simple, light, and good for defense.
A long weapon with a sharp tip. Good for keeping distance.
A farm tool used like a spear. Clumsy, but works in a fight.
A heavy blade. Cuts through plants and enemies alike.
A big axe. Strong, but slow and heavy.
Small knives made to throw. Weak, but quick and sneaky.
A plain piece of wood. Cheap and easy to use.
A bow with strong shots but slow reload. Good for defense.
A small bow. Not very strong, but good for hunting.
Metal on fists. Makes punches stronger and painful.
A chain used for hitting or grabbing. Hard to control.
A curved farm blade. Can slash or hook in close combat.
A small knife. Easy to hide, fast in close fights.
A three-pronged spear. Good for stabbing and fishing.
A large hammer. Can crush, but very heavy.
A pole with an axe head and spike. Long reach, powerful.
A pirate’s metal hook. Works as both weapon and tool.
A wooden club with nails. More deadly than plain wood.
A spiked ball on a stick. Heavy and dangerous.
A hand axe, perfectly balanced for close combat, can be an incredibly deadly weapon. When wielded with skill and precision, it has the power to take down even the most formidable opponents

The Boa Family is a powerful and influential lineage, feared and respected across the seas. Known for their cunning, combat skill, and sharp intellect, they strike strategically rather than relying on brute force alone. Loyalty and family honor are everything to them, and any threat to their name is met with swift and decisive retaliation.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: The Three-Eye Tribe is a mysterious and rare race known for the distinctive third eye in the center of their forehead. This third eye grants them heightened perception, allowing them to see things others cannot—hidden traps, invisible enemies, or the flow of energy in battle. Wise and disciplined, they often have strong spiritual and combat traditions, blending intuition with martial skill.
Masters of swordsmanship who can use advanced techniques like flying slashes and elemental-style swordplay.
Long-range fighters with pinpoint accuracy. Masters of firearms, trick shots, and explosive ordinance.
Tech-savvy inventors who modify their own bodies or build powerful tools and weapons. Often mix science with combat.
Vital support class focused on healing, antidotes, and enhancing crew performance with medicine or stimulants.
Experts in ocean travel, weather prediction, and map-making. Can control ship-based combat or affect environmental hazards.
Craft specialists who can repair and build ships mid-battle, as well as develop ship-based weapons.
Masters of ancient texts, Poneglyphs, and lost knowledge. May uncover secrets that lead to ancient weapons or mythical lore.
Uses clothing and thread for offense and defense. May create disguises, armor, or even thread-based traps.
Commands and communicates with sea beasts, land animals, or mythical Zoans.
Hand-to-hand fighters specializing in styles like Fish-Man Karate, Black Leg, or Rokushiki.
Raw strength-based fighters who use brute force, grapples, and wrestling moves.
Polearm users with long-range melee techniques and spinning crowd control moves.
Trained in using multiple weapons (axes, chains, fans, etc.) with expert precision.
Battlefield controller who can command allies, predict enemy moves, and exploit weak points.
Long-range marksman specializing in rifles, pistols, or trick shot weapons like slingshots.
Uses custom-built gadgets, smoke bombs, traps, and mechanical tools in combat.
A master chef who heals and boosts allies with powerful meals. Skilled in both cooking and combat, they keep their crew or strong and ready for any adventure.
Empowers teammates or confuses enemies with rhythm-based support techniques.
Crafts weapons and armor with unique materials from the Grand Line.
Experts in finding hidden loot, deciphering maps, and avoiding traps.

A scholar who deciphers the ancient, indestructible stones that reveal lost history, secrets of the Void Century, and hidden locations. Their knowledge can unlock powerful truths and guide daring adventures.

Carriers of a mysterious legacy, those with the D. in their name possess an unyielding spirit, fearless courage, and a fate intertwined with great change. They inspire allies and defy even the strongest enemies through sheer willpower.

A rare ability to hear the mysterious voices of the world animals, nature, and ancient relics. Masters use this to sense danger, communicate beyond words, and uncover hidden secrets others cannot perceive.

A rare and advanced form of Haki that lets the user damage an opponent’s soul, bypassing physical defenses. It inflicts deep mental and spiritual harm, weakening resolve and disrupting focus. Mastery of this Haki demands immense spiritual strength and control, making it one of the most formidable abilities.

Warriors of cosmic might, Galaxy Impact fighters harness the power of stars and celestial energy to unleash devastating attacks. Known for their explosive combat style, they combine incredible physical strength with energy manipulation that can devastate large areas, making them formidable both on land and at sea!

Dawn Island is a peaceful island in the East Blue, known for its green hills, forests, and rivers. Foosha Village sits at its heart, where friendly villagers live close to the sea. The island looks calm, but old ruins and signs of past battles hint at a history full of adventures. Its cliffs and fields make it a beautiful place for travelers seeking peace or new journeys.

Shells Town is a small coastal town in the East Blue, known for its cannon-topped towers and industrial feel. It is controlled by the Marine 153rd Branch, making it a strict and heavily guarded area. Despite its calm appearance, the town has a history of conflict and is marked by past battles that shaped its streets.

Shimotsuki Village is a peaceful village in the East Blue, surrounded by green hills and mountains. Its culture is inspired by Wano, with rice farming and traditional customs. The village is known for its swordsmanship, taught at the local Isshin Dojo, where residents keep their skills alive.

Orange Town is a small coastal town in the East Blue, known for its cobblestone streets and colonial-style buildings. It has a bustling marketplace and a few notable shops, including a Pet Food Shop guarded by a loyal dog. The town has a lively, colorful atmosphere but has also faced trouble from pirate activity in the past.

Syrup Village is a peaceful settlement located on the Gecko Islands. The village is nestled amid rolling grasslands, dirt trails, hills, and forests. Its residents live in modest homes, with the exception of Kaya's grand mansion situated atop a hill. The village is accessible via two slopes leading from the island's shoreline, as the rest of the coastline is marked by steep, impassable cliffs.

Baratie is a floating restaurant in the East Blue, shaped like a giant fish. It has multiple decks for dining and cooking, and stabilizing fins keep it steady in rough seas. The restaurant is accessible by small boats and is known for its lively atmosphere and skilled chefs.

Arlong Park is a strong fortress with tall walls shaped like sharks. Inside are barracks, a main hall with Arlong’s symbol, and training areas for his crew. The docks let the pirates make fast attacks along the coast. The air feels tense and scary, showing the power and control of Arlong and his crew.

- Humans aren’t allowed inside of arlong park
- The Arlong Pirates will attack any human who enters.
- If you’re part of the Straw Hats faction, you won’t be allowed inside and will be attacked by any Fishman living in Arlong Park, as you are considered an enemy.

Cocoyasi Village is a peaceful tropical village in the East Blue, surrounded by palm trees, mikan groves, and rice fields. It has a small dock for ships and simple homes. The village is known for its quiet charm and scenic views of the ocean.

Loguetown is a bustling port city located on the Polestar Islands in the East Blue. It serves as a vital stop for ships before entering the Grand Line. The city is renowned as the birthplace and execution site of the former Pirate King, Gol D. Roger, earning it the nickname "the town of the beginning and the end.".

Reverse Mountain is a massive peak where the four Blues meet, forming one of the main entrances to the Grand Line. Rivers from each Blue flow up the mountain, meet at the top, and then descend into the Grand Line. Its base, called Twin Cape, marks the start of the Grand Line.
A dark and gloomy island in the Grand Line, once home to the fallen Shikkearu Kingdom. It is renowned for its ominous atmosphere and as the dwelling place of a legendary swordsman.
The main town on Jaya, Mock Town is filled with infamous pirates who frequently brawl with each other.

Whisky Peak is a deceptive town situated on Cactus Island in the Grand Line. The town appears welcoming to pirates, offering celebrations and hospitality. However, its residents are all bounty hunters affiliated with Baroque Works, luring pirates into a trap to capture them.

Little Garden is a prehistoric island in the Grand Line, home to dinosaurs and massive plant life. The island features two giant skulls of Sea Kings as mountains, dense jungles, and active volcanoes. The island's unique environment makes it a dangerous yet fascinating destination.

Drum Island is a snowy, mountainous island in the Grand Line with a harsh winter climate. It was once ruled by a tyrant but now has peaceful leadership. The island is known for its skilled doctors and unique medical knowledge. After its leadership changed, it was renamed the Sakura Kingdom, reflecting its new era of peace.

Alabasta is a vast desert kingdom in the Grand Line, known for its scorching sands and ancient ruins. The kingdom is divided by the Sandora River and features diverse regions, from bustling cities to remote villages. Despite its arid climate, Alabasta boasts a rich history and a strong sense of national pride. It was once embroiled in a civil conflict, but the kingdom has since sought peace and stability.

Jaya is a lawless island in Paradise, popular with pirates. It has tropical forests, giant insects, and elusive South Birds. The main town, Mock Town, is known for its rough pirate-filled atmosphere. The island is famous for its mysterious history and connection to Skypiea.

Skypiea is a floating island high above the Blue Planet, reached via the Knock-Up Stream. It has a tropical climate, with clouds forming much of its land. The island includes Angel Island and Upper Yard, with forests, ancient ruins, and unique resources called dials. Skypiea is home to winged humanoids and holds a long history of conflicts and mysteries.

Long Ring Long Land is an unusual archipelago in the Grand Line, made of ten long islands connected by a path during low tide. It is home to nomadic tribes and features animals with exaggerated sizes, like tall horses and long-legged bears. Its strange geography and inhabitants make it a unique and fascinating place.

Water 7 is a city in the Grand Line, famous for its skilled shipwrights and complex canal system. Built on a series of islands connected by waterways, it resembles a floating Venice. The city is home to the prestigious Galley-La Company and faces challenges like sinking islands and political tensions.

Enies Lobby is a judicial island of the World Government, located above a massive waterfall. It has key structures like the Courthouse, Tower of Justice, and Gates of Justice connecting to other government facilities. The island is a symbol of law and order but operates with secrecy and strict control.

Territory: World Government

Tequila Wolf is a massive stone bridge in the East Blue, under construction for over 700 years. It was built by slaves, including criminals and people from countries refusing to ally with the World Government. The bridge connects several islands, and workers endure harsh conditions with little rest, making it a dangerous and oppressive place.

Territory: World Government
Thriller Bark is the world’s largest ship, originally an island from the West Blue, converted into a pirate ship. It sailed to the Florian Triangle, hiding in thick fog for years.

Sabaody Archipelago is a group of 79 islands near the Red Line, known for its mangrove trees. It is controlled by the World Government, with the Celestial Dragons ensuring strict law enforcement. Pirates are not allowed due to heavy surveillance and security.

Amazon Lily is a jungle island in the Calm Belt, home to the all-female Kuja tribe. The island is protected by the Kuja Pirates and surrounded by Sea Kings, which keeps outsiders away. Men are strictly forbidden, making the island isolated and safe. Its lush forests, hidden villages, and warrior culture make it a mysterious and powerful place in the Calm Belt.

Impel Down is a massive underwater prison in the Calm Belt, owned by the World Government. It holds the most dangerous pirates they capture, divided into multiple levels based on threat. The prison is heavily guarded and surrounded by Sea Kings, making escape nearly impossible. Only authorized individuals may enter, while pirates who haven't been capture are strictly banned.

Territory: World Government

Marineford is a crescent-shaped island in the Grand Line, serving as the headquarters of the Marines. The island is heavily fortified with steel walls, cannons, and a protected bay. At its center stands the large Marine Headquarters building, and the surrounding Marineford Town houses the families of Marine soldiers. Its defenses and strategic location make it a powerful stronghold of the World Government.

Territory: World Government

Baltigo, known as the Island of White Soil, was a remote island in the Grand Line, characterized by its white terrain and towering rock pillars. It served as the secret headquarters of the Revolutionary Army for many years, remaining hidden from the World Government.

Known as the White City, Flevance was a prosperous land rich in Amber Lead, a valuable white ore. The mineral’s toxicity caused a deadly disease that led to the city’s destruction, with only a few survivors escaping the tragedy.
Germa is the world's only seafaring kingdom, formerly part of the World Government. It was once the center of the Germa Empire, formed by the Vinsmoke family's conquest of the North Blue.

The sacred capital of the World Government perched high above the Red Line. Home to the enigmatic Gorosei and the Celestial Dragons, it’s a place of immense power and secrecy. Lavish palaces contrast with ruthless politics, where decisions shape the fate of the world.

World Lore: You begin in Mary Geoise (Marijoa), the Holy Land atop the Red Line. The Celestial Dragons rule here, flaunting unmatched wealth and authority.  
Marie Geoise is cloaked in opulence: grand white terraces, divine statues, and an imposing palace. Commoners and slaves are hidden below, out of sight.  
The World Government is headquartered here; the Gorosei convene daily in secret chambers.  
Straw Hat Pirates and most pirates are banned—adventure-seekers are not welcome.  
The divine sentence system is active: “Forbidden crimes” result in public execution.

The rebuilt stronghold of the Marines after the original Marineford’s destruction. A bustling military base and hub of justice, where Admirals and soldiers prepare to keep the world safe. Its towering walls and advanced defenses make it a symbol of authority and order.

A once-forgotten island where pirates and the World Government clashed in an epic battle. Now mostly lost to time, its history remains shrouded in mystery and whispers of legendary figures who walked its lands. A ghostly reminder of the world’s turbulent past.
A small but prosperous kingdom famous for its sweet delicacies and fruit cultivation. Sorbet Kingdom is a peaceful land with strong ties to the culinary world and trade routes.
An ancient city that resided on Jaya but was later blasted up to Upper Yard by the Knock Up Stream, Known as the City of Gold.

Fish-Man Island is an underwater island beneath the Red Line, home to fish-men and merfolk. The island has several districts, including the Fish-Man District, and is illuminated by the Sunlight Tree Eve. It has a rich culture, including Fish-Man Karate, and has faced invasions and internal conflicts while remaining an important location.
Territory: Ryugu Kingdom

Punk Hazard is a forbidden island divided into two extreme climates: one half scorched in unending flames, the other frozen solid. Once a World Government research facility, it became the site of twisted experiments on humans, animals, and artificial weapons. The island is still scarred by its violent past, filled with toxic gas, mutated creatures, and abandoned labs. It serves as a reminder of the Government’s darker pursuits and the dangers of unchecked science.

Territory: World Government

Dressrosa is a vibrant island known for its toy-making industry and gladiatorial games. Beneath its festive exterior lies a dark secret, with citizens turned into living toys and a corrupt ruler manipulating events from the shadows. The island's rich culture and hidden truths create a complex and intriguing setting.

Territory: The Donquixote family

Zou is a massive island located on the back of a giant elephant, Zunesha. It is home to the Mink Tribe, known for their longevity and strength. The island's unique geography and the mystical presence of Zunesha make it a fascinating and sacred place.

Territory: Mink Tribe

Momoiro Island, known as Peachy Island, is covered in pink plants and creatures, creating a surreal landscape. It is home to the Kamabakka Kingdom, a community proud of its identity and strength. After Baltigo’s fall, the Revolutionary Army made it their new base, with the island serving as both a sanctuary and a stronghold.

Territory: Revolutionary Army

Whole Cake Island is one of the islands in Totto Land, ruled by the Yonko Big Mom. It is a whimsical place where everything is made of sweets, but beneath its sugary surface lies a kingdom built on fear and control. The island's enchanting appearance contrasts sharply with its oppressive regime.

Territory owned by Charlotte Family

Wano is a secluded, samurai-led nation with a rich history and strict isolationist policies. Its unique culture and traditions are deeply rooted in its people, and the island's mountainous terrain and powerful shogunate make it a formidable force in the world.

Onigashima is a remote island located within Wano, serving as the stronghold of the Beasts Pirates. It is characterized by its ominous appearance, dominated by a giant skull-shaped mountain. The island's strategic location and formidable defenses make it a significant base.

Territory owned by Beast Pirates who Captain is Kaidou which is also nickname Kaidou of the Beasts

Egghead Island is a futuristic research facility located in the New World. It is known for its advanced technology and is home to Dr. Vegapunk, the leading scientist of the World Government. The island's cutting-edge innovations and scientific endeavors make it a hub of technological progress.

Territory owned by World Government but also owned by Dr.Vegapunk

Elbaf is a legendary island inhabited by giants, known for their warrior culture and rich history. The island's towering structures and ancient traditions reflect the strength and pride of its people. Elbaf's significance in the world's history adds to its mystique.

Territory by Giants

Lodestar Island is a mysterious location in the Grand Line, known for its unique magnetic field that disrupts compasses. It is a crucial point for navigators, serving as a guidepost for those seeking to reach the final island of the Grand Line.

Laugh Tale is the legendary final island of the Grand Line, shrouded in mystery. It is said to hold the greatest treasure in the world, the One Piece. The island's elusive nature and the secrets it holds make it the ultimate goal for pirates seeking to claim the title of Pirate King.
The easternmost of the four Blues, known as the weakest sea dangerous pirates here are considered low-tier elsewhere.

The western ocean is less explored but feared for its strong underworld presence and infamous crime families. The seas are rough, kingdoms are often at war, and hidden powers lurk beneath the surface.

A northern sea of cold waters and disciplined kingdoms. Known for its strict governments, advanced military forces, and long history of maritime power. Order dominates here, but corruption and ambition hide beneath the surface.

The southern sea is warm, lively, and filled with diverse cultures. It thrives on trade, yet is constantly shaken by wars and rebellions. Freedom and chaos rule these waters, making them a place of both opportunity and danger.

A dangerous strip of ocean that wraps around the globe, known for its unpredictable weather and bizarre islands. It's the true sea of adventure, where the will and strength of any sailor are put to the ultimate test.

The second half of the Grand Line, notorious as the deadliest ocean in existence. It’s a place of raging storms, colossal sea beasts, and constant battles for dominance. Only the strongest navigate these waters—and the rewards are legendary.

Hypnotists are masters of the mind, using subtle cues, gestures, and voice to control, confuse, or influence others. They can manipulate emotions, induce sleep, or bend enemies to their will. Skilled Hypnotists excel in strategy and deception, turning the battlefield in their favor without needing raw strength.
A pair of black-furred gloves equipped with full-length katana blades at the end of each finger. They are used for swift and lethal attacks.
A circular throwing weapon with a sharpened outer edge, used on a string in combination with techniques like hypnosis.

A battered Marine outpost in the New World, G-5 is ruled by chaos and brutality. Its walls are cracked, its halls stained by battles and betrayals, yet its Marines remain fiercely loyal to each other. Reckless and feared, they enforce their own savage brand of justice in seas where order rarely lasts.

A desolate battlefield of jagged cliffs and violent winds, Winner Island carries the scars of countless clashes. The land is barren, the air heavy with the echoes of betrayal, and its rocky shores stained with blood. Crews come here to test their might, but only the ruthless ever leave as victors.

A natural stronghold of cliffs and mist, Navarone Island rises from the seas like a fortress of stone. Its jagged coast makes landing nearly impossible, and hidden channels cut deep into its walls. Sailors whisper of strange echoes in the cliffs, as if the island itself watches intruders.

G-8 Base is a Marine stronghold famed for its discipline and vigilance. Towers crown the cliffs, prisons run deep underground, and warships patrol the hidden harbor. Every soldier moves with purpose under Vice Admiral Jonathan’s command, making the base as sharp and unbreakable as the hedgehog nickname it carries. Pirates who stumble here rarely escape.
A shikomizue-style weapon that resembles a shark and serves as both a musical instrument and a weapon. It can be used to perform sound-based attacks and in combat.

After all the crimes you committed during your years as a pirate, and after facing countless powerful figures with your mighty and formidable crew, you have finally been recognized as one of the Four Emperors. Feared across the entire seas, the Marines dread your name. You have also allied with other powerful figures but remain closely watched by the World Government.

Murakumogiri is a massive, legendary naginata. Its broad, curved blade allows powerful sweeping attacks and thrusts, capable of hitting multiple enemies at once. the weapon became a weapon of unmatched power and precision, able to clash with other legendary blades.

Punishers are a pair of gauntlets equipped with curved, sickle-like blades mounted on axles. you can spin them rapidly, creating shockwaves at the speed of sound, causing internal damage to opponents. These weapons are versatile, capable of both offensive and defensive maneuvers.

Tsuji Shibai looks like a giant ink brush but functions as a katana. It lets the user create drawings and illusions to confuse opponents, while delivering swift and unpredictable strikes. Its creativity and versatility make it deadly in skilled hands.

The On Air Pirates are a chaotic and unpredictable crew that strikes with the power of sound and rhythm. They rely on deception, coordination, and their musical combat style to overwhelm opponents. Their reputation is built on creativity and the fear they instill in those who cannot anticipate their next move, making them both formidable and eccentric.

The Golden Lion Pirates are proud, charismatic, and aggressive. Known for their daring raids and fierce pride, they strike with courage and boldness that few can match. The crew values loyalty above all, and their unity makes them a dangerous force in any confrontation.

They operate both as mercenaries and bounty hunters, using their influence to dominate seas and control territories. Their reputation combines wealth, intimidation, and political maneuvering, making them a formidable faction in the pirate world.
