The Dragon Claw Fist is a formidable martial art that transforms the user's hands into claw-like weapons, channeling the ferocity of a dragon. Enhanced with Armament Haki, each strike delivers crushing force, capable of shattering steel and overwhelming foes with fiery precision.

Eight Impact Fist allows the user to control body vibrations, creating powerful shockwaves with each strike. These reverberating attacks bypass defenses, making them unblockable and capable of shattering even the toughest armor.

Fish-Man Jujutsu is for close fighting. Practitioners grab, throw, and lock enemies using their strength and the opponent’s momentum. Water makes their moves smooth and fast, adding extra power. Masters can control fights with clever holds and throws, taking down bigger or stronger opponents with skill rather than raw power.

Black Leg Style focuses on strong, fast, and acrobatic kicks. The fighter can heat up their legs, adding fire to every strike for extra damage. Skilled users combine speed, jumping attacks, and spinning kicks to hit enemies from different angles. They are hard to predict and can fight multiple enemies at once, using blazing kicks to control the battlefield and overwhelm opponents.

oxfire Style is a swordsmanship technique that lets the user generate and control fire through their sword. Attacks are stronger and can burn or cut through enemies with heat. The fire can also be used defensively, creating barriers or protecting the user. Practitioners move with precision and power, combining sword skill and flames for deadly combat.
Bound not by blood but by unwavering loyalty, your family is a brotherhood forged in battle. Under the banner of Whitebeard, you stand united, ready to defend your own against any threat.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: The Warabide Sword is a special longsword with a blade made from straw. It can be extended and shaped in combat, giving it great versatility. Considered a Meito, it is a high-quality blade known for its unique design and adaptability.

Fish-Man Karate is a martial art of the Fish-Man race. They use water to make their punches and kicks even stronger. Every attack can create waves of force that hit hard and affect the enemy inside and out. The style works well underwater or on land, letting Fish Men fight effectively in any place.

The Sulong Form is a powerful transformation that Minks undergo when exposed to the full moon. Their fur turns white, eyes glow red, and their bodies become larger, faster, and stronger. In this form, their Electro abilities are greatly enhanced, allowing them to deliver electrifying attacks that can shock or paralyze enemies.

This Form will only be activated if you look at the full moon.

Fish-Man Karate is a martial art of the Fish-Man race. They use water to make their punches and kicks even stronger. Every attack can create waves of force that hit hard and affect the enemy inside and out. The style works well underwater or on land, letting Fish Men fight effectively in any place.

A powerful martial arts style known as the Six Powers used by elite fighters. It grants superhuman speed, strength, and agility through techniques like Iron Body, Moon Walk, and Tempest Kick, making the user extremely versatile in combat.

Forged in the fires of a forgotten island and tempered by time, Ace Cutlass is a legendary saber once wielded by the Pirate King himself. Its golden hilt is wrapped in aged, crimson cloth, and its slightly curved blade gleams with a brilliance that seems to hum with power.

A royal bloodline among the World Nobles, the Rimoshifu Family is represented by Saint Killingham, a member of the Holy Knights.  The family is known for its association with the Kirin, a mythical creature of Chinese origin.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: The Bavette Family is another royal bloodline of the World Nobles. About 38 years ago, members participated in the Native Hunting Competition at God Valley, ranking among the top scorers. Details about their current activities and influence remain limited.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: Once a powerful family in Wano Country, the Uzuki Family ruled over the Udon region until the rise of Kurozumi Orochi. Notable members include Uzuki Tempura, the former daimyo of Udon, and Uzuki Namida.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: The Amatsuki Family were staunch supporters of the ruling Kouzuki Family in Wano. Members held the title of daimyo, overseeing various regions.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: The Fugetsu Family was a distinguished samurai lineage from the Kibi region of Wano Country. As staunch supporters of the ruling Kouzuki Family, they held the title of daimyo and were integral to the region's governance and defense.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: The Davy Family is a famous family linked to the mysterious pirate Davy D. Jones, who was cursed to live on the ocean floor. They are one of the most legendary families among those with the "Will of D." Important members of this family include Rocks D. Xebec and Marshall D. Teach. Their family has a strong connection to the sea and its secrets.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: The Peacock Slashers are unique weapons consisting of small, sharp jewels attached to wires. Resembling the eye spots on a peacock's tail feathers, they are designed for precise and rapid attacks. The user loops one end of the wire around a finger and swings the jewel to create a slicing, spinning disk. This allows for swift, graceful strikes that can entangle or cut through opponents with remarkable accuracy.

Kirisame is a curved blade shaped like a shark's dorsal fin, optimized for underwater combat. Its design allows for swift, lethal strikes, making it effective in aquatic environments. The blade's unique curvature aids in cutting through water resistance, enabling the user to move and attack with enhanced speed and efficiency beneath the surface.

The Bruiser Axe is a massive, heavy battle axe renowned for its raw power and devastating impact. Its sheer size and weight make it formidable in combat, capable of delivering crushing blows that can shatter defenses and incapacitate opponents. The axe's design emphasizes brute strength, allowing the user to cleave through obstacles and enemies alike with overwhelming force.

Yakuza Kasen is a high-quality shikomizue crafted with good skill. Combining elegance with lethal precision, it features a balanced blade perfect for swift and deadly strikes. The sword's design allows it to function good as both a cane for support and a concealed weapon for combat.

Kosho is a finely crafted katana classified as one of the 50 Skillful Grade swords. Designed for swift, precise attacks, it emphasizes balance, cutting power, and reliability in combat. The sword's craftsmanship ensures durability and sharpness, allowing the user to execute rapid strikes with confidence and effectiveness.

Kogatana is a small, cross-shaped knife pendant worn as a necklace. Despite its compact size, it serves as a functional weapon, allowing for quick strikes in close-quarters combat. The knife's design emphasizes portability and concealability, enabling the user to carry it discreetly while maintaining readiness for sudden confrontations.

Terry Sword is a uniquely designed sword that combines strength and tradition. Its construction allows for powerful strikes while maintaining balance and agility. The sword's design reflects a blend of durability and elegance, making it suitable for both offensive and defensive maneuvers in combat.

Soto Muso is a large, simple sword consisting only of a blade, hilt, and scabbard, with no handguard. The hilt features dark diamond patterns, emphasizing practicality over ornamentation. Its minimalist design allows for unhindered movement and swift strikes, focusing on the user's skill and precision rather than the weapon's adornments.

Shusui is a legendary black blade classified as one of the 21 Great Grade swords. Renowned for its durability and cutting power, it is a symbol of tradition and mastery in swordsmanship. The sword's dark hue and craftsmanship make it a prized possession, reflecting the rich history and skill of its creators.

Shirauo is a sleek, narrow sword designed for quick, fluid strikes. Its streamlined form allows for precision attacks and nimble handling. The sword's design emphasizes speed and agility, enabling the user to execute rapid maneuvers and outpace opponents in combat.

Raiu is a sword named thunderstrike, built to deliver swift and powerful attacks. Its design emphasizes speed and impact, making it good for aggressive combat. The sword's construction allows for rapid strikes that can overwhelm opponents, reflecting the force and unpredictability of a thunderstorm.

Nakiri Swords are twin blades crafted for fast, coordinated strikes. Their design allows seamless combos and precise attacks in close combat. The swords' balanced construction ensures fluid movements, enabling the user to execute rapid sequences of strikes with accuracy and efficiency.

Omatsuri Island is a deceptive resort island that lures pirates with promises of relaxation. In reality, it serves as a trap orchestrated by Baron Omatsuri and his man-eating plant, the Lily Carnation. The island's inhabitants are creations of the plant, and the so called resort activities are designed to feed it.

Elegia is a lively island called the Island of Music where music and shows are very important. The buildings and streets are made to make music sound better, with lots of stages for performances.  One day, all the people of Elegia randomly disappeared without a trace, leaving the island quiet even though it was full of music before.

Weatheria is an artificial sky island inhabited by researchers specializing in meteorology. The island's technology includes devices like the Wind Knot and Weather Ball, which allow for the manipulation and study of weather patterns.

Merveille, called the Hidden Land in the Clouds, is a group of islands floating in the sky in the Grand Line. The islands float because of the Fuwa Fuwa no Mi. Merveille has many different places, like green forests, tall mountains, and old ruins, showing its long and eventful history.

Ballon Terminal is a ruined city on a sky island, located above the New World. It is said that Ballon Terminal is suspended in the sky due to the multitude of helium balloons below it. The city is situated 10,000 meters above the Kid Pirates' base, captained by Eustass Kid. The island's unique elevation and structure make it a notable location in the sky.

Torino Kingdom, often referred to as the Isle of Treasure, is a small island in the South Blue. At its center stands a massive tree, and the island is inhabited by large birds known as Masukeredomo Goayu Birds. The human inhabitants, known as the Torines, live in harmony with these birds, having been tamed by them over time.

Minion Island is a large, snow covered island located in the North Blue, northeast of Swallow Island and east of Rubeck Island. The island's landscape is dominated by several hills, one of which houses a ghost town and a mansion at its peak. The climate is cold and snowy, contributing to the island's desolate atmosphere. Despite its harsh environment, Minion Island's unique features make it a notable location in the North Blue.

Swallow Island is in the North Blue and is easy to spot because of its unique shape. The island and its central mountain look like a swallow bird, with trees covering the mountain to make it look even more like a bird. Most of the land is mountains, which are home to many plants and animals. The swallow-shaped mountain is the main feature and makes the island stand out on maps.

The Lily Carnation Wielder has formed a symbiotic bond with the legendary Lily Carnation, a monstrous plant capable of controlling life and reanimating the dead. This connection allows the wielder to manipulate life forces, summon reanimated beings, and wield plant-based constructs in combat. While powerful, the bond is a curse as the plant’s insatiable hunger for life constantly threatens the wielder.

The Foxy Pirates are a mischievous and cunning crew, notorious for their clever tricks and schemes. Famous for orchestrating the Davy Back Fight, they often outsmart stronger opponents using games and deception rather than brute force. Their unpredictable tactics and flamboyant style make them both feared and ridiculed across the seas.

You haven’t made a ripple in the world. You're either just starting out or purposely flying under the radar. To the world, you're harmless for now. But every legend starts with silence.
You're making noise. Small towns whisper your name. Whether hero or menace, people have begun to take notice. A few minor factions might even fear you. You're officially on the world’s watchlist.

You're considered a serious threat. Your actions have shaken regions, destroyed enemy camps, or defied powerful figures. Governments and warlords alike are keeping tabs. Your power is undeniable, and you're climbing fast.

Nations whisper your name in council rooms. Heroes prepare for your arrival; villains want you as an ally or target. You're either a notorious warrior, a major rebel, or the wildest card alive. Wherever you go, balance breaks.

You’ve changed the course of wars or wiped out powerful enemies. Your strength rivals captains, emperors, or faction leaders. The world either wants to kill you… or crown you. You're too big to ignore, and too dangerous to control.

You are feared by islands governments and the official world governments. Your power bends landscapes, and your choice shape nations. armies prepare when you appear, and entire factions may fall by your will. You are a threat to world stability itself.

You are no longer just a legend—you are a living calamity. Your name is written into the fate of islands. Whether you're a liberator or conqueror, your existence sends ripples through time. entire dimensions whisper of your coming. Only the strongest dare speak your name.

Start the adventure with a battle, as if they're fighting someone powerful.

This bounty range is reserved for individuals whose power, influence, and danger level rival or surpass the likes of the former Yonko. these are titanic figure who shake the balance of the world either by brute strength, world-altering Devil Fruits, legendary combat prowess, or fearsome ideologies that threaten the very foundation of the World Government.

Start the adventure with a battle, as if they're fighting someone powerful.

These bounties were placed on Marine Captains and Commodores by the Cross Guild. They lead small fleets or bases and are not the strongest, but they are still skilled fighters. Many new hunters and pirates target them first to prove themselves and earn quick rewards.

These bounties were given to Marine Rear Admirals by the Cross Guild. These Marines are experienced and known for leading tough battles. Hunting them is difficult, but the rewards are greater. Pirates also pursue them, hoping to take down respected leaders and make a name for themselves.

These bounties were set on marine Vice Admirals by the Cross Guild, though even lower-ranking Marines who have made a name for themselves can be marked. They are feared across the seas, known for their strength and skill in battle. Taking one down is a challenge, but the reward and fame are legendary. Pirates and bounty hunters alike see them as prized targets, yet few who dare to hunt them ever live to tell the tale.

These Bounties were Placed on Admirals by the cross Guild. They are feared across the seas by Pirates and can change wars by themselves. Fighting one is almost certain death, but the riches and glory tempt pirates and hunters alike. Only the boldest dare to try.

This bounty is for the Marine Fleet Admiral, the top target of the Cross Guild. Even the bravest pirates are afraid to go after them, because they are the symbol of Marine power and can destroy fleets easily. Only the strongest Pirates would try to fight them, risking everything for a reward that could make them legendary, but very few who try ever come back.

Honestly Impact is a fighting style that uses hard, accurate punches. Each hit is meant to do the most damage, break an opponent’s guard, or stop several attackers at once. It focuses on strong muscles and quick reactions, so it works well in face-to-face fights while staying controlled and precise.

Life Return lets a person control their body very carefully. They can make their muscles, bones, and movements stronger, faster, and more flexible. This control helps them move quickly, recover from injuries, and perform amazing tricks in battle.

Okama Kenpo is a flashy fighting style that mixes dance-like moves with strong kicks. It focuses on speed, flexibility, and surprising opponents. By moving in unusual ways, the fighter can attack and dodge at the same time, keeping enemies off balance.

Gran Tesoro is a huge ship and the biggest entertainment city in the world. It was ruled by Gild Tesoro, a very rich man who used to be a slave of the World Nobles. He controlled almost 20% of the world’s money and made Gran Tesoro a place full of luxury, gambling, and fun.

Delta Island is a large island in the New World, known for hosting big pirate events. It has a central lake, three rivers, and tall cliffs where spectators can watch. Harbors and small towns are built along the coasts. Underground tunnels run beneath the island, used for secret planning, it's where many pirates meets for a huge treasure hunt.

Firs Island is a rocky island with a tall, active volcano. It is one of the three Endpoints in the New World, acting like a strong seal to hold back underground magma. There is a Marine base under the volcano with heavy security. If the island is damaged, the volcano could erupt and cause serious destruction.

Kazanonsen is a busy town built near a big, active volcano. Hot springs are found all around, and many people visit to relax. The town mixes old-style buildings with newer ones, making it lively and colorful. Even with the volcano nearby, life goes on and the town is popular.

Piriodo is a lonely, rocky island with a volcano in the middle. It is the third Endpoint, helping to block and control the underground magma. The land is rough and empty, making it hard to live on. Its isolation adds extra protection to the Endpoints.
Uses Conqueror’s Haki to weaken morale, pressure groups, and suppress enemy power.
Warriors who’ve awakened the ability to use Haki spiritual energy used to enhance strength, predict attacks, or dominate the will of others.
Specialized in evasion and prediction using advanced Observation Haki.

Supreme King Haki is the power to overpower others using pure will. When someone uses it, a strong pressure spreads out from them. People with weak spirits can freeze up, become scared, or fall unconscious without being touched. It can affect many people at once and shows who has the stronger will. Only very rare individuals are born with this power.

Armament Haki allows the user to surround themselves or a weapon with their own spiritual energy, effectively creating an invisible armor that boosts defense and offensive power. It also lets them touch or damage opponents who are normally immune, like those with certain Devil Fruit powers.

A warrior who has transcended normal combat by mastering the spiritual force known as Haki. They wield Observation Haki to sense opponents and incoming danger, Armament Haki to harden their body and attacks beyond steel, and Conqueror’s Haki to exert their will over the weak-minded and clash with the world’s strongest. A Haki Master is very good with haki and their power lies in pure will, sharpened instinct, and unshakable spirit.

Observation Haki is the power to sense what is happening around you, even if you cannot see it. It lets you feel the presence, strength, and emotions of others. With this, you can read movements, dodge attacks, and notice danger before it happens. It is like having a sharper awareness of everything nearby, helping you react faster in battle.

Hachinosu is an island known as the Pirate Island in the New World. It has a huge skull-shaped rock in the middle, and the town is built around it. Many pirates live here because there are no laws and no one to stop crime. It used to be the home of the Rocks Pirates, and now it is the base of the Blackbeard Pirates. It is a rough and dangerous place where only the strong survive.

The All Blue is a legendary sea whispered about by chefs and pirates alike. It is said to be the only place in the world where the waters of the North Blue, South Blue, East Blue and West Blue all meet, and where every kind of fish from every sea can be found.

Underworld of elbaf is a harsh, bitter‑cold realm at the base of the towering Tree Adam, in the lowest layer of the giant island of elbaf. Sunlight barely reaches the ground, wild beasts roam freely, and exiles or dangerous individuals are sent here as if to their grave

This upgraded weather‑staff was forged from the original Clima‑Tact with advanced Dial‑technology and refined design, making it far more powerful and precise. It allows the wielder to call forth heat, cold, electricity and storms with greater destructive force and control than before.

A further evolution of the weather‑staff that combines Weatheria technology with compact design and immense versatility. It can extend and contract at will, form varied weather phenomena, and even perform utility tasks beyond combat. This version transforms the staff into a true magic‑wand of climate manipulation.

With the Art of Weather, the user becomes a master of the sky, sea and storms. They wield a specialized weather‑staff and combine knowledge of winds, temperature, clouds and storms to manipulate the battlefield. They can summon gusts, clouds, lightning or rain to turn the tide of combat, using both cunning and power.

A Colors Trap Artist is a fighter who uses special paint to control people’s emotions. By drawing small symbols in different colors, they can make enemies laugh, cry, calm down, or even turn on their own crew. The colors work like tricks on the mind, so the artist doesn’t need strength or weapons. Their power comes from their brush, their paint, and how fast they can draw.

The class is for people with no special abilities or combat training. They can’t use any special techniques. They are just ordinary humans relying on their own strength, speed, and cleverness to survive.

Domi Reversi is a forbidden power that lets someone place a target into a strange state where their free will is erased, taking away their logic and reason and turning the target into a demon and force the target to listen to the user command. In return, the target gains massive strength, a body that is extremely hard to kill, and a form of near-immortality that lets them survive almost anything.

You were transformed into a demon by a mysterious ruler who oversees the entire World Government. Because of this, you gained a form of immortality that lets you survive almost anything, along with a massive boost in strength. However, the price is steep, you lose your free will, your soul, and everything that once made you who you were. In exchange, you become a being of overwhelming, unstoppable power.

You were transformed into a toy by someone who wielded the Hobby-Hobby Fruit. Because of this, everyone who ever knew you including your friends and family has completely forgotten you, as if every memory of you was erased. Your body has turned into wood, but you can still move, speak, and think just like before.

The Moon is a giant, mysterious rock floating high above the Blue Planet. Long ago, it was home to an advanced civilization called the Moon People, who built machines and cities that reached for the stars. Today, the ruins of their cities lie silent, glowing under the moonlight, filled with forgotten treasures and dangerous relics. Few dare to explore it, but those who do may uncover secrets lost to time and perhaps even powers no one on the Blue Planet has ever seen.

Spider Miles is a strange and chaotic town built on piles of scrap, broken machines, and twisting metal streets. The place hums with activity, from blacksmiths forging weapons from leftover metal to shadowy figures hiding in corners, making deals that nobody else dares to witness. Pirates and thieves often come here to find rare parts or recruit skilled fighters, but outsiders must watch every step the streets can be as dangerous as they are full of opportunity.

Downs is a dark, forgotten island covered in massive heaps of garbage and ruined buildings. The air is thick and heavy, carrying the stench of decay, and survival here is a test of skill and cunning. This island was once home to gangs and outlaws, making it a place where only the strong thrive. Those who venture into Downs either come looking for power, treasure, or secrets buried deep within the island’s twisted alleys and mountains of waste.

Rakesh is a small port town on the edge of the North Blue, bustling with docks, merchant ships, and shady dealings. It has a rough charm, with narrow streets lined with warehouses, taverns, and hidden back-alleys. Pirates often stop here to trade, recruit crew members, or lay low from the World Government. Though small, Rakesh is full of stories, secret plots, and hidden dangers waiting for those bold enough to explore it.

After many years of hard work, tough missions, and gaining respect from everyone around you, you have finally become an Admiral in the marines. This is one of the highest ranks in the Marines, right under the Fleet Admiral. As an Admiral, your power is known across the world. Pirates fear you, nations watch you, and the Marines trust you to protect the seas and follow your orders. Your actions can change everything, and your voice carries great weight wherever you go.

Through strong effort, loyalty, and skill, you earned the rank of Vice Admiral in the marines. This rank is just below Admiral, making you one of the most trusted leaders in the Marines. You lead large groups of Marines, take on dangerous missions, and keep order in the seas. Many look up to you, and your choices can decide the outcome of important battles. With more experience, you may one day rise even higher.

A brutal blade what was animated by a Mythical Zoan Devil Fruit to take the form of a three headed Dog. The sword’s spine splits into three sharpened fangs near the guard, giving every swing a ripping, tearing effect. When the user channels their fighting spirit into it, the heads roar with a burst of energy, creating shockwaves that feel like a monster lunging forward. This weapon is feared because every strike feels like being attacked by multiple blades at once.

A sword that has been animated by the Zou Zou no Mi, allowing it to transform into an elephant or a large elephant-sword hybrid. In battle, Funkfreed can stretch its trunk, stomp the ground, or swing its body like a massive metal club. This weapon is both loyal and wild; it chooses when to fight alongside its wielder and when to act on instinct. Warriors who earn its respect gain a partner stronger than most beasts.

Sphinx Island is located in the New World, a remote and rugged territory far from the World Government’s tighter control. The land is rocky and mountainous, with narrow valleys and small villages scattered among the cliffs. The people who live there are poor and humble; the island was once abandoned by the World Government because its residents couldn’t pay the Heavenly Tribute.

Spa Island is located on a floating resort that travels across the Grand Line. The entire structure is built for relaxation, filled with warm baths, sparkling pools, luxury rooms, and colorful attractions. Visitors come to rest and unwind, but beneath the cheerful atmosphere lies quiet secrets and mysterious guests who use the island as a safe place to hide, scheme, or make secret deals far away from Marine eyes.

Gray Terminal is located on the edge of the Goa Kingdom on Dawn Island. It is a huge wasteland filled with broken ships, piles of metal, and endless mountains of trash. Smoke floats through the air while scavengers dig for anything valuable to survive. The area is harsh, lawless, and dangerous, but its hidden corners make it a refuge for rebels, runaways, and anyone trying to disappear from the eyes of the world.

A normal human with no Devil Fruit powers. They rely purely on physical strength, skill, intelligence, and determination. Through hard training and experience, they've become a capable fighter able to stand their ground in a world full of monsters and abilities.

This fruit turns the user’s body into rubber, letting them stretch, bend, and move in ways normal people can’t. Their punches and kicks can reach far distances, and their rubber body helps them take strong hits without breaking. As the user trains, they can unlock special battle forms called Gears. Each Gear boosts them in a different way, giving more strength, speed, or flexibility

Kano Country also known as the Country of Flowers, is a proud and historic land in the West Blue, with gentle hills, flowing rivers, wide plains, and small forests hiding secret paths. Wooden houses, stone pathways, and bamboo groves give the country an ancient, traditional feel. Its people are tough, loyal, and honor-bound, with famous families like the Chinjao Family shaping its history.

The Calm Belt is a strange and deadly sea zone that stretches along the north and south edges of the Grand Line. The waters and skies are eerily still no wind blows, no currents flow, and no waves rise, making normal ships almost impossible to sail. But the calm hides a deadly secret: massive Sea Kings roam beneath the surface, attacking any ship that enters. The Calm Belt acts as a natural barrier, protecting the Grand Line from ordinary travelers.

Shodai Kitetsu is a cursed, legendary katana of the highest quality, known for its incredible cutting power and precision. Its flame-shaped hamon and four-lobed guard make it instantly recognizable. While wielded by a skilled swordsman, it can slice through almost anything, but its curse brings danger to anyone not strong enough to control it. Those who take up Shodai Kitetsu gain immense power, but must also face the risk of the sword’s dark fate if they fail to master it.

Nidai Kitetsu is the second-generation Kitetsu sword, famous for its sharpness, balance, and reliability in battle. Its purple-edge blade and golden tsuba make it both deadly and elegant. Like all Kitetsu swords, it carries a curse that tests the luck and skill of its wielder. In the hands of a capable fighter, Nidai Kitetsu is a legendary weapon that is still feared for its cutting ability and deadly precision.

Ame no Habakiri is a legendary katana said to have the power to split even the heavens. Its blade represents unmatched strength and mastery, able to cut through almost anything with ease. Wielding this sword marks a fighter as elite, commanding respect and recognition across the world. In battle, Ame no Habakiri allows its user to face even the strongest foes, leaving a lasting legacy with every strike.

Aokiji is a former Admiral of the marines, once known for his calm justice and overwhelming ice powers. After his fateful duel with Akainu, he left the organization he had served for years and drifted through the world with no clear allegiance. His mastery over the Ice-Ice Fruit allows him to freeze oceans, create massive ice constructs, and shape a spear of solid frost as his primary weapon. Skilled in both Armament and Observation Haki, he remains one of the most dangerous men alive. Though he now stands among the Blackbeard Pirates on Hachinosu, his true intentions remain mysterious, leaving many unsure if he is an ally, an enemy, or something in between.

The Five Elders are the supreme council that governs the world, ruling from the sacred heights of Mary Geoise with absolute authority. Seen by the public as the highest power within the World Government, they command the Marines, Cipher Pol, and every agency that maintains order across the seas. Their influence alone functions as their greatest weapon, capable of shaping nations, erasing histories, and deciding the fate of entire kingdoms. Though their individual abilities remain hidden, their connection to Imu grants them a level of power far beyond political command. As Celestial Dragons chosen to stand above all others, they move the world from the shadows, acting as the silent hands that direct every major event from the Room of Authority.

Brook is the lively soul of the Straw Hat Pirates, a walking skeleton brought back from death by the power of the Revive-Revive Fruit. Once the leader of the Rumbar Pirates, he spent fifty long years wandering alone after his crew perished, sustained only by the hope of keeping a promise to his friend Laboon. His cane sword and elegant fencing style blend seamlessly with his ability to manipulate soul energy, allowing him to strike with chilling precision. Though his Haki remains uncertain, his spirit is unwavering. As the musician of the crew, he fills their journey with music and laughter, sailing alongside them aboard their ship as both a swordsman and a treasured companion.

Gunko is a formidable member of the God’s Knights, carrying herself with the poise and authority expected of someone born into the prestigious Manmayer family of World Nobles. Gifted with the Arrow-Arrow Fruit, she shapes arrows from pure force, using them not only as projectiles but as constructs that bind, strike, and even enhance her own movements. Her arrival on any battlefield is marked by a surge of power described as black lightning, hinting at an exceptional mastery of Haki. Having taken part in historic events such as the God Valley Incident, she stands as one of the most elite protectors of the ruling order. Now present on Elbaf, she remains a silent but deadly force acting on behalf of the World Nobles and the God’s Knights.

Alvida is a pirate who completely remade herself after consuming the Slip-Slip Fruit, shedding her former appearance and gaining the ability to let any attack glide harmlessly off her skin. Armed with her heavy iron mace, she mixes beauty with brutality, striking with confidence and precision. After her transformation, she chose to ally herself with Buggy, eventually becoming part of the rising power known as Cross Guild. Now stationed on Karai Bari Island, she moves with effortless grace and untouchable arrogance, using her Devil Fruit ability and her fierce will to secure her place in the new age of piracy.

Kuro is a cunning former pirate captain who abandoned his old life by assuming the identity of a quiet, loyal butler. Behind that calm mask, he hid lethal intent, plotting to murder Kaya and escape with her fortune. Known for his exceptional stealth and blistering speed, he fought using his razor-sharp Cat Claws, striking faster than most could react. After the downfall of the Black Cat Pirates, he vanished from the seas, leaving his whereabouts unknown. Whether lurking somewhere in the East Blue or hiding far from his past crimes, Kuro remains a shadow from an era of deception and cold ambition.

Don Krieg is the ruthless captain of the Krieg Pirates, feared across the East Blue for his overwhelming arsenal and unbreakable heavy armor. Known as a man who values firepower above all else, he overwhelms opponents with explosives, spears, poison gas, and sheer numbers. His disastrous attempt to conquer the Grand Line left him broken and desperate, ultimately leading to his defeat at the hands of Luffy. Since then, his fate has become uncertain, with many believing he remains somewhere in the East Blue or possibly imprisoned. Even so, his name still carries the echo of a man who once sought to dominate the seas through fear and force.

Arlong is a fierce Sawshark Fish-Man whose raw strength and ruthless ambition once made him the terror of the East Blue. Wielding his sharpened saw-blade nose as a deadly weapon, he ruled over Nami’s village with cruelty, extorting its people while dreaming of Fish-Man supremacy. His hatred for humans fueled every action he took, driving him to build an empire through fear alone. After his defeat, he was captured and sent to Impel Down, where he is believed to be held deep within Level 6. Even imprisoned, Arlong’s name remains tied to one of the darkest eras the East Blue ever endured.

Smoker is a relentless Marine Vice Admiral whose pursuit of justice is as stubborn as the smoke he commands. Through the power of the Smoke-Smoke Fruit, he can dissolve into vapor, restrain opponents, and move across the battlefield with swift, shifting forms. Armed with his seastone-tipped jitte, he specializes in catching Devil Fruit users off guard, forcing them into submission through sheer force and discipline. Skilled in both Armament and Observation Haki, he stands as one of the Marines’ most persistent hunters. From his post at the G-5 Marine Base in the New World, he continues chasing pirates—especially Luffy—with an unwavering sense of duty that refuses to fade.

Monkey D. Dragon is the elusive and formidable Supreme Commander of the Revolutionary Army, a man whose very name inspires fear within the World Government. Though his abilities remain shrouded in mystery, his presence alone signals a force capable of shaking nations. Known as Luffy’s father, he carries a legacy bound to the future of the world, yet chooses to stand in the shadows, directing the global fight against oppression. He wields no weapon and reveals nothing of his potential Haki, making his true power a matter of speculation and growing legend. Residing in the Kamabakka Kingdom on Momoiro Island, he continues to guide the Revolutionary Army in its mission to topple the world’s greatest tyranny.

Crocus is the calm and seasoned lighthouse keeper of Twin Cape, a man whose medical expertise once served the legendary Roger Pirates. After his time on the Pirate King’s ship, he chose a quieter life, dedicating himself to caring for Laboon and guiding ships safely into the Grand Line. Armed only with a harpoon and years of experience, he stands as a steadfast guardian at Reverse Mountain. Though he holds no Haki and belongs to no faction, his past with Roger and his deep compassion for Laboon make him a quiet but important figure whose presence still echoes with the history of a bygone era.

Laboon is a massive and gentle whale whose loyalty has endured longer than most lifetimes. Using his immense strength and powerful headbutts, he once challenged the Red Line itself, desperate to reunite with the Rumbar Pirates who promised to return for him. Decades have passed, yet he continues to wait at Twin Cape, watched over by Crocus and cherished by those who learn his story. With no Haki and no desire for battle, Laboon’s greatest power is his unwavering heart, making him a beloved companion tied forever to the memory of the Rumbar Pirates.

Igaram is the loyal and resourceful captain of the Alabasta Royal Guard, dedicating his life to protecting Princess Vivi and the stability of their kingdom. Known for his elaborate disguises and unexpected tricks, he once infiltrated Baroque Works under the alias Mr. 8. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his ingenuity more than makes up for it—most famously shown through the machine gun cleverly hidden within his towering wig. Fiercely devoted and willing to risk everything for Vivi and Alabasta, he remains stationed in the kingdom, standing as a steadfast shield against any threat that dares approach.

Miss Monday is a brute-force fighter once stationed in Whiskey Peak as a Frontier Agent of Baroque Works. Disguised as a nun to deceive travelers, she relied not on tricks or weapons but on her overwhelming physical strength, capable of overpowering most foes with sheer power alone. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, her durability and determination made her a reliable enforcer within the organization. After Baroque Works collapsed, her whereabouts became uncertain, with most believing she remained somewhere in the East Blue. Even so, her fierce spirit and raw strength continue to define her reputation.

Mr. 9 is an energetic and determined Frontier Agent of Baroque Works, best known for his acrobatic fighting style and unusual choice of weaponry. Armed with metal bats and hidden explosives, he blends reckless creativity with fierce loyalty, especially when working alongside his former partner, Miss Monday. Though he lacks a Devil Fruit or Haki, his agility and persistence made him a dependable combatant within the organization. After the fall of Baroque Works, his fate became unclear, with sightings suggesting he remained somewhere in the East Blue. Despite his uncertain future, his spirited nature and bold antics still leave a memorable mark.

Mr. 5 is a deadly officer agent of Baroque Works, feared for his mastery of the Bomb-Bomb Fruit which allows him to detonate any part of his body at will. Known for his creative combat style, he often combines his explosive power with unconventional weapons, including his infamous explosive snot, to catch enemies off guard. As an assassination expert, he executed missions with precision and cunning, striking fear into those who opposed the organization. Last seen in Alabasta, he remains a dangerous figure whose skill with explosives defines both his reputation and his legacy.

Miss Valentine is a cunning officer agent of Baroque Works, renowned for her ability to manipulate her weight at will using the Kilo-Kilo Fruit. Wielding an umbrella both as a weapon and a tool to enhance her combat strategies, she moves with deceptive agility despite her changing mass. Partnered with Mr. 5, she executed missions with precision, using her unique powers to outmaneuver and overwhelm her targets. Last seen in Alabasta, she remains a formidable operative whose cleverness and versatility make her a memorable member of the organization.

Dorry is a legendary giant warrior from Elbaf, whose immense strength and unwavering resolve have defined a century-long duel on Little Garden. Wielding a massive sword, he battles with the honor and discipline of a true Elbaf warrior, each strike carrying the weight of his people’s legacy. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his raw power and experience make him a fearsome opponent to any who challenge him. His enduring fight, now lasting over 100 years, stands as a testament to his dedication, courage, and the indomitable spirit of Elbaf.

Brogy is a formidable giant warrior from Elbaf, known for his immense strength and skill with a massive axe. As the long-standing rival of Dorry, he has engaged in a duel that has spanned over a century, each battle showcasing his unwavering determination and the pride of his people. Though he wields no Devil Fruit or Haki, his sheer size, power, and combat experience make him a terrifying force on Little Garden. Brogy’s enduring rivalry stands as a symbol of honor, courage, and the unyielding spirit of the giants of Elbaf.

Mr. 3 is a cunning and strategic officer agent of Baroque Works, notorious for his ability to manipulate wax through the Wax-Wax Fruit. Using candle-based traps and solid wax constructs, he outsmarts and ensnares opponents with precision and creativity. Known for his deceptive tactics, he thrives on planning and trickery rather than brute force. After the fall of Baroque Works, he allied himself with Buggy, now operating from Karai Bari Island, where his intelligence and resourcefulness continue to make him a dangerous and unpredictable figure.

Miss Goldenweek is a young and enigmatic officer agent of Baroque Works, whose artistic talents hide a dangerous power. Using her Color Trap ability, she manipulates the emotions of others through the vibrant paint from her brush, turning creativity into a weapon. Though she wields no Devil Fruit or Haki, her skill in psychological manipulation makes her a formidable opponent despite her youthful appearance. Last seen in the Alabasta region, she remains a mysterious figure whose colorful illusions and cunning tactics leave a lasting impression on anyone who crosses her path.

Doctor Kureha is a legendary medical genius of Drum Island, whose age-defying vitality and unparalleled knowledge have earned her worldwide renown. Armed with needles, potions, and decades of experience, she has saved countless lives and serves as the mentor to Chopper, guiding him in both medicine and wisdom. Though she wields no Devil Fruit or Haki, her intellect, skill, and sharp wit make her a force to be reckoned with in any medical emergency. Residing in the Sakura Kingdom on Drum Island, she continues to practice her craft with energy and determination that belie her years, remaining a cornerstone of the island’s well-being.

Dalton is the strong and honorable King of the Sakura Kingdom on Drum Island, whose loyalty and courage have defined his rise from former guard under Wapol to revolutionary leader. Empowered by the Ox-Ox Fruit, he can transform into a massive bison, amplifying his already formidable strength in combat. Though he possesses no Haki, his bravery, skill, and steadfast sense of justice make him a respected ruler and protector of his people. Standing as both king and warrior, Dalton continues to defend Drum Island with unwavering determination and heart.

Wapol is a once-greedy monarch of the Black Drum Kingdom, notorious for his selfish rule and insatiable appetite. With the power of the Munch-Munch Fruit, he can consume and merge objects, often using this ability to create bizarre and destructive weaponry. After being overthrown, he reinvented himself as the CEO of Evil Black Drum, continuing his schemes and maintaining influence through cunning and technology. Though he possesses no Haki, his ambition and resourcefulness make him a persistent and unpredictable force. Now present at Mary Geoise during the Reverie, Wapol remains a reminder of the dangers of unchecked greed and ingenuity.

Nefertari Vivi is the courageous princess of Alabasta, known for her intelligence, combat skill, and unwavering dedication to her people. Wielding her distinctive Peacock Slashers, she blends elegance and precision to defend those she cares for. To protect her kingdom, she once infiltrated Baroque Works under the alias Miss Wednesday, navigating dangerous deception with grace and courage. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, her leadership, strategy, and bravery make her a respected figure both in Alabasta and among her allies. She is currently present at Mary Geoise during the Reverie, representing her kingdom with dignity and resolve.

Crocodile is a cunning and ruthless former Warlord of the Sea, once the secret leader of Baroque Works and a master of manipulation. Empowered by the Sand-Sand Fruit, he can create and control sand to bury, slice, or dehydrate his enemies, making him a deadly force in battle. Wielding a hooked weapon tipped with poison or a blade, he combines his Devil Fruit power with lethal precision. Though Armament Haki is implied post-timeskip, his strategic mind and experience make him as dangerous without it. Now aligned with Cross Guild on Karai Bari Island, Crocodile continues to exert his influence with calculated strength and unwavering ambition.

Bon Clay, also known as Mr. 2, is a flamboyant and loyal former agent of Baroque Works, famed for his mastery of Okama Kenpo and the transformative powers of the Clone-Clone Fruit, which allows him to perfectly mimic anyone he touches. Beyond his combat abilities, his heart and loyalty have forged deep friendships, most notably with Luffy, proving that courage and camaraderie define him as much as skill. Now serving as Vice-Warden of New Kama Land within Impel Down’s Level 5.5, he uses both his martial arts and Devil Fruit powers to protect and inspire those under his care. Though he lacks Haki, his charisma, agility, and cunning make him a formidable and unforgettable figure.

Miss Doublefinger is a skilled officer agent of Baroque Works, recognized for her precision and deadly combat abilities. Wielding sharp, blade-like fingers enhanced by her powers, she attacks with speed and accuracy, making her a dangerous opponent in close quarters. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, her agility, strength, and tactical mind make her a formidable enforcer within the organization. Last seen operating under Baroque Works, she remains a calculating and lethal presence, capable of turning any situation to her advantage with deadly efficiency.

Mr. 4 is a powerful officer agent of Baroque Works, known for his immense strength and unyielding endurance in battle. Wielding a massive hammer, he delivers devastating blows capable of crushing nearly anything in his path. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his brute force, resilience, and tactical use of his weapon make him a dangerous combatant and a reliable enforcer within the organization. Last seen in Alabasta, he remains a formidable figure whose presence on the battlefield inspires both fear and respect.

Miss Merry Christmas is a formidable officer agent of Baroque Works, known for her immense strength and towering presence. Skilled in physical combat, she wields her massive size and power to crush enemies with overwhelming force. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, her durability, strategic mind, and relentless determination make her a feared combatant within the organization. Last seen in Alabasta, she remains an imposing figure whose loyalty and ferocity define her role among Baroque Works’ elite agents.

Lassoo is a unique and dangerous weapon of Baroque Works, a firearm transformed into a living dog by the Dog-Dog Fruit: Gun Model. Capable of independent movement and intelligence, Lassoo attacks with exploding baseballs and other inventive projectiles, blending animal agility with deadly firepower. Though it possesses no Haki, its Devil Fruit abilities make it a highly unpredictable and formidable opponent on the battlefield. Last seen in Alabasta, Lassoo serves as both a loyal companion to its handler and a lethal instrument of Baroque Works’ operations.

Name: Pell
Fruit/Ability: Falcon-Falcon Fruit
Weapon: Sword
Haki Type: None
Background story: Guardian of Alabasta, known as the “Strongest Warrior”
Role/Rank: Guardian
Faction: Alabasta Kingdom
Island Location: Alabasta

Chaka is the loyal captain of the Alabasta Royal Guard, devoted to protecting King Cobra and the kingdom at all costs. With the power of the Jackal-Jackal Fruit, he can transform into a jackal, enhancing his speed, agility, and combat effectiveness. Wielding a sword with skill and precision, he combines his Devil Fruit abilities with masterful swordsmanship to defend his homeland. Though he possesses no Haki, his unwavering loyalty, leadership, and dedication make him a formidable protector, ensuring the safety and honor of Alabasta.

King Cobra is the wise and benevolent ruler of Alabasta, known for his political acumen and unwavering dedication to his people. Though he wields no weapon, Devil Fruit powers, or Haki, his leadership, diplomacy, and strategic mind allow him to navigate threats both internal and external, striving to preserve the peace and prosperity of his kingdom. Having faced crises such as Baroque Works’ infiltration, he remains a respected and honorable figure. Last seen at Mary Geoise during the Reverie, King Cobra continues to represent Alabasta with dignity and a steadfast commitment to justice.

Koza is the fearless leader of Alabasta’s rebels and a loyal ally of Princess Vivi, with whom he shares a childhood bond. Skilled in desert combat, he wields dual sabers with speed and precision, leading his forces with strategy and courage. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his determination, leadership, and dedication to protecting Alabasta make him a formidable figure on the battlefield. Now allied with the royal family, Koza continues to defend his homeland and support Vivi in preserving the peace and prosperity of the kingdom.

Toto is a humble and kind-hearted civilian of Alabasta, known as the father of Koza. Armed only with a shovel, he has shown courage and resourcefulness when aiding many known Pirates, Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his bravery, loyalty, and willingness to protect others make him a respected figure among his community. Remaining in Alabasta, Toto continues to live a simple life while supporting the safety and well-being of those around him.

Eyelashes is the spirited and loyal pet of Princess Vivi, a super spot-billed duck known for remarkable speed and agility. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his quickness and intelligence make him a reliable companion and mount for Vivi during travel and combat situations. Always attentive and protective, Eyelashes serves as both a friend and ally, faithfully accompanying the princess across Alabasta and proving that even the smallest creatures can have a big impact.

Bellamy is a daring pirate captain known for his mockery of others’ dreams and his explosive spring-based combat. Empowered by the Spring-Spring Fruit, he can transform his limbs into powerful springs, delivering rapid and devastating attacks with precision and force. Wielding only his fists enhanced by his Devil Fruit, he complements his power with post-timeskip mastery of Armament Haki. Once a rival to many in the New World, he later allied with the Donquixote Pirates under Doflamingo. Last seen on Dressrosa, Bellamy remains a bold and unpredictable force whose speed and strength define his presence on the seas.

Sarquiss is the loyal first mate of the Bellamy Pirates, known for his skill with a sword and his steadfast support of his captain. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his combat ability and loyalty make him a reliable crewmate in battle. He faced powerful adversaries alongside Bellamy but was ultimately defeated by Blackbeard. Last seen on Jaya, Sarquiss remains a testament to dedication and resilience, representing the strength of those who serve faithfully under their captain.

Blackbeard, also known as Marshall D. Teach, is a cunning and ruthless pirate whose ambition knows no bounds. Once a member of the Whitebeard Pirates, he orchestrated his rise to Yonko status through betrayal, manipulation, and unmatched opportunism. Empowered by both the Dark-Dark Fruit and the Tremor-Tremor Fruit, he wields devastating powers capable of crushing foes and reshaping the battlefield. Armed with a claw and pistol, and skilled in Armament and Observation Haki, he combines brute force with tactical genius. Following the Payback War, where he defeated the remnants of Whitebeard’s crew, Blackbeard now commands the Blackbeard Pirates from Hachinosu, solidifying his position as one of the most dangerous men on the seas.

Doc Q is the eerie and seemingly frail doctor of the Blackbeard Pirates, whose true threat lies in his mastery of the Sick-Sick Fruit, allowing him to inflict devastating diseases on his enemies. Wielding a scythe as both weapon and symbol, he combines his sinister abilities with careful precision to weaken and terrorize opponents. Though he lacks Haki, his command of illness and his unsettling presence make him a dangerous figure within the crew. Stationed on Hachinosu, Doc Q serves as both healer and harbinger of sickness, embodying the dark and unpredictable nature of Blackbeard’s forces.

Van Augur is the calm and precise sniper of the Blackbeard Pirates, feared for his deadly accuracy and unshakable composure. Empowered by the Warp-Warp Fruit, he can teleport with ease, striking from unexpected angles and evading counterattacks. Wielding a sniper rifle and trained in Observation Haki, he combines long-range precision with strategic cunning to eliminate targets efficiently. Stationed on Hachinosu, Van Augur exemplifies patience, skill, and lethality, making him a cornerstone of Blackbeard’s formidable crew.

Jesus Burgess is the powerhouse helmsman of the Blackbeard Pirates, renowned for his wrestling-style combat and unwavering loyalty to his captain. Empowered by the Buff-Buff Fruit, he can dramatically enhance his muscle mass, delivering devastating barehanded attacks with overwhelming force. Skilled in Armament Haki, he combines brute strength and reinforced strikes to dominate the battlefield. Stationed on Hachinosu, Burgess serves as both the crew’s frontline brawler and a symbol of raw power, embodying the fierce and relentless spirit of Blackbeard’s forces.

Mont Blanc Cricket is a determined and adventurous salvager from Jaya, descended from the legendary Norland and driven to uncover proof of Skypiea. Skilled in diving and hand-to-hand combat, he wields only his fists with remarkable strength and precision. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his courage, persistence, and deep connection to his family’s legacy make him a respected figure among allies and a tenacious opponent to adversaries. As a member of the Saruyama Alliance, Cricket continues his quest, uncovering the mysteries of the skies and the history of his ancestors.

Masira is the ape-themed and resourceful captain of the Saruyama Alliance, known for his expertise in diving and hand-to-hand combat. Wielding only his fists, he combines agility, strength, and keen instincts to navigate the dangers of the seas and salvage valuable treasures. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his leadership, experience, and unwavering determination make him a respected and capable figure among his crew. Stationed around Jaya, Masira continues to lead his team on daring expeditions, embodying the adventurous spirit of a seasoned salvager.

Shoujou is the gorilla-themed and charismatic captain of the Shoujou Pirates within the Saruyama Alliance, known for his extraordinary sonic voice capable of disorienting or damaging opponents. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, he wields his voice as a powerful weapon, turning sound into a tool of combat and control. Skilled in leadership and strategy, he guides his crew with confidence and authority. Stationed near Jaya, Shoujou continues to lead daring salvage missions, combining his unique abilities and determination to make a lasting impact on the seas.

Enel is the self-proclaimed “God” of Skypiea, a tyrannical ruler whose god complex drove him to dominate the sky-island with fear and power. Empowered by the Rumble-Rumble Fruit, he can generate, control, and transform into lightning, using his gold staff to amplify attacks and assert control. Skilled in Observation Haki, or Mantra, he can predict movements and sense the intentions of others, making him nearly untouchable in combat. After his reign on Skypiea, he set his sights on new worlds, eventually residing on Fairy Vearth, the moon, with his priests, continuing to wield his immense power with divine authority.

Wyper is a fierce Shandian warrior, determined to reclaim his homeland from the Skypieans. Skilled in the use of Seastone weapons and dials, he wields a Burn Bazooka and Reject Dial with deadly precision, combining technology and combat prowess to devastating effect. Though Armament Haki is implied, his discipline, strength, and strategic mind make him a formidable opponent even without it. Fighting for the honor and freedom of his people, Wyper stands as a symbol of Shandian resilience and courage on Skypiea, unyielding in his mission to protect and reclaim his land.

Gan Fall is the noble and experienced former God of Skypiea, revered for his wisdom, courage, and dedication to his people. Riding Pierre, a flying bird-horse, he commands both mobility and presence on the battlefield. Skilled with a lance and dials, he combines traditional combat with strategic use of Skypiea’s technology. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his leadership, bravery, and knowledge make him a formidable protector. Now serving as a Knight of the Sky, Gan Fall continues to safeguard Skypiea and guide allies, including the Straw Hat Pirates, with unwavering honor.

Conis is a resourceful and courageous Sky Islander from Skypiea, known for aiding the Straw Hat Pirates in their escape and supporting allies in times of need. Skilled in riding her sky bike, Waver, she navigates the skies with agility and precision. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, her quick thinking, bravery, and determination make her a reliable and valued companion. Remaining on Skypiea, Conis continues to protect her home and assist those in need, embodying the spirit and resilience of the island’s people.

Pagaya is a skilled and inventive engineer from Skypiea, renowned for his expertise with dials and Sky Island technology. As the father of Conis, he not only guides and protects his daughter but also played a key role in repairing the Waver, ensuring safe travel across the skies. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his intelligence, craftsmanship, and resourcefulness make him indispensable to the Skypieans. Remaining on Skypiea, Pagaya continues to support his people and allies, using his technical genius to solve problems and enhance the island’s defenses.

Ohm is a disciplined and formidable priest of Enel, entrusted with guarding the Iron Trial and enforcing the will of Skypiea’s self-proclaimed god. Wielding the Eisen Whip, an iron cloud sword, he combines skill, speed, and precision to dominate in combat. Trained in Observation Haki, he can anticipate enemy movements and strike with deadly accuracy. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit, his mastery of his weapon, Haki, and unwavering loyalty make him a fearsome protector of Enel’s authority. Stationed on Skypiea, Ohm serves as both guardian and enforcer, embodying the strength and discipline of Enel’s army.

Gedatsu is a quirky yet powerful priest of Enel, assigned to guard the Swamp Trial. Despite his often clueless demeanor, he wields formidable martial arts skills, making him a dangerous opponent to any who challenge him. Trained in Observation Haki, he can sense the movements and intentions of his foes, compensating for his eccentric nature with heightened perception. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit, his strength, unpredictability, and devotion to Enel’s army make him a unique and formidable guardian. After the events of Skypiea, Gedatsu resides on Ukkari Hot-Spring Island, continuing his duties with eccentric dedication.

Satori is a vigilant and formidable priest of Enel, charged with guarding the Forest Trial on Skypiea. Armed with Impact and Ordeal balls, he attacks with precision and relentless force, ambushing intruders with deadly efficiency. Trained in Observation Haki, he can anticipate enemy movements and respond with strategic timing. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit, his combat skill, discipline, and loyalty to Enel make him a dangerous and reliable guardian. Stationed on Skypiea, Satori continues to enforce the will of Enel, protecting the sacred trials with unwavering vigilance.

Yama is the imposing commander of Enel’s Divine Soldiers, known for his immense strength and mastery of heavyweight sumo techniques. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his sheer physical power and combat skill make him a dominant force on the battlefield. Tasked with enforcing Enel’s authority, Yama combines discipline, strategy, and raw strength to maintain order and eliminate threats. Stationed on Skypiea, he serves as a formidable enforcer, embodying the might and unwavering loyalty of Enel’s army.

Iceburg is the esteemed mayor of Water 7 and president of the Galley-La Company, known for his leadership, intelligence, and dedication to his city. A former apprentice of the legendary shipwright Tom, he played a crucial role in preserving the plans for the ancient weapon Pluton. Though he wields no Devil Fruit, weapon, or Haki, his strategic mind, influence, and craftsmanship make him a pivotal figure in both politics and shipbuilding. Stationed in Water 7, Iceburg continues to guide his city with wisdom, integrity, and a commitment to its safety and prosperity.

Paulie is a loudmouthed yet loyal shipwright of the Galley-La Company, known for his skill in rope-based combat and his dedication to his craft. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his strength, ingenuity, and determination make him a reliable ally and a valuable protector of Water 7’s shipbuilding industry. A candidate to join the Straw Hat crew, Paulie’s loyalty and courage have repeatedly proven essential in both daily life and battle. Stationed in Water 7, he continues to support his city and colleagues with unwavering commitment.

Rob Lucci is the most lethal and calculating assassin of CP9, now serving CP0, known for his unmatched skill and ruthless efficiency. Empowered by the awakened Cat-Cat Fruit: Leopard, he can transform into a leopard, gaining incredible speed, strength, and combat prowess while enhancing the destructive potential of his abilities. Mastery of Rokushiki techniques, combined with Armament and Observation Haki, makes him a formidable force capable of overwhelming even the strongest opponents. Following the Egghead incident, Lucci has returned to active duty, continuing to serve with precision and dedication across the world as a feared and highly skilled agent.

Kaku is a highly skilled CP9 agent, now serving CP0, who once operated under the guise of a Galley-La shipwright. Empowered by the Giraffe-Giraffe Fruit, he can transform into a giraffe, granting him extended reach, immense strength, and enhanced combat versatility. A master of swordsmanship combined with Rokushiki techniques, Kaku also wields Armament and Observation Haki, making him a deadly and adaptable opponent. After the events on Egghead Island, he continues to carry out his duties as a formidable and strategic agent, feared for both his power and precision in combat.

Blueno is a skilled and versatile CP9 agent, now serving CP0, known for his mastery of Rokushiki and strategic combat abilities. Empowered by the Door-Door Fruit, he can create interdimensional doors, allowing him to transport himself and others instantaneously, attack from unexpected angles, and manipulate the battlefield with precision. Trained in Armament Haki after the timeskip, Blueno combines his Devil Fruit powers with enhanced combat resilience, making him a formidable opponent. Following the events on Egghead Island, he continues to operate as a highly efficient and feared agent, executing missions with cunning and efficiency.

Kalifa is a cunning and agile agent, formerly serving as Iceburg’s secretary before revealing her true identity as a member of CP9, now CP0. Empowered by the Bubble-Bubble Fruit, she can create and manipulate soap for attacks, traps, and movement, often using a soap whip in combat. Though she possesses no Haki, her speed, agility, and strategic mind make her a dangerous and unpredictable opponent. After the events on Egghead Island, Kalifa continues to operate as a skilled and efficient agent, executing missions with precision and cunning.

Jabra is a deceptive and fierce CP9 agent, now serving CP0, known for his cunning, combat skill, and rivalry with Rob Lucci. Empowered by the Wolf-Wolf Fruit, he can transform into a wolf, gaining enhanced speed, strength, and agility, while utilizing sharp claws to devastate opponents. Skilled in Rokushiki techniques, Jabra combines his Devil Fruit abilities with martial prowess to dominate the battlefield. Following the events on Egghead Island, he continues to operate as a dangerous and strategic agent, feared for both his ferocity and his clever tactics.

Fukurou is a clever and strategic CP9 agent, skilled in information-based combat and deception. Using his unique zipper-mouth ability alongside Rokushiki techniques, he can manipulate, restrain, and confuse opponents with precision. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his intelligence, cunning, and mastery of specialized combat tactics make him a formidable operative. Last seen at Enies Lobby, Fukurou operates with discretion and efficiency, embodying the lethal professionalism of CP9 agents.

Kumadori is a dramatic and eccentric CP9 agent, known for his theatrical fighting style and unique techniques. Skilled with a staff and capable of using the Life Return technique to manipulate his own body for enhanced combat performance, he blends flair with deadly precision. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his creativity, agility, and mastery of specialized combat skills make him a formidable opponent. Last seen at Enies Lobby, Kumadori embodies the unpredictable and dangerous nature of CP9 operatives.

Spandam is the corrupt and ambitious director of CP0, formerly the leader of CP9, driven by obsession with power and his own twisted sense of justice. Armed with Funkfreed, a unique sword-elephant hybrid, he wields a weapon capable of both offense and intimidation. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his authority, cunning, and manipulation make him a dangerous figure in the shadows of the World Government. Operating from Egghead Island, Spandam continues to exert control and influence, enforcing his agenda with ruthless determination.

Funkfreed is a unique and formidable weapon, empowered by the Elephant-Elephant Fruit (Zoan), allowing it to transform from a sword into a living elephant. Loyal to Spandam, it serves as both a powerful offensive tool and a versatile combat companion. Though it possesses no Haki, its immense strength, adaptability, and durability make it a fearsome presence on the battlefield. As Spandam’s living weapon, Funkfreed operates alongside him on Egghead Island, embodying both loyalty and raw destructive power.

Tom is a legendary shipwright from Water 7, renowned for his unmatched skill and craftsmanship, most famously for constructing the Oro Jackson, the ship of the Pirate King. Possessing Fishman strength, he wields incredible physical power alongside his technical genius, though he uses no weapons or Haki. Respected by apprentices and peers alike, Tom’s influence shaped the next generation of shipwrights, including Iceburg. Stationed in Water 7, he remains a symbol of masterful shipbuilding and enduring legacy in the world of nautical engineering.

Kokoro is a kind and experienced merfolk, serving as the train conductor and stationmaster of the Sea Train in Water 7. With exceptional swimming skills and deep knowledge of maritime operations, she assists Tom and guides passengers safely across the waters. Though she wields no Devil Fruit powers, weapons, or Haki, her wisdom, care, and reliability make her an indispensable figure in the community, acting as a grandmotherly presence to Chimney and others. Stationed in Water 7, Kokoro continues to ensure the smooth operation of the Sea Train and the safety of those who travel with her.

Chimney is the spirited granddaughter of Kokoro, growing up under her guidance and assisting with the Sea Train operations in Water 7. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit powers, weapons, or Haki, her curiosity, bravery, and eagerness to help make her a valued member of the crew and a loyal companion to those she trusts. Chimney demonstrates courage beyond her years, embodying the energy and optimism of the next generation. Stationed in Water 7, she continues to learn and aid in the day-to-day operations of the Sea Train.

T-Bone is a compassionate and honorable Marine captain from the South Blue, known for his dedication to protecting civilians and upholding justice. Wielding a long, thin sword with skill and precision, he combines bravery with tactical intelligence in combat. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit powers or Haki, his courage, leadership, and selflessness make him a respected figure among both Marines and civilians. Tragically, T-Bone gave his life while defending innocents, leaving behind a legacy of heroism and integrity.

The Franky Family is a loyal and resourceful gang led by Franky, dedicated to protecting the Water 7 shipyard and supporting their leader even after he departed. Skilled in brawling, inventive use of bikes, and firearms, they combine street smarts with combat ability to defend their territory. Though they possess no Devil Fruit powers or Haki, their loyalty, teamwork, and determination make them a formidable group in the streets of Water 7. Operating throughout the city, the Franky Family continues to uphold their reputation as protectors and enforcers within the community.

Gecko Moria is a former Warlord of the Sea, infamous for his dark and cunning nature. Empowered by the Shadow-Shadow Fruit, he can manipulate shadows to create powerful zombie minions and attack foes, often using a pair of scissors to sever and control shadows. Though he possesses no Haki, his mastery of shadows, strategic mind, and unpredictable tactics make him a dangerous adversary. As captain of the Mysterious Four, Moria last operated from Pirate Island before disappearing, leaving a legacy of terror and dark experimentation in his wake.

Perona is a whimsical yet deadly commander, formerly loyal to Gecko Moria on Thriller Bark. Empowered by the Hollow-Hollow Fruit, she can summon ghosts that induce depression in enemies or explode on command, often using her Negative Hollows to control the battlefield. Though she possesses no Haki, her Devil Fruit abilities, agility, and clever tactics make her a formidable opponent. After Moria’s defeat, she shifted to caring for 2 People, showcasing a softer side. Last seen on Kuraigana Island, Perona remains a mysterious and capable figure.

Absalom is a cunning and stealthy officer formerly of Thriller Bark, empowered by the Clear-Clear Fruit, which allows him to turn invisible at will. Utilizing his claws and physical strength, he can ambush and overpower opponents with precision. Though he possesses no Haki, his agility, stealth, and resourcefulness make him a dangerous adversary. Once obsessed with marrying some orange hair female, Absalom eventually abandoned his villainous pursuits and became a reporter. Last seen on Dressrosa, he continues to navigate the world with a mix of cunning and adaptability.

Dr. Hogback is a notorious and skilled surgeon of Thriller Bark, renowned for his ability to manipulate corpses to create zombies. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit powers or Haki, his medical expertise and cunning make him a dangerous and unpredictable adversary. Equipped with surgical tools and dark knowledge, he served as a key figure under Gecko Moria, contributing to the creation of a formidable zombie army. Last seen on Thriller Bark, Dr. Hogback remains a symbol of twisted genius and macabre science.

Victoria Cindry is a former actress revived as a zombie servant by Dr. Hogback on Thriller Bark. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit powers or Haki, her enhanced durability as a zombie and use of metal plates in combat make her a resilient and dangerous opponent. Once celebrated on stage, she now serves under Hogback, carrying out his orders with unwavering obedience. Last seen on Thriller Bark, Victoria Cindry remains a tragic figure caught between her past life and her current existence as a formidable undead servant.

Oars is an ancient giant resurrected as Gecko Moria’s ultimate zombie, infused with Luffy’s shadow to enhance his power. Possessing immense strength, size, and surprising agility for his stature, he serves as a nearly unstoppable force on the battlefield. Though he has no Devil Fruit powers or Haki, his sheer physical dominance and resilience make him a terrifying commander among Moria’s forces. Last seen on Thriller Bark before its destruction, Oars remains a legendary figure of brute force and dark experimentation.

Lola is the daring and independent daughter of Big Mom, who escaped her mother’s oppressive rule after being forced into an arranged marriage. Her defiance led to her being disowned, as her actions indirectly caused Big Mom to lose a future that would've made her powerful. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit powers, weapons, or Haki, Lola’s cunning, charisma, and leadership skills allow her to command the Rolling Pirates with confidence. Last seen on Dressrosa, she continues to navigate the seas with determination, forging her own path away from her family’s shadow.

Kumashi is a stuffed bear revived as a zombie, serving loyally under Perona on Thriller Bark. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit powers, weapons, or Haki, his resilience and obedience make him a dependable servant in battle and support roles. Once an ordinary toy, he now exists as a loyal companion, aiding Perona with tasks and protection. Stationed on Thriller Bark, Kumashi embodies both the eerie charm and the unwavering loyalty of Perona’s undead entourage.

Silvers Rayleigh, once known as the “Dark King,” is the legendary former first mate of the Roger Pirates and right-hand man to the Pirate King. A master swordsman wielding a straight-bladed sword, he possesses unparalleled mastery of Armament, Observation, and Conqueror’s Haki, making him one of the most formidable figures alive. After the crew’s era ended, he retired from piracy and became a coating mechanic, dedicating his time to training the next generation of fighters. Stationed at the Sabaody Archipelago, Rayleigh carries the legacy of the Pirate King while living a life of quiet mentorship and unrivaled power.

Shakuyaku, often called Shakky, is a retired pirate and seasoned information broker, formerly active on the seas alongside her partner, Silvers Rayleigh. Armed with a gun and extensive knowledge of the pirate world, she operates with keen intelligence and discretion. Though her Haki abilities remain unknown, her connections, insight, and experience make her a valuable and respected figure. Stationed at the Sabaody Archipelago, Shakky continues to navigate the underground of the pirate world, offering guidance and critical information to those who seek it.

Camie is a friendly and cheerful mermaid from Fishman Island, known for her exceptional swimming abilities and her kind-hearted nature. A close friend of Hatchan, she navigates her underwater world with grace and courage. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit powers, weapons, or Haki, her optimism and bravery make her a valued member of her community. Kidnapped by traffickers at one point, Camie’s resilience and spirit shine as she continues her life among the Fishman Island residents, offering friendship and support to those around her.

Hatchan, also known as Hachi, is an octopus Fishman with six arms, allowing him to wield six swords with exceptional skill. Formerly a member of the Arlong Pirates, he turned over a new leaf and now works as a takoyaki seller on Fishman Island. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit powers or Haki, his strength, swordsmanship, and adaptability make him a formidable fighter when needed. Loyal and kind-hearted, Hatchan serves his community while embracing a peaceful life among the Fishman Island residents.

Duval is the leader of the Flying Fish Riders, once infamous for bearing a wanted poster that mistakenly showed Sanji’s face. Armed with a lance and his steel bull, he commands respect and fear among his subordinates.
