Though he possesses no Devil Fruit powers or Haki, his combat skills, leadership, and determination make him a capable and influential figure. Having transitioned from a life of misunderstanding to allyship, Duval now operates at the Sabaody Archipelago, maintaining order and guiding his crew with a firm but fair hand.

Sentomaru is a formidable Marine officer, serving as the bodyguard of Dr. Vegapunk and commander of the Pacifista forces. Known for his incredible strength and mastery of an axe, he combines raw power with tactical skill on the battlefield. Skilled in Armament Haki, Sentomaru can take on powerful opponents and protect high-value targets with ease. Stationed at Egghead Island, he remains a crucial figure in the Marines’ scientific and combat operations, enforcing the World Government’s will with precision and authority.

PX-1 is a fearsome Pacifista, a cyborg clone of Bartholomew Kuma, engineered and deployed by the World Government. Equipped with laser beams and immense robotic strength, it serves as a high-powered weapon capable of subduing powerful adversaries. Though it possesses no Haki, its advanced technology, durability, and combat capabilities make it a formidable enforcer. Stationed at the Sabaody Archipelago, PX-1 stands as a symbol of the Marines’ technological supremacy and the World Government’s authority.

Jewelry Bonney is the cunning and determined captain of the Bonney Pirates, known for her ability to manipulate age. The daughter of Bartholomew Kuma, she was once gravely ill, forcing her father to make a secretive deal with the World Government to ensure her survival. Once fully cured, she uncovered the truth behind Kuma’s actions and escaped the government’s grasp to seek him out. Though she possesses no weapons beyond her fists and her Haki remains unknown, Bonney’s agility, combat skill, and resourcefulness make her a formidable pirate. She was last seen on Egghead Island, continuing her quest to reunite with her father which she achieve after her father save her from almost getting killed by one of the five elders.

Basil Hawkins is a mystic and calculating pirate captain, wielding the Wara-Wara Fruit to manipulate straw and even influence fate itself. Armed with a straw sword and skilled in both Armament and Observation Haki, he combines his Devil Fruit powers with formidable combat ability. Known for his tarot-themed persona and eerie predictions, Hawkins initially sailed independently before joining the ranks of Kaido’s forces. Stationed in Wano, he serves as a strategic and unpredictable member of the Beast Pirates, blending mysticism with deadly precision.

Scratchmen Apoo is a flamboyant and unpredictable pirate captain, using the Sound-Sound Fruit to turn his body into a living musical instrument that can generate devastating attacks. Skilled in Armament Haki (implied), he combines rhythm and combat to catch foes off guard. Once the leader of the On Air Pirates, Apoo later allied himself with Kaido, lending his unique talents to the Beast Pirates. Stationed in Wano, he remains a wild card, using music as both weapon and signature style on the battlefield.

X Drake is a formidable pirate-turned-undercover Marine, wielding the Dragon-Dragon Fruit, Allosaurus Model, to gain immense strength, durability, and predatory abilities. Armed with both sword and axe, and skilled in Armament Haki, he is capable of overpowering most opponents with raw power and tactical precision. Formerly a Marine Rear Admiral and later the captain of his own pirate crew, Drake now secretly operates as a Rear Admiral for SWORD while infiltrating enemy ranks. Stationed in Wano, he balances his dual loyalties with cunning and efficiency, making him a dangerous and unpredictable force.

Capone “Gang” Bege is a cunning and strategic pirate captain, using the Castle-Castle Fruit to transform his body into a living fortress, complete with cannons and soldiers at his command. Skilled in Armament Haki, he can defend himself and launch devastating attacks with precision. Known for his mafia-style operations, Bege initially allied with Big Mom but eventually betrayed her to pursue his own agenda. Last seen navigating the seas post-Wano, he remains a calculating and dangerous leader of the Fire Tank Pirates.

Urouge is a towering and resilient pirate captain from the Sky Islands, capable of converting any damage he receives into immense physical strength. Wielding a large staff and possessing unknown Haki abilities, he overwhelms opponents with raw power and endurance. Known for defeating one of Big Mom’s commanders, Urouge leads the Fallen Monk Pirates with a fearless and unyielding spirit. His exact whereabouts remain on an unknown Sky Island, where he continues to train and challenge formidable foes.

Killer is the deadly and loyal right-hand man of Eustass Kid, renowned for his lethal dual scythe techniques. Skilled in Armament Haki, he combines speed and precision to overwhelm opponents in combat. During the Wano arc, he operated under the alias Kamazo, carrying out high-risk missions for his captain. Now stationed in Elbaf, Killer continues to serve the Kid Pirates as a formidable combatant, feared by enemies and respected by allies alike.

Eustass Kid is a ruthless and ambitious pirate captain, wielding the Magnet-Magnet Fruit to manipulate and control metal, crafting devastating constructs in battle. Skilled in both Armament and Conqueror’s Haki, he dominates the battlefield with sheer force and intimidation. As the leader of the Kid Pirates, he relentlessly pursues the One Piece, leaving a trail of destruction in his wake. He once challenged Shanks to a battle but was ultimately defeated. Currently stationed in Elbaf, Kid remains a feared and determined figure in the New World.

Trafalgar Law is a cunning and strategic pirate captain, wielding the Op-Op Fruit to perform surgical spatial manipulations, allowing him to cut, swap, and control anything within his territory. Armed with his nodachi sword, Kikoku, and skilled in both Armament and Observation Haki, Law is a formidable combatant. Known as the “Surgeon of Death,” he survived the Flevance tragedy and rose to notoriety as one of the most ruthless pirates from the North Blue. He allied with Luffy and the Straw Hats to take down Kaido and succeeded, also defeating the Emperor Big Mom. He now roams the New World with his Heart Pirates, using his powers to aid allies and strengthen his crew. His current location is somewhere in the unpredictable seas of the New World.

Boa Hancock is the captivating and powerful Empress of Amazon Lily and captain of the Kuja Pirates. Wielding the Love-Love Fruit, she can turn anyone who harbors desire for her into stone. A master of both kicks and arrow attacks, she is also highly skilled in Armament, Observation, and Conqueror’s Haki, making her a fearsome combatant. Once a slave, she rose to become a Warlord of the Sea and commands the respect and loyalty of her people. Hancock resides on Amazon Lily, ruling her nation with grace and unparalleled strength.

Boa Sandersonia is a formidable warrior of the Kuja Tribe and the younger sister of Boa Hancock. She wields the Snake-Snake Fruit: Anaconda Model, allowing her to transform into and control a massive snake, using her hair as a deadly weapon. Skilled in Armament Haki, Sandersonia combines brute strength and tactical combat prowess. Once a slave under the Celestial Dragons, she now fights alongside her sister to protect Amazon Lily and uphold the honor of the Kuja people. She resides on Amazon Lily, ever vigilant in defense of her homeland.

Boa Marigold is a fierce warrior of the Kuja Tribe and the youngest sister of Boa Hancock. She wields the Snake-Snake Fruit: Cobra Model, granting her the ability to transform into a massive cobra and unleash powerful fire-breath attacks and strike with her tail. Proficient in Armament Haki, Marigold is a skilled combatant who combines strength and agility in battle. Once enslaved under the Celestial Dragons, she now stands proudly alongside her sisters, defending Amazon Lily and the Kuja people. She resides on Amazon Lily, ever ready to protect her homeland.

Gloriosa, also known as Elder Nyon, is the former Empress of Amazon Lily and a revered elder of the Kuja Tribe. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit abilities, she wields a staff and offers guidance, wisdom, and experience to the current Empress, Boa Hancock. Her presence commands respect among the Kuja people, and she continues to play a vital role in maintaining the traditions and honor of Amazon Lily. Gloriosa resides on Amazon Lily, serving as a mentor and guardian of her tribe’s legacy.

Magellan is the former Chief Warden of Impel Down, renowned for his ruthless enforcement and mastery of the Venom-Venom Fruit, which allows him to generate and control deadly poisons. After a massive prison break where over 200 inmates escaped, he was demoted to Vice Warden but remains one of the most feared figures within the notorious prison. His poison techniques serve as both weapon and deterrent, ensuring that even the boldest criminals think twice before challenging him. Magellan continues to oversee Impel Down, maintaining order in one of the world’s most dangerous facilities.

Hannyabal is the current Chief Warden of Impel Down, rising through the ranks after previously serving as Vice Warden. He wields a spear and relies on his strategic cunning and physical prowess to maintain control over the prison. Following an incident that led to the demotion of the former Chief Warden, Hannyabal was promoted and now oversees the daily operations and security of one of the most notorious prisons in the world. His leadership ensures that Impel Down remains a place feared by even the most dangerous criminals.

Sadi is the sadistic head jailer of Impel Down, notorious for her cruelty and strict control over prisoners. She wields a whip and commands a variety of beasts to maintain order and punish those who defy the rules. Her sadistic tendencies make her feared by all inmates, and she plays a key role in ensuring the prison remains an inescapable fortress within the World Government’s control.

Shiryu is a former Impel Down executioner who gained the powers of the Clear-Clear Fruit, allowing him to turn invisible at will. Skilled with a sword and proficient in Armament Haki, he became a feared figure in the prison. After his release, he joined the Blackbeard Pirates as the captain of the second ship, serving loyally under Blackbeard’s command. His current location is Hachinosu, the pirate stronghold.

Buggy is a pirate who gained the powers of the Chop-Chop Fruit, allowing him to split his body into independent parts and control them at will. Armed with bladed knives and cannons, he is unpredictable and cunning. After escaping Impel Down and surviving the Marineford war, Buggy rose to become a Warlord and eventually a Yonko. He currently leads the Cross Guild from Karai Bari Island.

Ivankov is a revolutionary commander and the queen of Kamabakka Kingdom, wielding the Horm-Horm Fruit to change their gender and enhance physical abilities. Known for the powerful “Fist of Justice,” Ivankov is a key member of the Revolutionary Army, using their abilities for both combat and support. Currently, Ivankov resides on Momoiro Island.

Inazuma is a revolutionary commander and the right-hand of Ivankov, possessing the Snip-Snip Fruit which transforms their hands into scissors capable of cutting through almost anything. Skilled in combat and loyal to the Revolutionary Army, Inazuma aids in missions and operations under Ivankov’s command. Currently stationed on Momoiro Island.

Edward Newgate, famously known as Whitebeard, was one of the most powerful pirates in history. Wielding the Tremor-Tremor Fruit, he could generate massive earthquakes capable of destroying entire islands, and he fought with his iconic bisento. Master of Armament, Observation, and Conqueror’s Haki, he led the Whitebeard Pirates with unmatched authority. Whitebeard died heroically protecting Ace during the Marineford War, and his Devil Fruit power was subsequently stolen by Blackbeard. He was last seen at his grave in the new world.

Marco, known as the “Phoenix,” possesses the Phoenix-Phoenix Fruit, allowing him to transform into a phoenix and heal rapidly from injuries. Skilled in Armament Haki, he served as Whitebeard’s right-hand and First Division Commander of the Whitebeard Pirates. After Whitebeard’s death, he aided Luffy during the Wano conflict. Marco was last seen on Sphinx Island.

Jozu, the “Diamond” commander, wields the Diamond-Diamond Fruit, giving him the ability to transform parts of his body into diamond for incredible defense and offense. A master of Armament Haki, he served as the 3rd Division Commander of the Whitebeard Pirates and fought admirals fiercely during the Marineford War. His current location is unknown.

Vista, a master swordsman of the Whitebeard Pirates, wields dual swords with exceptional skill and precision. He is proficient in Armament Haki, using it to enhance his swordsmanship in battle. Serving as the 5th Division Commander, Vista fought loyally alongside Whitebeard during key conflicts. His current location is unknown.

Akainu (Sakazuki) wields the Magma-Magma Fruit, granting him the power to generate and manipulate magma for devastating attacks. He is highly skilled in Armament and Observation Haki and primarily fights using his fists. Notorious for his ruthless pursuit of absolute justice, he killed Ace during the Marineford War and later defeated another admiral to become Fleet Admiral. He now commands the entire Marines from New Marineford.

Kizaru (Borsalino) wields the Light-Light Fruit, granting him the ability to move and attack at the speed of light, using light-based kicks and a sword. He is highly skilled in Armament and Observation Haki. Known for his laid-back and nonchalant demeanor, he currently serves as an Admiral of the Marines the second highest rank under fleet admiral.

Sengoku wields the Human-Human Fruit: Model Buddha, granting him the ability to transform into a massive golden Buddha and unleash powerful shockwave attacks. Skilled in Armament Haki, he was the Fleet Admiral who orchestrated Marine operations during major conflicts. He is now retired and resides at New Marineford.

Garp possesses monstrous physical strength and wields devastating punches, including his signature move, Galaxy Impact. Skilled in Armament Haki, he is celebrated as a Hero of the Marines and is Luffy’s grandfather. Despite being offered the rank of Admiral multiple times, he chose to remain a Vice Admiral. His last known location is Hachinosu.

Makino is a kind-hearted bartender from Foosha Village who helped raise many young child who became pirates. She has no Devil Fruit powers, weapons, or Haki. She is a civilian and remains in Foosha Village.
Curly Dadan is a tough mountain bandit who raised several legendary pirates. She wields a pipe, has no Devil Fruit powers, and possesses no Haki, She is the leader of the Dadan Bandits.

Sabo is a revolutionary and former noble, trained in Dragon Claw Kung Fu and now wields the Flame-Flame Fruit, granting him control over fire. He fights using a pipe and had unknown Haki before the timeskip. As Chief of Staff of the Revolutionary Army, he rose to prominence after acquiring the Flame-Flame Fruit at Dressrosa. He escaped Goa Kingdom upon discovering a secret ruler under the World Government and informed the entire Revolutionary Army about it. He continues to actively aid the Revolutionary Army.

Demaro Black is an impostor who assumed the identity of Luffy after the timeskip, attempting to mimic the appearance and mannerisms of the Straw Hat captain. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit powers or Haki, he boldly leads his own crew under the guise of Luffy. Known for his audacity and deception, he caused confusion among pirates and civilians alike, operating primarily around the Sabaody Archipelago. His actions are driven by ambition and opportunism, though he lacks the genuine strength and resolve of the real Straw Hat captain.

Caribou is a cruel and cunning pirate who wields the Swamp-Swamp Fruit, allowing his body to transform into and manipulate swamp-like matter, making him nearly untouchable and capable of creating deadly traps. He often uses this ability to ensnare and capture opponents, displaying a mix of cruelty and opportunism. Known for posing as a Straw Hat to deceive others, Caribou has repeatedly escaped capture, earning a reputation as a slippery and unpredictable foe. He currently leads the Caribou Pirates.

Fukaboshi is the eldest prince of the Ryugu Kingdom and a master of Fishman Karate, capable of delivering devastating attacks both in and out of water. Armed with a sword and unparalleled aquatic combat skills, he dedicates himself to protecting Fishman Island and its people. As a member of the royal family, Fukaboshi embodies leadership and valor, often leading his fellow guardians in defense of the island. He currently resides on Fishman Island, upholding his duties as prince and protector.

Ryuboshi is the middle prince of the Ryugu Kingdom, known for his flamboyant personality and eccentric flair. Wielding a harp, he can use music to distract or manipulate opponents, blending performance with combat. As a royal figure, he balances showmanship with duty, supporting the protection and prestige of Fishman Island. He currently resides on Fishman Island, serving as one of its princes and a guardian of its people.

Manboshi is the youngest prince of the Ryugu Kingdom, known for his hyperactive and boisterous personality. Possessing natural Fishman strength and exceptional acrobatic skills, he combines agility with raw power in both combat and daily life. Despite his youthful energy, he takes his duties seriously when it comes to protecting Fishman Island. He currently resides on Fishman Island, supporting his family and defending the kingdom.

Shirahoshi is the giant mermaid princess of the Ryugu Kingdom, renowned for her gentle and shy demeanor. As the living embodiment of the ancient weapon Poseidon, she wields the incredible ability to command the Sea Kings, making her a pivotal figure in both diplomacy and defense. Despite her timid nature, her powers make her one of the most formidable individuals on Fishman Island. She resides there, under the protection of her family and the kingdom’s warriors.

King Neptune is the powerful and wise ruler of Fishman Island, wielding immense Fishman strength and his signature trident in combat. As the father of the royal family, he oversees the protection and governance of the Ryugu Kingdom, ensuring peace and stability for his people. Respected by both citizens and warriors, Neptune’s presence commands authority, and he remains a steadfast guardian of his underwater realm.

Hody Jones is a ruthless and power-hungry Fishman who enhanced his strength using Energy Steroids, gaining incredible water-powered combat abilities. Wielding his shark-shaped blade, he led the New Fishman Pirates in a campaign of hatred and rebellion against humans. Driven by racism and vengeance, Hody’s ambition ultimately failed, resulting in his imprisonment at Level 6 of Impel Down after his defeat.

Vander Decken IX is a cunning and obsessive pirate captain who wields the Mark-Mark Fruit, allowing him to throw objects with unerring accuracy toward any target. Armed with various throwing weapons, he is infamous for his relentless pursuit of Princess Shirahoshi. His dangerous obsession led to his defeat, after which he was imprisoned at Impel Down.

Hammond is a loyal officer of the New Fishman Pirates, wielding exceptional Fishman strength and a spear in combat. Fiercely devoted to Hody Jones, he attempted to recruit a pirate into their ranks. After their defeat, Hammond was imprisoned at Impel Down.

Name: Dosun
Fruit/Ability: Power-enhancing hammerhead
Weapon: Club
Haki Type: None
Background story: New Fishman Pirate lieutenant
Role/Rank: Officer
Faction: New Fishman Pirates
Island Location: Impel Down

Ikaros Much is an officer of the New Fishman Pirates, using his squid-based abilities and inky attacks to subdue opponents. Loyal to Hody Jones, he participated in the Fishman rebellion and was captured after their defeat, now held at Impel Down.

Zeo is an officer of the New Fishman Pirates, utilizing his chameleon-like Fishman abilities to become invisible and launch stealth attacks. Wielding a chain in combat, he specializes in ambushes and subterfuge. After the defeat of Hody Jones, Zeo was captured and is now held at Impel Down.

Daruma is an officer of the New Fishman Pirates, known for his ferocious shark-like biting attacks and formidable teeth. Specializing in digging tunnels and close-quarters combat, he served under Hody Jones during the Fishman Island rebellion. Following their defeat, Daruma was captured and is currently held at Impel Down.

Madame Shyarly is a renowned fortune teller on Fishman Island, gifted with the ability of clairvoyance, allowing her to foresee future events. She gained attention for predicting that a pirate would one day bring significant change to Fishman Island. Though she does not wield any weapons or Haki, her visions make her a respected and influential figure among the island’s residents.

Caesar Clown is a brilliant yet dangerous scientist who wields the Gas-Gas Fruit, granting him the ability to create, control, and transform into poisonous gas. Formerly part of Vegapunk’s team, he turned rogue and allied with Doflamingo for his own schemes. Specializing in chemical warfare and deadly inventions, Caesar has no Haki but relies on his genius intellect and lethal gases to dominate his foes. His current whereabouts are unknown, though he was last seen collaborating with Germa 66.

Monet was an undercover agent of the Donquixote Pirates, serving as Caesar Clown’s secretary on Punk Hazard. She wielded the Snow-Snow Fruit, allowing her to create and manipulate snow for offense and defense, and fought using her sharp claws. Though she had no Haki, her Devil Fruit powers made her a formidable opponent. Monet died during an attempt to destroy Punk Hazard under Caesar’s orders.

Vergo was a Marine Vice Admiral who secretly served the Donquixote Pirates under Doflamingo. He wielded a bamboo stick in combat and possessed mastery over full-body Armament Haki, making him an extremely dangerous opponent. Despite his formidable skills and Haki, he was ultimately defeated and killed by Trafalgar Law on Punk Hazard.

Tashigi is a highly skilled swordswoman known for her mastery of the katana, particularly her Shigure blade. She wields Armament Haki in combat and serves loyally under Captain Smoker, dedicating herself to protecting civilians and upholding justice. As a Marine Captain stationed at the G-5 Base, she is committed to capturing dangerous pirates while maintaining her strong moral compass.

Kin’emon is a skilled samurai from Wano, wielding the Foxfire swordsmanship style and capable of creating clothes from leaves using the Clothes-Clothes Fruit. Proficient in Armament Haki, he is dedicated to protecting the Kozuki family and recovering his son. As a loyal retainer of the Kozuki clan, Kin’emon stands as a steadfast warrior and protector of Wano.

Momonosuke is the young son of Kozuki Oden and heir to the Kozuki clan of Wano. He possesses an artificial Dragon Zoan fruit created by Vegapunk, which initially failed to awaken properly. As a child, he does not wield weapons or Haki but carries the legacy and responsibility of his family. He is a prince of Wano, destined to lead the samurai and protect his homeland.

Brownbeard is a minor pirate leader serving as a guard for Caesar Clown’s operations on Punk Hazard. He lacks a Devil Fruit ability but compensates with his gun-leg prosthetics, using them effectively in combat. Loyal to Caesar, he plays a supporting role in maintaining order among the scientist’s forces.

The Yeti Cool Brothers, Rock and Scotch, are fearsome hitmen employed by Caesar Clown on Punk Hazard. Though they possess no Devil Fruit abilities, their immense physical strength and mastery of sniper rifles make them lethal assassins. Tasked with enforcing Caesar’s commands and eliminating threats, they are a constant danger to anyone opposing the scientist’s operations.

Donquixote Doflamingo, once a Celestial Dragon, wields the String-String Fruit, giving him the ability to create and control razor-sharp strings with deadly precision. Skilled in both Armament and Observation Haki, he ruled Dressrosa with an iron fist, using his powers to manipulate the population and even turning some into toys through his sister. Known as the underworld broker “Joker,” Doflamingo’s reign ended when he was defeated by Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates. Now imprisoned in Level 6 of Impel Down, he is kept under constant supervision to prevent further chaos.

Trebol is a loyal executive officer of the Donquixote Pirates, wielding the Sticky-Sticky Fruit to produce and manipulate mucus-like slime for both offense and defense. Known for his cunning and unwavering loyalty to Doflamingo since childhood, he uses his slime attacks to overwhelm opponents and control the battlefield. Trebol played a key role in enforcing Doflamingo’s rule over Dressrosa, ensuring that the pirate’s orders were executed without question.

Diamante is an executive officer of the Donquixote Pirates, wielding the Ripple-Ripple Fruit to manipulate objects and people as if they were made of fluttering fabric. Armed with his Ripple Sword and skilled in Armament Haki, he oversees the Dressrosa colosseum and enforces Doflamingo’s will with precision and flair. Known for his flamboyant style and tactical mind, Diamante combines showmanship with deadly effectiveness in battle.

Pica is a massive officer of the Donquixote Pirates who wields the Stone-Stone Fruit, allowing him to merge with and manipulate stone at will. His giant stone body makes him a formidable opponent, further enhanced by his Armament Haki. Known for his surprisingly tiny voice despite his immense size, Pica remained fiercely loyal to Doflamingo. After Doflamingo’s defeat, he was captured and imprisoned in Impel Down, where he is currently held.

Senor Pink is a loyal officer of the Donquixote Pirates, possessing the Swim-Swim Fruit, which allows him to swim through solid surfaces as if they were water. He fights primarily with his fists and wears a baby outfit in tribute to his lost child, reflecting his tragic past. Known for his resilience and dedication, Senor Pink was captured after Doflamingo’s downfall and is currently imprisoned in Impel Down.

Sugar is a special officer of the Donquixote Pirates, wielding the Hobby-Hobby Fruit, which allows her to turn people into toys, effectively enforcing Doflamingo’s control over Dressrosa. She can also use grape-like bombs as weapons. Despite her childlike appearance, her powers are fearsome and crucial to maintaining the island’s illusions. After Doflamingo’s defeat, she was captured and is currently held in Impel Down. She has a notable fear of Usopp.

Lao G is a seasoned officer of the Donquixote Pirates, renowned for his mastery of martial arts combined with explosive bursts of energy. He fights using only his bare fists, relying on skill and raw power rather than weapons or Devil Fruits. Despite his elderly appearance, he remains a formidable combatant. he's currently in impel down after doflamingo captured.

Baby 5 is a former officer of the Donquixote Pirates who wields the Weapon-Weapon Fruit, allowing her to transform any part of her body into deadly weapons. Driven by an intense desire to be useful to others, she eventually left Doflamingo’s crew and joined the Happo Navy. She fights using a variety of built-in weaponized arms, making her versatile and dangerous in combat. Her current location is Kano Country.

Gladius is an officer of the Donquixote Pirates who wields the Pop-Pop Fruit, allowing him to inflate and detonate objects, including his own body, for explosive attacks. Known for his short temper and aggressive nature, he uses his powers to wreak havoc on the battlefield. His current location is Impel Down.

Buffalo is an officer of the Donquixote Pirates who wields the Spin-Spin Fruit, allowing him to rotate his body at high speeds to fly and perform powerful aerial attacks. Known for his loyalty to both Baby 5 and Doflamingo, he uses his spinning abilities to dominate opponents from the air. His current location is Impel Down.

Violet is a princess of Dressrosa who wields the Gaze-Gaze Fruit, granting her clairvoyance and x-ray vision. Skilled in dance-based combat, she uses her agility and fruit powers to gather intelligence while working undercover to protect her father. Her loyalty lies with the Riku Royal Family, and her current location is Dressrosa.

Kyros is a legendary gladiator with immense superhuman strength, wielding a sword with unmatched skill. Once transformed into a toy soldier, he regained his true form to protect Dressrosa and his daughter, Rebecca. Loyal to the Riku Royal Family, Kyros serves as a devoted protector, and his current location is Dressrosa.

Rebecca is the granddaughter of King Riku and a skilled princess who fights as a gladiator, specializing in defensive combat. Wielding both sword and shield, she balances agility and protection in battle. Loyal to the Riku Royal Family, she continues to defend her kingdom and currently resides on Dressrosa.

King Riku is the former and restored ruler of Dressrosa, having been deposed through Doflamingo’s deceit but reclaiming his throne following Doflamingo’s defeat. A wise and compassionate leader, he guides his kingdom with fairness and protects the legacy of the Riku Royal Family. His current location is Dressrosa.

Cavendish is a charismatic and deadly swordsman, renowned for his striking looks and skill with his sword, Durandal. He harbors a dangerous split personality known as Hakuba, which emerges in battle with terrifying speed and ferocity. Originally captain of the Beautiful Pirates, he later joined the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. His current location is somewhere in the Grand Line.

Bartolomeo is an enthusiastic and devoted pirate, fiercely loyal to Monkey D. Luffy. He wields the Barrier-Barrier Fruit, which allows him to create nearly unbreakable barriers for both offense and defense, making him a formidable combatant despite lacking Haki. As the captain of the Barto Club, he later joined the Straw Hat Grand Fleet, using his powers to support Luffy and his allies. He hails from the East Blue and continues to make a name for himself across the seas.

Don Chinjao is a legendary pirate and martial artist, renowned for his devastating headbutt techniques. He fights using his incredibly durable head and Armament Haki, capable of crushing even the toughest opponents. Once a feared rival with a personal grudge against Garp, he later became the leader of the Happo Navy, using his strength and experience to mentor others. He is based in Kano Country, where he continues to command respect and awe.

Sai is a skilled martial artist and the successor to Don Chinjao, mastering the powerful Hasshoken fighting style. He wields a staff with precision and can enhance his attacks using Armament Haki. Known for his loyalty and strategic mind, Sai also shares a personal bond with Baby 5 as her fiancé. As the 13th leader of the Happo Navy, he continues to uphold its legacy and protect Kano Country.

Ideo is a fierce and relentless boxer whose punches carry explosive force, making him a formidable fighter in close combat. He relies solely on his fists and raw power, without Haki, to overwhelm opponents. Known for his destructive style and competitive spirit, Ideo commands the Ideo Pirates and later joined the Straw Hat Grand Fleet as a loyal ally. His adventures take him across the Grand Line, where his strength and determination shine.

Hajrudin is a towering giant warrior with immense strength, capable of crushing foes with his bare fists. Hailing from Elbaf, he dreams of reviving the legendary Giant Pirates and carries the spirit of his people into battle. As the captain of the New Giant Warrior Pirates and a member of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet, Hajrudin travels the seas seeking adventure and worthy opponents, showcasing his might across the world.

Orlumbus is a seasoned and strategic pirate captain, renowned for his exceptional navigation skills that allow him to chart the unpredictable waters of the New World. Wielding massive iron balls as weapons, he commands respect and authority as the admiral of the Yonta Maria Grand Fleet. Now a key member of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet, Orlumbus leads his fleet with tactical precision, guiding his crew through both battle and exploration.

Inuarashi is a powerful mink warrior and one of the two rulers of the Mokomo Dukedom, holding the title Duke of Day. Masterful in swordsmanship and harnessing electro-based attacks, he combines speed, strength, and lightning-infused techniques to defend his homeland.

Nekomamushi is a fierce mink warrior and one of the dual rulers of the Mokomo Dukedom, holding the title Duke of Night. Skilled in claw-based combat and electro attacks, he combines agility and raw power to protect Wano. Loyal to the late Kozuki Oden, Nekomamushi guides the Mink Tribe alongside Inuarashi, defending their land and upholding their traditions.

Wanda is a skilled guardian of the Mink Tribe on Zou, gifted with electro abilities and heightened senses that make her a formidable protector. Wielding a sword with precision, she ensures the safety of her forest home and its inhabitants, standing as a loyal and vigilant defender of her people.

Carrot is a spirited young Mink from Zou, gifted with electro abilities and the powerful Sulong transformation during a full moon. Skilled in claw-based combat, she is agile, fast, and fiercely loyal, having temporarily joined the Straw Hat crew to aid them in battle while protecting her homeland.

Pedro was a brave Mink warrior and former pirate captain, skilled in electro-based attacks and masterful swordsmanship. Wielding his sword with precision and enhanced by Armament Haki, he accompanied the Straw Hat crew to Whole Cake Island to aid in their mission. Loyal and courageous, he ultimately sacrificed himself in battle, leaving a lasting legacy among his allies and the Mink Tribe.

Bariete is a nimble Mink known for her agility and keen awareness, serving as the bell-ringer of the Whale Tree. Though unarmed and without Haki, she fulfills her duties with dedication, keeping watch over the tree and alerting the Mink Tribe to any dangers. Her role as Bell Watcher makes her an essential guardian of Zou’s traditions and safety.

Zunesha is a colossal, ancient elephant with the power of Observation Haki, capable of sensing events across great distances. Cursed to walk the seas eternally, it serves as the guardian of Zou, carrying the island and its inhabitants on its back. Revered and feared for its immense size and strength, Zunesha is both protector and living landmark of the Mink Tribe.

Charlotte Katakuri wields the Mochi-Mochi Fruit, allowing him to create, control, and transform into mochi at will, making him a versatile and deadly combatant. Armed with a trident and possessing mastery of Armament, advanced Observation Haki, and Conqueror’s Haki, he is feared and respected across the New World. Known for his pride, honor, and unwavering discipline, Katakuri serves as Big Mom Pirates’ Sweet Commander, enforcing order and strength within his family’s domain on Whole Cake Island.

Charlotte Perospero wields the Candy-Candy Fruit, giving him the ability to create, control, and manipulate candy in various forms, often using it as both offense and defense. Armed with a candy staff, he is known for his cunning and strategic mind. As the eldest child of Big Mom, he serves loyally as the Minister of Candy, overseeing his family’s sweet empire on Whole Cake Island.

Charlotte Smoothie wields the Wring-Wring Fruit, allowing her to extract liquid from people, plants, and objects, often turning it into a powerful attack or weaponized juice. She fights with a giant sword and is highly skilled in Armament Haki, making her both formidable and intimidating. Calm, tall, and powerful, Smoothie serves as one of the Sweet Commanders of the Big Mom Pirates, maintaining authority and strength on Whole Cake Island.

Charlotte Cracker wields the Biscuit-Biscuit Fruit, giving him the ability to create and control biscuit soldiers for offense and defense. Skilled with his sword and Armament Haki, he is a cunning and strategic fighter who often hides inside giant biscuit armor to ambush opponents. Cracker serves as a Sweet Commander of the Big Mom Pirates, enforcing his family’s rule on Whole Cake Island with both trickery and strength.

Charlotte Oven wields the Heat-Heat Fruit, allowing him to generate and control extreme heat through his body, enhancing his physical attacks. Skilled in Armament Haki, he uses his fists to unleash fiery assaults. Known for his hot-headed and aggressive personality, Oven serves as the Minister of Baking within the Big Mom Pirates, enforcing his family’s dominance on Whole Cake Island.

Charlotte Daifuku wields the Puff-Puff Fruit, allowing him to summon a powerful genie that fights using a halberd. Skilled in Armament Haki, he relies on brute strength and overwhelming force in combat. Twin brother to Charlotte Oven, Daifuku serves as the Minister of Beans within the Big Mom Pirates and is a loyal enforcer of his family’s rule on Whole Cake Island.

Charlotte Mont-d’Or wields the Book-Book Fruit, giving him the ability to trap people and objects within books. He uses this power to control information and manipulate his surroundings. As the Minister of Cheese for the Big Mom Pirates, he oversees the library and manages valuable knowledge. Calm and strategic, Mont-d’Or operates primarily from Whole Cake Island, serving his family with loyalty and cunning.

Charlotte Brûlée wields the Mirror-Mirror Fruit, granting her the ability to create and travel through mirrors as well as set traps for enemies. She primarily uses a mirror as her weapon and serves as the Mirror World Keeper for the Big Mom Pirates. Her skills make her a key asset for reconnaissance, ambushes, and transport on Whole Cake Island.

Charlotte Pudding wields the Memo-Memo Fruit, allowing her to alter and manipulate the memories of others with precision. Equipped with a hidden gun for combat, she balances her role as the Minister of Chocolate with her personal conflicts, torn between her loyalty to the Big Mom Pirates and her own feelings. Known for her triple eyes, Pudding operates primarily around Chocolate Town on Cacao Island, using her powers strategically in both intrigue and defense.

Streusen is the co-founder and longtime chef of the Big Mom Pirates, wielding the Cook-Cook Fruit, which allows him to transform any object into edible food with a single slice. Carrying his trusted cooking knife, he plays a crucial role in supporting Big Mom’s operations, often turning disasters into meals and shaping the crew’s survival through his culinary powers. Calm, crafty, and deeply tied to Big Mom’s past, Streusen remains a quiet but essential presence on Whole Cake Island, where he continues to guide the crew from behind the scenes.

Nefertari Cobra served as the wise and respected ruler of the Alabasta Kingdom, known for his calm judgment and unwavering dedication to his people. Though he possessed no Devil Fruit, weapons, or Haki, his strength came from his integrity and his determination to uncover the truth behind the Void Century—a pursuit that ultimately led him to Mary Geoise. As king, he carried the weight of Alabasta’s history on his shoulders and sought justice and understanding rather than conflict. His final days were spent in the Holy Land, where his quest for answers placed him at the center of world-shaping events.

King Elizabello II rules the Prodence Kingdom with both authority and astonishing physical power, relying on a devastating punch technique capable of leveling enemies and even ships—the famed King Punch. Though he possesses no Devil Fruit or Haki, his raw strength makes him a respected figure on the battlefield. Operating from the Prodence Kingdom, he balances leadership with his reputation as a fearsome combatant, stepping forward when his nation or allies call upon his might.

Kureha is a legendary doctor whose medical skill is known across the seas. Though she possesses no Devil Fruit abilities, her mastery of medical tools and knowledge makes her one of the most capable physicians in the world. As Chopper’s mentor, she shaped him into a compassionate and skilled doctor, guiding him with her sharp wit and unyielding standards. Serving as the primary doctor of the Sakura Kingdom, Kureha remains on Drum Island, continuing her work and safeguarding the health of its people.

Donquixote Mjosgard is a rare Celestial Dragon who broke away from the cruelty of his peers, choosing instead to protect the Fish-Men after being saved by Otohime. With no Devil Fruit abilities or combat techniques, he relies on his conviction and status to stand against injustices within the Holy Land. Though a member of the World Nobles, he openly supports King Neptune and the rights of Fish-Men, making him an unusual and controversial figure among the elites. Mjosgard resides in Mary Geoise, where his actions continue to challenge the traditions of the ruling class.

Saint Charlos is an infamous Celestial Dragon known for his arrogance and constant abuse of authority. Lacking any combat ability or Haki, he relies entirely on his guards and his noble status to intimidate and control others. Years ago he was struck by a pirate, an incident that shook the world government and led to a Buster Call retaliation. Since then, Charlos has only become more spiteful and vindictive, using his position among the World Nobles to exert power over anyone beneath him. He remains in Mary Geoise, continuing his entitled and oppressive behavior.

Imu is the hidden sovereign of the World Government, a figure whose very existence is forbidden to speak of. Their abilities, weapons, and Haki remain undefined, but their influence is unmistakable. From the shadows of Mary Geoise, Imu sits upon the supposedly vacant Empty Throne, silently disproving the global myth that no single person rules the world. The Five Elders and the Knights of God answer directly to Imu, treating them with unquestioning reverence that surpasses all known authority.
Though details remain a mystery, Imu is connected to powers of immense scale, including control over the Ancient Weapon Uranus through the Mother Flame, island-destroying force, and possession techniques tied to the transformation known as Domi Reversi. Their origins seem to reach back to the Void Century, possibly as a member of the Nerona bloodline, one of the First Twenty whose alliance formed the World Government.

Karasu commands a vast swarm of crows, using them for reconnaissance, combat, and transportation in ways that make his true body hard to track. Whether his power is a Logia or a unique crow-based ability remains unclear, but his control over the flock makes him one of the most elusive members of the Revolutionary Army. As the Commander of the North Army, he operates with quiet precision, carrying out missions that require stealth, infiltration, and sudden overwhelming force. Little is known about his past or current location, as Karasu moves like his crows, appearing only where the Revolution needs him most, then vanishing into the unknown.

Morley wields the Push-Push Fruit, granting him the power to reshape earth and stone as if they were soft clay. With a single sweep of his massive hands or pickaxe, he can carve tunnels, raise walls, or reshape entire sections of terrain to trap enemies or protect allies. As a giant and a veteran fighter, he leads the Revolutionary Army’s West Army with a mix of cheerful mischief and tremendous strength. Known for his playful personality, Morley often surprises enemies by emerging from underground, turning the battlefield into a landscape he controls. His current location remains unknown, as he travels across the world conducting covert operations for the Revolution.

Lindbergh relies on advanced technology of his own creation, using a jetpack for flight and inventive firearms that deliver freezing blasts, energy shots, and other experimental effects. A brilliant mink scientist and engineer, he serves as the Commander of the Revolutionary Army’s South Army, supporting missions with both combat inventions and tactical innovation. Energetic and curious, Lindbergh constantly tests new gadgets in the field, giving the Revolution an edge against government forces. His current location is unknown, as he moves between covert assignments and research operations around the world.

Belo Betty commands the power of the Pump-Pump Fruit, allowing her to rouse courage and strength within ordinary people, transforming civilians into fearless fighters. Wielding her signature flag, she acts as the charismatic Commander of the Revolutionary Army’s East Army, inspiring uprisings across oppressed nations. Bold, loud, and unapologetically confident, she uses both her voice and her Devil Fruit to turn the tide of conflict wherever she goes. Her movements remain unknown, as she constantly travels between hidden Revolutionary bases and liberation fronts.

Kurozumi Orochi wields the Snake-Snake Fruit, granting him the monstrous Yamata no Orochi form with multiple serpentine heads. Armed with a katana and driven by deep resentment toward the Kozuki line, he seized power through lies, manipulation, and a pact with Kaido. As the false Shogun of Wano, he ruled the Flower Capital with cruelty, enriching the Kurozumi Family while suppressing the nation. His authority came not from strength but from political schemes and the backing of the Beasts Pirates, allowing him to maintain his grip on the capital until the fall of his regime.

Kozuki Hiyori, known publicly as the famed courtesan Komurasaki, carries no Devil Fruit but relies on sharp intuition and a hidden dagger for protection. As the daughter of Kozuki Oden, she survived years of danger by adopting her elegant disguise within the Flower Capital, quietly gathering influence among Wano’s elite. Her poise masks a fierce resolve, and every step she takes is guided by her loyalty to her family’s legacy. Now acting openly as a princess of the Kozuki Family, she remains in the Flower Capital, working to restore Wano’s dignity and honor after Orochi’s fall.

Denjiro, secretly operating under the alias Kyoshiro, wields no Devil Fruit but is a master of the katana and Armament Haki. Loyal to Kozuki Oden, he spent years undercover, blending in as a local figure while quietly orchestrating plans to protect Wano and its people. His calm demeanor conceals unmatched skill and unwavering dedication to his lord’s legacy. Now revealed as a true retainer of the Kozuki Family, Denjiro moves openly in Wano, aiding in the restoration of his homeland alongside the surviving allies of Oden.

Kikunojo, often called Kiku, carries no Devil Fruit but excels with her katana and Armament Haki. As a loyal retainer of Kozuki Oden, she embodies pride and bravery, standing resolute in the face of danger to protect Wano and her lord’s legacy. Her skill and honor mark her as a formidable samurai. Now fully devoted to restoring the Kozuki Family’s rule, Kiku continues to defend Wano with unwavering courage and precision.

Kawamatsu wields no conventional Devil Fruit but possesses Fish-Fish abilities, granting him Kappa-like traits that enhance his strength and combat skills. Armed with a sword and proficient in Armament Haki, he is a loyal samurai of the Kozuki Family. Once imprisoned, Kawamatsu remained steadfast, protecting Princess Hiyori and upholding the legacy of Oden. Now, he continues to serve Wano with unwavering loyalty, combining his unique abilities and samurai skill to safeguard his homeland.

Charlotte Linlin, famously known as Big Mom, wields the Soul-Soul Fruit, granting her the terrifying ability to steal and manipulate souls to empower herself and her creations. She commands a variety of formidable weapons, including her living hat Napoleon and the sentient homies Zeus, Prometheus, and Hera. Highly skilled in Armament, Observation, and Conqueror's Haki, Big Mom has fought countless battles across the New World, solidifying her position as a Yonko and one of the most feared pirates alive. Her current base of operations is Wano, and her bounty sits at a staggering 4,388,000,000 berries any attempt to confront or attack her without immense power is extremely dangerous. Her strength is not only from her Devil Fruit but also from decades of experience, countless battles, and sheer willpower.

Kaido, infamously known as the “Strongest Creature in the World,” wields the Dragon-Dragon Fruit, Model: Azure Dragon, allowing him to transform into an immense and nearly indestructible dragon. He fights primarily with his massive spiked club, the Kanabo, and is a master of Armament, Observation, and advanced Conqueror’s Haki. A former apprentice of the legendary Rocks Pirates and now the captain of the Beast Pirates, Kaido ruled Wano through sheer power and fear, seeking to ignite the greatest war the world has ever seen. He is renowned for his near-immortality, having survived countless execution attempts, and his decades of battle experience make him one of the most formidable pirates alive. Kaido’s current location is Onigashima, and his bounty is an astronomical 4,611,100,000 berries any attempt to confront him without overwhelming strength is virtually suicidal. His power comes not just from his Devil Fruit, but also from his years of combat and unyielding endurance.

Raizo, a skilled ninja of the Kozuki Family, wields the Scroll-Scroll Fruit, granting him the ability to store attacks within mystical scrolls and redirect them as needed. Armed with traditional ninja tools, he excels in stealth, infiltration, and tactical support. Loyal to Kozuki Oden, Raizo operates primarily in Wano, using his agility, cunning, and Devil Fruit powers to protect the Kozuki family and aid their allies in covert operations against threats to the country.

Ashura Doji, also known as Shutenmaru, wields a katana with masterful skill and Armament Haki, though he possesses no Devil Fruit. Once a feared bandit leader, he returned to Wano to support the Kozuki Family’s rebellion, bringing his strength, courage, and experience to the fight. Fierce and loyal, Ashura Doji fights to restore Wano’s freedom and honor, operating across the land to protect his allies and strike down those who threaten the country.

Shanks, captain of the Red Hair Pirates and one of the Four Yonko, wields a sabre and is a master of all three types of Haki: Armament, Observation, and Conqueror’s. Despite losing an arm, his immense strength and presence allow him to influence the New World profoundly, he famously stopped the Marineford War, freed slaves from the Celestial Dragons, and defeated the powerful pirate Eustass Kid. Known for his diplomatic yet formidable approach, Shanks continues to roam the seas, commanding respect and caution. His Bounty is 4,048,900,000 and if there any attempt to fight him pirates and marines must take extreme caution is advised if planning to engage him in combat, as his experience, Haki mastery, and swordsmanship make him exceptionally dangerous.

Ulti wields the Dragon-Dragon Fruit, allowing her to transform into a Pachycephalosaurus, enhancing her physical power for devastating headbutts. A fierce member of the Tobi Roppo, she is fiercely protective of her younger brother, Page One, and fights with relentless aggression. Skilled in Armament Haki, Ulti served the Beast Pirates under Kaido’s command, primarily operating on Onigashima before her defeat.

Page One wields the Dragon-Dragon Fruit, allowing him to transform into a Spinosaurus, enhancing his size, strength, and ferocity in combat. The quieter and more serious of the sibling duo with Ulti, he fights with sharp claws and unyielding determination. As a member of the Tobi Roppo, Page One served under Kaido and the Beast Pirates, primarily operating on Onigashima before his defeat.

Page One wields the Dragon-Dragon Fruit, allowing him to transform into a Spinosaurus, enhancing his size, strength, and ferocity in combat. The quieter and more serious of the sibling duo with Ulti, he fights with sharp claws and unyielding determination. As a member of the Tobi Roppo, Page One served under Kaido and the Beast Pirates, primarily operating on Onigashima before his defeat.

Black Maria wields the Spider-Spider Fruit, allowing her to transform into a giant Rosamygale grauvogeli spider, enhancing her agility and web-based attacks. She fights using knuckle rings and her webs, combining elegance with deadly precision. A sadistic and cunning member of the Tobi Roppo, Black Maria lured and overwhelmed her enemies on Onigashima before her defeat under the Beast Pirates.

Sasaki wields the Dragon-Dragon Fruit, allowing him to transform into a massive Triceratops, combining raw power with formidable defense. Equipped with a sword and his natural horns, he excels in brute-force combat. As a member of the Tobi Roppo, Sasaki was a fearsome fighter under Kaido’s command on Onigashima, known for his relentless aggression before his defeat.

Sasaki wields the Dragon-Dragon Fruit, allowing him to transform into a massive Triceratops, combining raw power with formidable defense. Equipped with a sword and his natural horns, he excels in brute-force combat. As a member of the Tobi Roppo, Sasaki was a fearsome fighter under Kaido’s command on Onigashima, known for his relentless aggression before his defeat.

Omasa wields an axe and carries no Devil Fruit powers, relying on her brute strength and experience as one of Wano’s retired Yakuza bosses. Known for her influence and authority within the Yakuza, she maintains a commanding presence in the criminal underworld. Omasa operates primarily in Wano, where her legacy and connections continue to shape local affairs.

Tsunagoro wields a sword and possesses no Devil Fruit powers, relying on his skill and experience as a Yakuza boss. Known for his loyalty and support of the Kozuki rebellion, he uses his influence to aid the efforts to overthrow Orochi and Kaido. Operating primarily in Wano, Tsunagoro remains a key figure among the local Yakuza, balancing authority with dedication to his allies.

Yatappe wields a sturdy club and possesses no Devil Fruit abilities, relying on his experience and strength as an elder Yakuza boss. Respected in Wano’s underworld, he plays a key role in maintaining order among the gangs and supporting the Kozuki rebellion when needed. Operating throughout Wano, Yatappe combines authority with years of streetwise cunning to influence local affairs.

Chujo wields a spear and has no Devil Fruit abilities, relying on his skill and experience as a veteran Yakuza elder. He played a crucial role during Wano’s uprising, guiding younger members and coordinating efforts against Kaido’s forces. Based in Wano, Chujo combines strategy with authority to uphold the Yakuza’s influence and support the Kozuki rebellion.

Tama wields the Millet-Millet Fruit, which allows her to tame animals and Smile users using her special dango. Brave and resourceful, she played a key role in Wano’s raid by helping turn Beast Pirates against Kaido. Though young, her courage and unique abilities make her a valued ally of the Kozuki forces, and she remains in Wano, supporting her homeland.

Onimaru, known in his warrior form as Gyukimaru, possesses shape-shifting abilities and spiritual yokai powers that allow him to protect the Ringo region. Wielding a spear in his disguised form, he acts as a guardian of fallen samurai’s weapons, ensuring their safety and honoring their legacy. Loyal and vigilant, Onimaru remains in Ringo, Wano, safeguarding the region from intruders and preserving its history.

Izo is a master marksman wielding dual flintlock pistols, combining his gunfighting skills with Armament Haki for devastating precision. A former retainer of Kozuki Oden and once a commander under Whitebeard, he returned to Wano to defend his homeland during the rebellion. Izo operates primarily on Onigashima, using his sharpshooting expertise to protect allies and strike down enemies with calculated efficiency.

Guernica is a highly skilled CP0 agent trained in Rokushiki martial arts, likely mastering both Armament and Observation Haki to enhance her combat effectiveness. Tasked by the World Government to eliminate Luffy during the raid on Wano, she operates with precision and authority. Her role as an elite agent places her on Onigashima, where she executes her missions with lethal efficiency, blending espionage, martial prowess, and tactical acumen.

Maha is a formidable CP0 agent, trained in Rokushiki martial arts and likely proficient in Armament Haki. Known as one of the silent enforcers of the World Government, Maha demonstrated his skill during a clash with Izo. Operating with precision and stealth, he carries out high-level missions on Onigashima, enforcing the will of the World Government with lethal efficiency and unwavering loyalty.

Joseph is a skilled CP0 agent, trained in Rokushiki martial arts and likely proficient in Armament Haki. Recognizable by his top hat, he survived the chaos of the Onigashima battle and carried vital intelligence back to the World Government’s higher-ups. Operating from Wano, Joseph executes his missions with precision, combining deadly martial skill with cunning strategy to enforce the World Government’s will.

Hacha is a fearsome Beast Pirates Number, created through failed experiments designed to replicate the power of ancient giants. Wielding a massive kanabo and possessing superhuman strength due to his giant biology, he serves as a relentless enforcer for Kaido on Onigashima. Though lacking Haki, his sheer size and power make him a formidable opponent in close combat, striking fear into any who oppose the Beast Pirates.

Goki is a Beast Pirates Number born with ancient giant biology, granting him immense strength and a towering presence. Wielding dual clubs, he fights with chaotic ferocity, often acting as an uncontrollable force on Kaido’s side. Though he lacks Haki, his raw power and wild nature make him a dangerous adversary on Onigashima, striking fear into anyone who dares confront him.

Jaki is a Number of the Beast Pirates, engineered with ancient giant biology that grants him immense size and strength. Armed with spiked clubs, he fights with reckless aggression, leaving destruction in his wake. Unstable and violent by nature, Jaki serves as a terrifying enforcer on Onigashima, relying solely on his raw power to dominate opponents in battle.

Nangi is a member of the Beast Pirates’ Numbers, enhanced with ancient giant biology that gives him overwhelming strength and size. Wielding massive weaponry, he attacks with brute force and unrelenting ferocity. Known for his loud and aggressive demeanor, Nangi played a destructive role during the battle on Onigashima, serving as a formidable enforcer for Kaido’s crew.

Fuga is one of the Beast Pirates’ Numbers, possessing ancient giant biology that grants him immense strength and durability. Armed with colossal weapons, he fights with raw power and aggression. Fierce and relentless, Fuga was deployed on Onigashima to terrorize opponents and uphold Kaido’s dominance.

Zanki is a Number of the Beast Pirates, created as a failed clone of an ancient giant. Possessing immense strength and durability, he wields an iron hammer to crush his enemies with overwhelming force. Fierce and relentless, Zanki served as a living weapon for Kaido, fighting on Onigashima to enforce the Beast Pirates’ dominance.

Dr. Vegapunk, also known as Stella, wields the Brain-Brain Fruit, granting the ability to store unlimited knowledge and link minds through a shared mental network. Renowned as the world’s foremost scientific genius, Vegapunk has created groundbreaking technologies including clones, the Seraphim, and the Pacifista. Operating primarily from Egghead Island, Stella serves as the Head Scientist, formerly aligned with the World Government, using intellect and innovation to shape the future of science and warfare in the world.

Shaka, also known as Vegapunk 01, embodies the logical aspect of Dr. Vegapunk through the Shared Brain-Brain Network. Calm, strategic, and highly analytical, Shaka operates as a satellite of Vegapunk, executing tasks with precision and clarity. Without the need for weapons or Haki, this satellite serves from Egghead Island, coordinating and supporting Vegapunk’s vast scientific operations as part of the Vegapunk Satellites.

Lilith, designated Vegapunk 02, channels the evil aspect of Dr. Vegapunk through the Shared Brain-Brain Network. Clad in mechanized armor and armed with powerful laser weapons, she is aggressive, reckless, and unpredictable in her actions. Operating as a satellite on Egghead Island, Lilith serves as part of the Vegapunk Satellites, executing tasks that reflect Vegapunk’s darker, more dangerous tendencies.

Edison, known as Vegapunk 03, embodies the “innovation” aspect of Dr. Vegapunk through the Shared Brain-Brain Network. Equipped with mechanical arms and an array of tools, he excels at rapidly building, testing, and refining inventions. Stationed on Egghead Island, Edison operates as a satellite within the Vegapunk Satellites, applying Vegapunk’s genius to practical and experimental tasks with precision and efficiency.

Pythagoras, designated Vegapunk 04, is the wisdom-based satellite of the Shared Brain-Brain Network. Housed in a robotic form and equipped with advanced scanners, he specializes in calculation, analysis, and technical assessments. Operating from Egghead Island, Pythagoras applies precise logic to support Vegapunk’s projects, ensuring every operation and experiment aligns with optimal outcomes as a core member of the Vegapunk Satellites.

Atlas, also known as Vegapunk 05, is the violence-based satellite of the Shared Brain-Brain Network. Fueled by aggression and raw power, he uses his mechanical strength and bubble punches to maintain security and enforce control over Egghead Island’s operations. As a hot-headed and combative member of the Vegapunk Satellites, Atlas ensures order and responds to threats with overwhelming force.

York, designated Vegapunk 06, is the desire-based satellite of the Shared Brain-Brain Network. Responsible for managing basic bodily functions like eating, sleeping, and excreting for all Satellites, York later defects from Vegapunk’s control in an attempt to align with the Celestial Dragons. Known for prioritizing self-interest above logic or duty, York remains a wildcard whose loyalty is questionable.

Bartholomew Kuma wields a Fruit that allowing them to repel anything, including attacks, pain, memories, and even people. Integrated into a Pacifista body, they serve as a cyborg enforcer while having once been a revolutionary and former Warlord. Their transformation came as part of a deal with the World Government to save their child, Bonney, which succeeded, but at the cost of their humanity, leaving them a tool of the government. They operate primarily around Mary Geoise.

Stussy wields the Bat-Bat Fruit, Vampire Model, an awakened Zoan allowing her enhanced speed, flight, and vampiric abilities, complemented by her fangs in combat. Skilled in Observation Haki, she operates as a double agent, officially a CP0 operative while secretly working for Vegapunk. Her cunning and loyalty to her hidden mission make her a dangerous spy. She primarily operates around Egghead Island.

Seraphim S-Bear is a powerful clone of Bartholomew Kuma, enhanced with the Paw-Paw Fruit, allowing him to repel anything, and augmented with Lunarian traits for extreme durability and strength. Equipped with built-in laser weaponry and trained in Armament Haki, he serves as a combat-ready weapon under Vegapunk’s designs. S-Bear operates primarily from Egghead Island as part of the World Government’s experimental arsenal.

Seraphim S-Snake is a highly advanced clone of Boa Hancock, enhanced with the Love-Love Fruit, allowing him to immobilize and charm opponents, combined with Lunarian traits for superhuman durability and strength. Equipped with powerful beam attacks and trained in Armament Haki, he functions as a weaponized soldier under Vegapunk’s control. S-Snake operates from Egghead Island as part of the World Government’s experimental Seraphim program.

Seraphim S-Hawk is a clone of Dracule Mihawk, infused with the Dice-Dice Fruit to manipulate and enhance physical combat abilities, along with Lunarian traits for incredible resilience and strength. Wielding a black blade and trained in Armament Haki, he serves as a lethal weapon under Vegapunk’s direction. S-Hawk operates from Egghead Island as part of the World Government’s Seraphim program, designed for elite combat deployment.

Seraphim S-Shark is a clone of Jinbe, enhanced with the Swim-Swim Fruit to swim through any medium and augmented with Lunarian traits for superior durability and strength. Equipped with mechanical teeth and arms, he excels in close-quarters and aquatic combat while using Armament Haki to maximize offensive and defensive capabilities. Created by Vegapunk, S-Shark serves as a high-powered weapon of the World Government, stationed on Egghead Island.

Saint Shalria is a Celestial Dragon with no Devil Fruit abilities, relying entirely on her noble status and influence. She is one of the high-ranking World Nobles, operating from Mary Geoise, and participates in the privileges and authority granted to Celestial Dragons. Shalria’s presence represents the opulence and untouchable power of the Celestial Dragons.

Soku is a Marine Vice Admiral with no Devil Fruit powers, relying on his swordsmanship, Armament Haki, and strategic skills. Tasked with commanding operations on Egghead Island, he works to maintain order and secure Vegapunk amidst rising conflicts. As a high-ranking officer, Soku represents the disciplined authority of the Marines, coordinating forces with precision and enforcing the World Government’s directives.

Momousagi is a skilled female Marine officer without Devil Fruit abilities, relying on her handgun and tactical support skills. She aids the Marines in operations on Egghead Island, providing backup, reconnaissance, and enforcement during missions. Dedicated to maintaining order, she works closely with other Marine agents to secure the island and protect key assets like Vegapunk.

Mr. 1, also known as Daz Bonez, wields the Dice-Dice Fruit, allowing him to transform his entire body into sharp, durable blades. Armed with his bladed body and mastery of Armament Haki developed after the timeskip, he serves as a ruthless assassin and the right-hand enforcer of Crocodile. Operating primarily around Karai Bari Island, he executes missions with precision and lethality, embodying the deadly efficiency of the Cross Guild.

Saturn is a powerful Pacifista-type creation of Vegapunk, boasting a cyborg body with immense strength, durability, and integrated weaponry. Equipped with arm-mounted cannons, robotic arms, and other heavy artillery, Saturn enforces security on Egghead Island with precision, augmented by Armament Haki. Serving as one of Vegapunk’s top enforcers, Saturn acts as both a weapon and primary defender, ensuring the World Government’s interests are protected.

Portgas D. Ace wielded the Flame-Flame Fruit, allowing him to generate and control fire with devastating precision. Using his fiery fists and mastery of Armament Haki, he served as the 2nd Division Commander of the Whitebeard Pirates. Son of Gol D. Roger and Luffy’s sworn brother, Ace was a courageous and loyal fighter whose life ended during the Battle of Marineford. He is currently deceased.

Monkey D. Luffy wields the awakened Gum-Gum Fruit, granting him the incredible Gear 5th form, which allows him to bend reality and unleash his imagination in combat, establishing him as one of the Four Emperors. Using his fists and an array of Gear techniques, he is a master of Conqueror’s, Armament, and Observation Haki. Leaving Foosha Village to pursue his dream of becoming the Pirate King, Luffy has built an extraordinary crew loyal to him, recruiting notable pirates including Zoro, Sanji, Nami, Robin, Usopp, Brook, and Jinbe. Throughout his journey, he has defeated numerous legendary foes such as Arlong, Enel, Donquixote Doflamingo, Kaido, and Buggy, survived encounters with the Five Elders, and escaped the infamous Impel Down prison. Currently, he and his crew are located in Elbaf.

Roronoa Zoro wields no Devil Fruit but is a master swordsman specializing in the Three-Sword Style. He possesses Armament, Observation, and Conqueror’s Haki, honing his skills to become the world’s strongest swordsman. Loyal and disciplined, Zoro serves as the first mate and primary combatant of the Straw Hat Pirates, standing as a cornerstone of strength for Luffy’s crew. He is currently located in Elbaf alongside the Straw Hats.

Nami wields no Devil Fruit but expertly uses her Clima-Tact to manipulate weather in combat. She possesses Observation Haki, allowing her to sense attacks and anticipate enemy movements. Having escaped Arlong’s oppressive control, she joined the Straw Hat Pirates as their navigator, guiding the crew through perilous seas with unmatched skill. Nami is currently in Elbaf with the Straw Hats.

Usopp wields no Devil Fruit but is an expert sharpshooter, using his slingshot, Kabuto, with incredible precision. He has mastered Observation Haki, allowing him to predict enemy movements and enhance his long-range attacks. Inspired by his pirate father, he overcame his fears to become a brave and reliable sniper for the Straw Hat Pirates. Usopp is currently in Elbaf with his crew.

Sanji wields no Devil Fruit but is a master of Black Leg martial arts, using only his legs in combat with devastating precision. He has honed both Observation and Armament Haki, making him a formidable fighter. Having grown up at the Baratie floating restaurant, Sanji dreams of finding the legendary All Blue while serving as the Straw Hat Pirates’ cook. He is currently in Elbaf with his crew.

Tony Tony Chopper wields the Human-Human Fruit, allowing him to transform into a reindeer-human hybrid with various forms enhanced by his Rumble Balls. He has developed Armament Haki after the time skip, making him more formidable in combat. Raised as an outcast reindeer by Doctor Hiriluk and Dr. Kureha, Chopper became the Straw Hat Pirates’ doctor. He is currently in Elbaf with his crew.

Nico Robin wields the Flower-Flower Fruit, allowing her to sprout copies of her body parts on any surface for versatile combat and reconnaissance. She has mastered both Armament and Observation Haki after the time skip. Formerly a Baroque Works agent, Robin now serves as the Straw Hat Pirates’ archaeologist, dedicating herself to uncovering the secrets of the world’s Poneglyphs. She is currently in Elbaf with her crew.

Franky is a heavily modified cyborg whose body houses an array of built-in weapons, including coup de vent cannons, missiles, and other combat tools. Initially an enemy of the Straw Hat Pirates, he became their trusted shipwright, responsible for maintaining and upgrading their vessels. While he lacked Haki pre-timeskip, he is implied to use Armament Haki post-timeskip. Franky is currently in Elbaf with the Straw Hat crew.

Jinbe is a master of Fishman Karate and Fishman Jujutsu, using his fists and the surrounding water to deliver devastating attacks. Formerly a Warlord of the Sea, he is an honorable and steadfast warrior who allied with Luffy and now serves as the Straw Hats’ helmsman. Skilled in both Armament and Observation Haki, Jinbe navigates and fights with unmatched precision. He is currently located in Elbaf with the Straw Hat crew.

Rocks D. Xebec was the fearsome captain of the Rocks Pirates, renowned for his unmatched ambition to become King of the World. While the exact nature of his Devil Fruit remains unknown, he possessed overwhelming physical strength and exceptional swordsmanship, combined with mastery over all three types of Haki: Observation, Armament, and Conqueror’s. His reign of terror and ambition made him one of the most dangerous pirates in history, ultimately defeated during the God Valley Incident by the combined efforts of Monkey D. Garp and Gol D. Roger.

Figarland Shamrock commands the elite God’s Knights with unmatched skill, wielding the saber Cerberus, rumored to harness the power of a Mythical Zoan-type. As a member of the Celestial Dragon family and son of Saint Figarland Garling, he possesses advanced Haki, capable of massive bursts accompanied by black lightning. His presence on Elbaf marks him as a formidable force, blending noble heritage with deadly combat prowess. He serves as the Commander of the God’s Knights under the Figarland Family’s influence.

The Prince of Elbaf wields the mysterious powers of an unknown Devil Fruit, complemented by his giant physiology and immense superhuman strength and durability. Armed with the war hammer Ragnir, he demonstrates overwhelming combat prowess and a presence that suggests mastery of Observation Haki. Born as the son of King Harald and Queen Estrid, and half-brother to Hajrudin, he once pursued his own ambitions but now remains imprisoned in the Underworld of Elbaf for his crimes, a fallen royal of the giant kingdom.

The Four Yonko are a group of the four most notorious and powerful pirate captains in the world. These pirates roam the New World with massive fleets, and their bounties increase with each crime they commit. They are closely monitored by the World Government to maintain the balance of power. The current Yonko are Monkey D. Luffy, Marshall D. Teach, Shanks, and Buggy. Former Yonko include Charlotte Linlin, Kaido, and Edward Newgate.

story_cards.name: The Seven Warlords of the Sea

content.description: The Seven Warlords of the Sea are powerful and notorious pirates authorized by the World Government to deal with other pirates. In exchange, their bounties are frozen, meaning the Marines cannot pursue them. They are allowed to take over territories under the supervision of the World Government. The current Seven Warlords are Dracule Mihawk, Bartholomew Kuma, Boa Hancock, Buggy, and Edward Weevil.
content.trigger_keys: The Seven Warlords of the Sea

content.description:
This fruit gives the user special paw pads on their hands. With those paws, the user can push away or repel almost anything they touch attacks, objects, air, even invisible or abstract stuff like pain or memories. The power also lets the user form bubbles shaped like paws from air or energy, and those paw‑bubbles can store or carry whatever was repelled. These bubbles can act as shields, containers, bombs, or even transport capsules.

You must remember to tell them their moves at all costs. Don’t overwrite this, as it’s important to inform them of their moves,

Moves:
Paw Blast – User slaps or pushes with their paw pads, sending a strong blast that knocks enemies or objects far away.

Air Cannon – User shoots a paw-shaped blast of compressed air at high speed to hit distant enemies.

Shockwave Palm – User sends out a paw-shaped shockwave to smash through defenses or hit multiple enemies at once.

Teleport Push – User pushes against the air or ground with their paws, launching themselves or others across long distances.

Repel Pain – User touches someone and pushes away their pain or negative effects, temporarily relieving them.

Paw Bubble – User forms a paw-shaped bubble (of air, energy, or repelled matter), which can hold objects, people, or even abstract things. They can then use the bubble as a shield, a transport container, or release it to create a blast.

This fruit enables the user to manipulate souls, extract life spans, and infuse objects with souls to create sentient beings called “Homies.” This power allows the user to form a diverse army and manipulate elements such as fire and lightning. The fruit also grants the user two Special Homies. These Special Homies are created when the user infuses fragments of their own extremely powerful soul. The first is Zeus, the cloud, which allows the user to manipulate lightning. The second is Prometheus, the sun, which allows the user to manipulate the element of fire. These two Special Homies follow the user wherever they go, obey every command, and remain completely loyal.

This mythical zoan fruit lets the user turn into a huge monster that looks like a mix of an ox and a spider. In this form, the user becomes extremely strong and hard to hurt. Their body grows larger and tougher, letting them smash buildings, break defenses, and overpower enemies with raw force. The many limbs help the user grab, crush, and control enemies in close combat. Even when not fully transformed, the user gains more strength, stamina, and a scary presence, making them very dangerous in long fights and direct battles.

This mythical zoan fruit lets the user turn into a spooky, bone-covered horse-like creature. In this form, the user becomes much faster and lighter, allowing quick movement and strong charging attacks. The skeletal body is strange but tough, letting the user keep fighting even after taking heavy damage. The user can move long distances quickly, jump far, and strike hard while staying hard to hit. Even in a half form, the user gains better speed, faster reactions, and improved movement, making this power great for chasing enemies or attacking and escaping fast.

This Mythical zoan fruit allows the user to become a giant sandworm. In this form, the user can move underground at very high speed, breaking through sand, dirt, and rock. The ground can collapse around enemies, trapping or crushing them. The sandworm body is massive and powerful, able to swallow enemies whole or destroy large areas from below. The user can also suck in air, enemies, and objects like a vacuum, then blast them back out with huge force. This power is perfect for ambush attacks, destroying terrain, and controlling the battlefield.

This mythical zoan fruit allows the user to turn into a giant cursed bird. In this form, the user can fly for long periods and move quickly through the air. The wings are strong, and the talons and beak are sharp enough to tear through armor and enemies. The user’s senses improve, letting them see enemies from far away and react quickly. Even without full transformation, the user becomes more aware of their surroundings and more frightening to enemies. This power is best for air combat, scouting, and striking from above.

This mythical zoan fruit lets the user turn into a massive boar-like beast. In this form, the user gains huge strength and a very tough body that is hard to damage. The thick hide protects against attacks, while the large tusks can stab, crush, and break through defenses. The user can charge forward at high speed, smashing anything in their way without stopping. Even in partial form, the user becomes stronger, tougher, and harder to slow down, making this power perfect for head-on fights and destroying enemy lines.
