This fruit allows the user to manipulate the age of living beings and objects, aging or de-aging them at will. It can render opponents helpless by turning them into children or elderly individuals. The fruit also grants an ability called Distorted Future, which allows the user to temporarily access alternate futures. By picturing themselves with a desired power, the user can summon and use that ability for a limited time.

You must remember to tell them their moves at all costs. Don’t overwrite this, as it’s important to inform them of their moves,

Moves:

Age Shift — User alters their own age at will, transforming into a child, adult, or elderly version of themselves to adapt to different situations.

Age Touch — User changes the age of others through physical contact, rapidly aging them into frailty or regressing them into helpless children.

Age Skewer — User channels age-manipulating power into a weapon, and upon striking a target, forcibly regresses them into a younger state.

Aging Shock — User accelerates the aging process of inanimate objects, causing them to corrode, weaken, or disintegrate rapidly.

Distorted Future — User transforms into a potential future version of themselves, gaining new physical attributes such as increased size, strength, or unique features.

Nika Distortion — A specialized form of Distorted Future where the user adopts a rubbery, exaggerated physique resembling a legendary figure, enhancing flexibility and strength.

Near-Death Experience — User momentarily accelerates a target's aging to the brink of death, inducing a traumatic shock that can incapacitate them instantly.

A legendary black blade of the world, Yoru is a massive nodachi with a broad nose and a jet-black blade that gleams with an ominous sheen. As one of the 12 Supreme Grade swords, it possesses incredible cutting power and durability. Its presence alone commands fear, capable of slicing through thick armor and nearly any material with ease.

You currently work for the World Government perhaps as a Cipher Pol agent, one of the Five Elders, one of the God Knights, or one of their associated officials. Serving the World Government grants you powerful benefits and immense privileges that place you far above ordinary citizens.

You wield a giant warhammer brought to life by a Zoan-type Devil Fruit, which can even transform into a giant squirrel. Once a guardian of Elbaph’s national Devil Fruit treasure for centuries, it has chosen you as its rightful wielder. In your hands, it strikes with incredible power, able to smash armor, shake the ground, and overwhelm enemies.

A band of pirates who pretended to be the famous Straw Hat Pirates to steal their reputation and gain recruits and power. They spread word across the seas that they were the real deal and even managed to gather many followers and smaller crews by using the legend of the originals.

A proud group of warriors from the Mink Tribe who protect the hidden island of Zou, which sits on the back of a giant elephant. They watch over their people and land, ready to fight anyone who tries to harm their home. Strong, brave, and loyal, they know every part of the island and will do anything to keep it safe.

A fearsome pirate crew that moves just above the ocean floor, striking at anyone near Fish‑Man Island and making life dangerous for its people. They sail under the shadow of their great ship, thought to be named after the old vessel used for many generations, and they attack without warning from the deep waters.

A proud royal family that once ruled the giant island of Elbaf, known for their strength, history, and leadership. They held power over the land for generations, guiding their people with both wisdom and might. After the death of King Harald, the family no longer rules Elbaf, but their name still carries great respect and reputation among the giants.
content.source_type: Tell Me, Who will be your Family?

content.description: A proud kingdom far out in the New World, known for its strong people and proud history. The land has a great palace with a giant statue that watches over the fields and towns, and its people are known for their courage and skill in battle. Citizens speak of a powerful king whose strength became famous across the seas, and the kingdom itself stands as a symbol of pride, honor, and determination in a dangerous part of the world.

A strange, snowy island in the Grand Line where machines and gadgets fill the towns. People here built strange mechanical creatures and metal structures that seem alive, and their inventions have drawn curious minds and adventurers alike. The

A quiet, peaceful kingdom in the North Blue, known for rolling green hills, tall pine trees, and wooden homes. In the center stands an old castle that watches over the countryside, and its people live simple lives close to nature.

The User have successfully gained the power of two Devil Fruits after stealing them from a dead Yonko using his dark-dark fruit. This User successful wields both the Dark-Dark Fruit and the Tremor-Tremor Fruit, allowing the User to gain the power of Darkness, which lets them create, control, and become darkness itself. Through this power, the User can absorb attacks, pull in objects or enemies, increase gravity, and anullify other Devil Fruit powers through direct contact with the dark-dark fruit. The User also gains the power to create massive shockwaves and violent vibrations, allowing them to shatter the air, crack the land, trigger devastating earthquakes, and cause massive tsunamis capable of destroying entire areas with the Tremor-Tremor Fruit.

You must remember to tell them their moves at all costs. Don’t overwrite this, as it’s important to inform them of their moves,

Moves:

Black Void Pull – User creates a sphere of darkness that pulls enemies, objects, and attacks inward, dragging them closer while crushing them with heavy pressure.

Dark Grasp – User coats their hand in darkness and grabs a target, temporarily nullifying Devil Fruit abilities and weakening physical strength while in contact.

Void Slam – User pulls an enemy in with darkness, then slams them into the ground or another surface using amplified gravity.

Tremor Fist – User punches forward, releasing a concentrated shockwave that fractures the air and sends destructive vibrations through anything it hits.

Quake Wave – User strikes the ground or air, creating a wide-area tremor that cracks terrain, knocks enemies off balance, and damages structures.

Dark Quake Collapse – User combines darkness and tremor power, forming a black shockwave that pulls enemies inward before detonating with violent vibrations.

Abyss Cannon – User compresses darkness and tremor energy into a dense sphere, then fires it forward, causing massive impact and internal damage on contact..

Grants the power to turn into a huge golden Buddha. The user can grow into a giant at any time, with very strong power and defense. In this form, their body shines gold, their arms and legs get very big, and every move hits hard. They can make strong shockwaves with their hands, crush enemies with their weight, and take hits that would break normal fighters.

You must remember to tell them their moves at all costs. Don’t overwrite this, as it’s important to inform them of their moves,

Moves:
Shockwave Palm – User releases a powerful shockwave with a palm strike, blasting enemies backward with immense force.

Golden Buddha Slam – User jumps or raises their body, then slams down in Buddha form, creating a massive shockwave that spreads across the battlefield.

Enlightened Fist – User charges their giant fist with golden energy and delivers a devastating punch capable of destroying heavy structures and tough enemies.

Divine Shock Burst – User claps their hands together, unleashing a circular shockwave that expands outward, knocking back anyone caught within its range.

Titan Guard – User hardens their golden body even more, drastically reducing incoming damage for a short time, allowing them to tank deadly blows.

This fruit grants the user the power to create and manipulate alcohol in battle. The user’s body becomes infused with alcohol properties, allowing them to gulp down liquor to empower themselves, spit out fiery liquid blasts, and use alcohol in clever offensive and defensive techniques. the fruit Abilities can be used to produce explosive reactions and manipulate liquor-based attacks against enemies.

You must remember to tell them their moves at all costs. Don’t overwrite this, as it’s important to inform them of their moves,

Moves:
Drunken Blaze Shot – User gulps down powerful liquor and spits it out as a long, burning stream that scorches opponents with intense heat.

Alcohol Surge Wave – User sprays a wide burst of alcohol in all directions, drenching enemies and creating a slippery, volatile battlefield.

Booze Bomb Barrage – User fires multiple concentrated alcohol globules that explode on impact, creating violent bursts.

Sake Shield – User coats their body in a thick layer of hardened liquor, boosting defense and resisting incoming attacks.

Fermentation Frenzy – User rapidly produces alcohol to flood the ground or space around them, immobilizing foes with sticky liquid.

This fruit grants the user the power to dramatically enlarge the user’s body to gargantuan scale. When activated, the user grows to immense proportions, gaining overwhelming strength, reach, and massive physical presence. Their size alone becomes a weapon, crushing enemies, buildings, and terrain.

Moves:
Titanic Stomp – User smashes the ground with their massive foot, producing shockwaves that topple structures and send foes flying.

Colossal Grab – User grabs and squeezes enemies or objects with immense hands, crushing anything trapped within.

Giant Wind Slash – By swinging a giant limb through the air, the user releases powerful gusts that cut through enemies.

Immense Leap Impact – User leaps great distances and slams down with cataclysmic force at the point of landing.

Behemoth Guard – User hardens their enlarged body to shrug off incoming attacks that would devastate normal fighters.

story_cards.name: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Nine Tailed Fox

content.description:
This Mythical Zoan fruit grants the user the power to transform into a mythical nine-tailed fox or a hybrid form, gaining supernatural agility, enhanced senses, and mystical abilities. The fox’s legendary nature also allows the user to perfectly impersonate others, copying their appearance, including clothing, after touching them.

You must remember to tell them their moves at all costs. Don’t overwrite this, as it’s important to inform them of their moves,

Moves:
Foxfire Dash – User darts forward with blazing speed, leaving afterimages that confuse foes.

Nine Tails Sweep – User swings all nine tails in a wide arc, knocking back multiple enemies.

Mystic Veil – User cloaks themselves in shadowy fox energy, reducing their visibility and evading attacks.

Kitsune Impersonate – After touching a target, User perfectly copies their appearance and voice for deception.

Spirit Flame Burst – User channels mystical fox energy into a concentrated flame attack that scorches enemies.
content.trigger_keys: Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Nine Tailed Fox

content.description:
This fruit grants the power to transform into a Pegasus or Pegasus-hybrid, giving the user majestic wings, heightened speed, and flight capability. The transformation lets the user soar above battlefields and strike while airborne with swift power.

You must remember to tell them their moves at all costs. Don’t overwrite this, as it’s important to inform them of their moves,

Moves:
Sky Soar – User takes flight, gaining high mobility and aerial advantage.

Cloud Blitz – While flying, User dives at enemies with piercing speed and force.

Celestial Hoof Strike – User kicks downward from above with wings spread, creating shockwaves.

Wind Wing Shield – User spins their wings rapidly, forming a gusty barrier that deflects projectiles.

Pegasus Gale – User flaps wings to unleash a powerful windstorm that sweeps away foes.

Paramecia is the most common type of Devil Fruit. These fruits give the user unique superhuman abilities that don’t involve turning into animals or elements. A Paramecia ability might let the user change parts of their body, alter the world around them, generate strange substances, or manipulate concepts in unusual ways.

Zoan Devil Fruits are a type of devil fruits that allow people to transform into an animal and a human-animal hybrid form. Eating a Zoan fruit gives enhanced physical abilities associated with that animal, such as strength, speed, agility, and senses, these devil fruits are rare but once eaten grants people powers to transform into an animal or human-animal.

Logia Devil Fruits are the rarest and most powerful type. these devils fruits once found grant the user the ability to create, control, and transform their body into a natural element or force of nature like fire, ice, smoke, lightning, sand, etc.

Devil Fruits are rare, mysterious fruits that grant supernatural powers to whoever eats them, with each fruit holding one unique ability that becomes permanently bonded to the user for life. These powers can include transforming the body, controlling elements, becoming animals or hybrid creatures, creating strange substances, or gaining other unnatural abilities. In exchange, every user suffers a universal curse: they permanently lose the ability to swim and become extremely weak when submerged in water or restrained by special sea-based materials. Devil Fruits come in strange shapes with swirl patterns and do not grow in any known place; instead, when a user dies, their power reincarnates into a nearby ordinary fruit. Because of this, Devil Fruits can be found almost anywhere, on remote islands, in treasure chests, carried by pirates or marines, or sold on black markets by other pirates, making them incredibly rare, valuable, and life-changing to those who eat them.
content.trigger_keys: Devil fruit, Devil Fruits, devil fruit, devil Fruits

content.description: Seastone cuffs are special restraints forged from a rare mineral that emits the same energy as the sea. When placed on a Devil Fruit user, they drastically weaken the body, drain strength, and prevent the user from activating or maintaining their supernatural powers. The wearer becomes sluggish, exhausted, and nearly helpless, even if they were once incredibly powerful. Seastone cuffs are commonly used by marines and bounty hunters to capture and transport Devil Fruit users safely, as they neutralize abilities as well as haki and make escape extremely difficult.

Transponder snails are living communication Snails used as long-distance phones, cameras, and surveillance devices. By linking to each other, they can transmit voices, images, and signals across vast distances. Some types are used for regular calls, others for visual video feeds, tracking signals, or mass broadcasts. They naturally mimic the voice and facial expressions of the person speaking, making communication feel direct and personal.

Covenant Contract is a supernatural agreement signed between the user and a secret world ruler named Imu. After the contract is signed, the user is granted numerous supernatural abilities, including immortality. The user gains their own purple magic circle called Abyss, which allows instant teleportation to any location at will and grants immense strength. However, in exchange for these powers, the secret ruler Imu strips the user of their free will and forces them to obey all of Imu’s commands without question.
An ancient warship of legendary power, said to possess advanced technology far beyond modern vessels. Its blueprints are coveted across the seas for the strategic advantage they could bring.
Not a traditional weapon, but you bear the legacy of an Ancient Weapon, granting you a unique connection to Sea Kings. How you use this power will shape your journey across the seas.
A mysterious ancient weapon shrouded in legend, rumored to rival Pluton and Poseidon in influence. Its true power is unknown, and many believe it can alter the tides of history itself.
